Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying rotation with a light dumbbell, turning the forearm upward with the elbow at the side. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructionsZh: 侧躺在平坦的长凳上，上臂靠在身体两侧，肘部弯曲 90 度。
手中握住哑铃，手掌朝下。
保持上臂靠在身体两侧，尽可能缓慢地向上旋转前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your upper arm against your side and your elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell in your hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your upper arm against your side, slowly rotate your forearm upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder exercise raising the arms to the side and rotating the dumbbells upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff and delts.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
向外旋转手臂，将哑铃举向头部，同时保持肘部处于同一位置。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your arms externally, bringing the dumbbells up towards your head while keeping your elbows in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise that also lifts the hips off the floor at the top. It trains the lower abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，将它们抬向天花板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, raising them towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging leg raise with added weight. It builds the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或稍高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank held face up, supported on your hands and heels. It strengthens the back of the body and opens up the chest.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl using a cable and an underhand grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将电缆附件放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine shoulder press with a lever arm, pressing the handles overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying move where the hips lift off the floor as the knees come toward the chest. It trains the lower abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在动作的最高点，挤压腹肌并暂停片刻。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides, palms facing down.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
At the top of the movement, squeeze your abs and pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch that pulls the knees toward the chest as the upper body curls up. It trains the abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部，同时将上半身卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低肩胛骨并将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest, simultaneously curling your upper body towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulder blades and extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂沿着身体两侧伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，使大腿垂直于地板。
收缩腹肌，将臀部卷离地板，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse crunch using a low cable, curling the hips off the mat. It trains the lower abs.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，然后面朝上躺在垫子上。
用双手握住电缆，并将双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖并抬起双腿，使大腿靠近胸部。
在保持上半身稳定的同时，将骨盆向胸部弯曲，将臀部抬离垫子。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a cable to a low pulley and lie down facing up on a mat.
Hold the cable with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs up, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
While keeping your upper body stable, curl your pelvis up towards your chest, lifting your hips off the mat.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿卷腹(绳索把手)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable crunch with a rope held behind the head, curling the torso forward. It strengthens the abs.
instructionsZh: 将一根绳子连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手握住绳子并将其放在脑后，保持肘部弯曲。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挤压躯干，使肘部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope with both hands and bring it behind your head, keeping your elbows bent.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch your torso forward, bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep back squat performed in a power rack for safety. It builds strength across the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at upper chest height in a rack and step under it, resting it on your upper back.
Unrack and step back with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend your hips and knees and squat down as deep as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety pins just below your lowest depth.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable kickback for the glutes with an ankle strap. This is a second version of the move.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the frame for support.
Keep your core tight and kick the strapped leg back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge where you step back and across behind you, like a curtsey. It works the glutes and outer hips from a different angle.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest up and hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or by your side.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Sit your hips back and lower under control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press up to stand, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways step up under the smith bar. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Place a bench beside you and set the bar across your upper back.
Stand with the bench at your side.
Step up sideways with the near foot.
Straighten your leg to lift your body.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机侧卧上提(髋部)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying lift using the smith machine for resistance. It targets the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side under the bar and set it at a comfortable height.
Place your top foot or leg against the bar.
Lift the leg up smoothly against the resistance.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg deadlift using the smith bar. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand holding the bar at hip height on a single leg.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward, sliding the bar down your leg.
Keep your back flat and extend the free leg behind you.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A back extension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band and secure it across your upper back.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your torso up until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the muscles between your shoulder blades and the lats.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends in your hands.
Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带俯身后侧平举 v. 3
entries.nameEn: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over raise to the sides with a band. It focuses on the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise with band resistance. It builds the calves and ankle strength.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A hammer curl with a band. The neutral grip hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A band-resisted leg kick back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it low.
Stand tall and hold support.
Press one leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hyperextension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Secure the band over your shoulders and under your feet or anchor.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Rise until your torso is in line with your legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps kickback with a band. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band, hinge forward and hold the ends.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows, pushing your hands back.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Bend slowly to return.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling pulldown with a band anchored overhead. It trains the lats and mid-back.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it.
Grab the ends with arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling glute kick against a band. It strengthens the glutes with a stable base.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours with the band around one foot and in your hands.
Keep your core tight.
Kick the banded leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise with a band. It builds the side delts.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.
Avoid shrugging.

entries.descriptionEn: A fly where your arms sweep upward from low to high. It targets the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and stand with a staggered stance.
Hold the ends with arms slightly bent.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunges with band resistance. They build the quads and glutes with extra tension.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.

entries.nameEn: band lying leg and hip raise
entries.descriptionEn: A lying raise lifting the legs and hips with a band. It works the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band set around your feet or anchored.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg curl while lying down using a band. It targets the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise against a band. It works the hip muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band around your legs.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise one leg against the band.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest fly with the band at mid-chest height. It works the pecs through a sweeping motion.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away.
Hold the ends with slightly bent elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up with a band across your back for extra resistance. It strengthens the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Loop the band across your upper back, holding the ends under your palms.
Set up in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up against the band.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl with an overhand grip using a band. It builds the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg stiff-leg deadlift with a band. It builds the hamstrings and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band on one leg and hold the ends.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward with a flat back and kick the free leg back.
Return by driving your hips forward.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An external rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing press angled upward using a band. It targets the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at your chest.
Step into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: An internal rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg extension while standing with a band around the ankle. It works the quads.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you and loop it around one ankle.
Hold support and lift the knee slightly.
Straighten your knee forward.
Squeeze your quad.
Bend slowly to return, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight-leg raise forward while standing with a band. It works the hip flexors and quads.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankle and anchor it behind you.
Stand tall holding support.
Raise the straight leg forward.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A pulldown with straight arms using a band. It isolates the lats.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it.
Hold the ends with straight arms.
Pull your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing row with a band. It works the mid-back and lats.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal twist with a band moving from low to high. It trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and hold it with both hands beside the anchor.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally up.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull a band up along your body toward chest height. It works the shoulders and upper traps with gentle, joint-friendly resistance.
instructionsEn: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends with both hands.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with the band slightly taut.
Pull your hands up along your body, leading with the elbows, until they reach about chest height.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without letting the band snap back.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders away from your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotate your forearm outward against a band while the elbow stays at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned in place.
Pause when your hand points slightly outward, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Climb on a lever stepper machine at a steady pace. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.

entries.descriptionEn: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.

entries.descriptionEn: A deeper version of chair pose where you sit lower with arms lifted. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: An arm balance where your knees rest on the backs of your upper arms and your feet lift. It builds wrist, arm and core strength.
instructionsEn: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.

entries.descriptionEn: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.

entries.nameEn: downward facing dog adho mukha svanasana
entries.descriptionEn: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on your back and lift your chest into a gentle arch. It opens the chest and front of the neck and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Balance on one leg with the torso and top leg extended sideways. It strengthens the standing leg and hips and tests your balance.
instructionsEn: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneel and sit between your feet, stretching the thighs and ankles. A grounded seat for breathing or meditation.
instructionsEn: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit cross-legged with each foot resting on the opposite thigh. It opens the hips and encourages a calm, upright posture.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.

entries.nameEn: revolved side angle pose parivrtta parsvakonasana
entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.
instructionsEn: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: spread leg forward fold upavista konasana
entries.descriptionEn: Sit with legs wide and fold forward over them. It stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward from a wide-legged stance to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh. It builds balance, focus and hip strength.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with arms raised overhead. It stretches the hip flexors and chest and strengthens the legs.
instructionsEn: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: wide legged forward bend prasarita padottanasana
entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward with your feet far apart. It stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs and eases the back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Let your head hang long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: The barbell deadlift shown from behind. It's a full posterior chain lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.

entries.descriptionEn: The barbell deadlift seen from the front. A strong lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.

entries.descriptionEn: A band curl alternating one arm at a time. It trains the biceps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住弹力带，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将一只手臂向肩膀弯曲，在顶部挤压二头肌。
将手臂放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复此动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and slowly curl one arm up towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the arm back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A V-up with a band, alternating the leg position each rep. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，将双手伸向脚趾。
当你降低双腿和上半身时，交换双腿的位置，将一条腿交叉在另一条腿上。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替变换双腿的位置。
继续进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
As you lower your legs and upper body back down, switch the position of your legs, crossing one over the other.
Repeat the movement, alternating the position of your legs with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with a band looped under the feet for assistance. It builds the lats and biceps while you work toward unassisted pull-ups.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在上拉杆或坚固的锚点上。
踏上弹力带，手掌背向自己，握住杠铃，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，保持核心收紧，肩膀向下并向后倾斜。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将肘部向下推向臀部，将身体向上拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a pull-up bar or sturdy anchor point.
Step onto the band and grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your core engaged and your shoulders down and back.
Pull your body up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An ab wheel rollout with a band to help bring you back. It trains the abs with a lighter load.
instructionsZh: 跪在地板上，双手握住弹力带的手柄，手掌朝下。
将弹力带放在您面前的地面上，双手分开与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并缓慢地向前滚动轮子，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将轮子向膝盖方向滚动，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor and hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Place the band on the ground in front of you and position your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bicycle crunch with a band, rotating the torso and alternating the knees. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双手放在脑后，膝盖弯曲。
将脚抬离地面，将右膝盖靠近胸部，同时扭转躯干，将左肘靠近右膝盖。
伸直右腿，同时将左膝靠近胸部，并扭转躯干，使右肘靠近左膝。
继续交替扭转运动，就像踩自行车一样，同时在整个运动过程中保持核心参与。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent.
Lift your feet off the ground and bring your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Straighten your right leg while bringing your left knee towards your chest and twisting your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Continue alternating the twisting motion, as if you are pedaling a bicycle, while keeping your core engaged throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Rise onto your toes against band resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.

entries.descriptionEn: A close-grip pulldown with a band, pulling down toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，用反手抓住弹力带，双手与肩同宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
当你将弹力带向下拉向胸部时，收紧你的核心并保持背部挺直，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point and grab the band with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a band around the upper arms to keep the elbows in. It trains the triceps and chest.
instructionsZh: 将一条带子绕在你的上臂上，就在肘部上方。
采取俯卧撑姿势，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Place a band around your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Assume a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated concentration curl with a band, with the elbow braced on the thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
用手握住带子的一端，用脚踩在另一端上，同时将脚放在同一侧。
稍微向前倾，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，慢慢地将手向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold one end of the band in your hand and step on the other end with your foot on the same side.
Lean forward slightly and rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, slowly curl your hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hand back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with a band, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It trains the front delts.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持双臂伸直，将弹力带举到身前，直到双臂与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and lift the band up in front of you until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with a band, raising both arms forward. It builds the front shoulders.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢向前举起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and slowly raise them forward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带水平帕洛夫推举
entries.descriptionEn: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
垂直于锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手抓住带子手柄并远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双手放在胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
调动你的核心并保持稳定的姿势。
将手臂伸直至前方，将弹力带推离身体。
保持伸展姿势几秒钟，专注于保持核心紧张。
慢慢地将双手放回胸前，抵抗弹力带的拉力。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band handle with both hands and step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Bring your hands to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your core and maintain a stable stance.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, pushing the band away from your body.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, focusing on maintaining tension in your core.
Slowly bring your hands back to your chest, resisting the pull of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over hip extension with a band, kicking one leg back. It trains the glutes.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在脚踝高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并向前倾斜，保持脊柱中立。
将右腿向后伸直，在顶部挤压臀部。
将右腿放回原位，然后换左腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and lean forward, maintaining a neutral spine.
Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower your right leg back down and repeat with the left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A jackknife sit-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时抬起双腿和上半身，将双手移向脚部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, bringing your hands towards your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
跪下，用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝下。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
调动你的背阔肌，将弹力带拉向你的一侧，使你的肘部靠近你的胸腔。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Kneel down and hold the band with one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully overhead, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Engage your lat muscles and pull the band down towards your side, bringing your elbow towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying hip rotation with a band around the feet or legs, rotating the knees out and back. It works the glutes and hips.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸直，将阻力带绕在脚上。
弯曲膝盖并将其靠近胸部，双脚并拢。
慢慢向外旋转膝盖，使膝盖彼此远离，同时保持双脚并拢。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your feet.
Bend your knees and bring them towards your chest, keeping your feet together.
Slowly rotate your knees outwards, away from each other, while keeping your feet together.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling crunch with a twist using a band. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向远离锚点的方向跪下，用双手握住弹力带，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，慢慢地将躯干扭向一侧，将双手移向另一侧的臀部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Kneel down facing away from the anchor point and hold the band with both hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, bringing your hands towards your opposite hip.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单臂过头二头弯举
entries.nameEn: band one arm overhead biceps curl
entries.descriptionEn: A standing one-arm curl with the arm held overhead against band tension. It trains the biceps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带的一端放在脚下。
握住弹力带的另一端，手臂完全伸过头顶，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，将前臂向肩膀弯曲，挤压二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place one end of the band under your foot.
Hold the other end of the band with your arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl your forearm towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单臂单腿分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: band one arm single leg split squat
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg split squat with a band, back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
向前伸出一条腿，将脚尖放在长凳上或身后的一步上。
用一只手握住支撑物以保持平衡。
弯曲站立的腿，将身体降低到蹲姿，保持膝盖与脚趾在一条直线上。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Extend one leg forward and rest the top of your foot on a bench or step behind you.
Hold onto a support with one hand for balance.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单臂站姿低位划船
entries.nameEn: band one arm standing low row
entries.descriptionEn: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的稳定锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝内，然后后退以在弹力带中产生张力。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将带子拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a stable anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with one hand, palm facing inward, and step back to create tension in the band.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: band one arm twisting chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm chest press with a band that adds a twist. It trains the chest and core.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在胸部高度的坚固锚点上。
站立，一侧面向锚点，用一只手抓住带子。
远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
将握住弹力带的手穿过身体，朝向对侧的肩膀。
在保持弹力带张力的同时，将手向前推离身体，伸展手臂。
慢慢回到起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手重复练习。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at chest height.
Stand with your side facing the anchor point and grab the band with one hand.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Bring your hand holding the band across your body, towards the opposite shoulder.
While maintaining tension in the band, push your hand forward and away from your body, extending your arm.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other hand.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单臂扭转坐姿划船
entries.nameEn: band one arm twisting seated row
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm row with a band and a torso twist. It trains the back and obliques.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住弹力带，并将手臂完全伸到身前。
保持背部挺直，弯曲肘部并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将弹力带拉向身体。
同时，将躯干向拉动手臂的一侧扭转。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放弹力带的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the band with one hand and extend your arm fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight, pull the band towards your body by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
At the same time, twist your torso towards the side of the pulling arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge pulling a band through the legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 将阻力带连接到地面上坚固的锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前迈一步，在弹力带中产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并将臀部向后推，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
向前推动臀部并挤压臀部以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at ground level.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and push your glutes back, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up that pushes a band forward as you come up. It trains the abs.
instructionsZh: 将带子牢固地固定在稳定的锚点上。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
用双手握住弹力带，并将双臂伸向天花板。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band securely to a stable anchor point.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse fly with a band, opening the arms to the sides. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在胸部高度的固定物体上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带放在身前。
保持手臂伸直并将其向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a stationary object at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and lift them out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse wrist curl with a band, lifting the back of the hands. It strengthens the forearms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住弹力带，手掌朝下，然后将其缠绕在手指上。
将前臂放在大腿上，手腕悬在边缘上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and wrap it around your fingers.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip rotation against a band around the thighs. It works the glutes and hip muscles.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
在大腿周围、膝盖上方放置一条阻力带。
保持膝盖弯曲 90 度，双脚分开与肩同宽。
收紧臀肌，慢慢向外旋转膝盖，克服弹力带的阻力。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Keep your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your glutes and slowly rotate your knees outward, pushing against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder press with a band under the feet. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
手掌朝前握住弹力带，将双手举至肩高，肘部弯曲。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将阻力带降低至肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band with your palms facing forward and raise your hands to shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带侧向三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension with a band, extending the arms out to the sides. It works the triceps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带，掌心朝下。
将手臂伸直至两侧，保持与地面平行。
慢慢弯曲肘部，将双手放在肩膀上，保持上臂不动。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, keeping them parallel to the ground.
Slowly bend your elbows and bring your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arms back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg calf raise with a band around the foot. It trains the calves.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带绕在左脚掌上。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将左脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将左脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换右腿。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.

entries.nameEn: band single leg reverse calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带放在脚掌周围。
抓住稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

entries.nameEn: resistance band sitting floor ankle dorsi flexion
entries.descriptionEn: Pull your toes toward your shin against a band while seated. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg split squat with a band. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
右脚向前迈一大步，左脚向后退一小步。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行，保持左膝盖略高于地面。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Take a big step forward with your right foot and a smaller step back with your left foot.
Bend your knees and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your left knee slightly above the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.nameEn: ball assisted lying supine hip adduction
entries.descriptionEn: Squeeze a ball between your knees while lying on your back. It targets the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying straight leg raise with a band held in the hands. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
将带子放在脚弓周围，并用手握住带子的末端。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，直到它们垂直于地板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your feet together.
Place the band around the arches of your feet and hold the ends of the band with your hands.
Engaging your abs, lift both legs off the ground until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat combined with a band row, pulling the handles as you stand. It works the legs and back.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
弯曲膝盖并蹲下，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
从蹲姿开始，将弹力带手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
From the squat position, pull the band handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.
instructionsEn: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.
instructionsEn: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating a dumbbell so your palm turns up, working the muscles that twist the forearm.
instructionsEn: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，弹力带放在膝盖上方。
保持挺胸、核心收紧，将臀部向后推，弯曲膝盖，形成下蹲姿势。
确保膝盖位于脚趾上方，并且重量位于脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A raise where each dumbbell sweeps across the front of your body. It trains the front delts and upper chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃仰卧地面挤压推举
entries.descriptionEn: A floor press with the dumbbells pressed together. The squeeze keeps your chest working throughout the lift.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press on the floor with legs straight, using one arm. It removes leg drive and challenges your trunk.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-up with cable resistance that adds load to the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing crunch with a band, curling the torso forward. It trains the abs.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住弹力带并将其举至胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands and bring it up to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.
instructionsEn: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge held in one place with a barbell on your back, so the feet stay put while you lower and rise.
instructionsEn: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A landmine press with a band adding extra resistance on the way up.
instructionsEn: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.
instructionsEn: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.
instructionsEn: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull a band toward you with elbows flared wide. It targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine rotation that trains the abs and obliques with controlled twisting.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing twisting crunch with a band, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在上背部，穿过胸前。
用手握住带子的末端，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌并将躯干向一侧扭转，将肘部移向另一侧的膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper back, crossing it in front of your chest.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and twist your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the opposite knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-up with a band around the thighs. It trains the glutes and quads.
instructionsZh: 将一条带子绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
面向台阶或平台站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
用右脚踩上平台，用脚后跟推动。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
将左脚放回地面。
重复左脚踩上平台的动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Stand facing a step or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step up onto the platform with your right foot, pushing through your heel.
Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Lower your left foot back down to the ground.
Repeat with your left foot stepping up onto the platform.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，将弹力带绕在脚踝上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，铰接臀部，慢慢将上半身降低到地面。
当你降低时，将臀部向后推，并让膝盖稍微弯曲。
将弹力带降低至地面，感受腿筋的拉伸。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将上半身抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground.
As you lower, push your hips back and allow your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the band towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal lift from low to high while half kneeling, working the trunk, hips and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm cable fly done in a braced, staggered stance, working the chest and keeping the trunk steady.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃后撤弓步蹲转单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
entries.descriptionEn: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片侧向起身深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a weight plate in front of your chest. The plate acts as a counterweight and helps keep your torso upright.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up and elbows in.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep the plate close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight-leg deadlift with a band, hinging forward at the hips. It trains the lower back and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在脚上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝向身体，手臂伸直。
收紧核心并保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
慢慢地以臀部为中心向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将弹力带降低至地面，同时保持双腿伸直。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing your body, and keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and maintain a slight bend in your knees.
Slowly hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
Lower the band towards the ground while keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive pull taking the bar from the thighs to chest height. It builds power in the traps, hips and legs.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive throw of a medicine ball from behind the head forward. It builds power from hips to arms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with a band around the waist. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，背部挺直。
将带子绕在腰上，并用双手握住两端。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将躯干扭向一侧，保持背部挺直，双脚着地。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your back straight.
Wrap the band around your waist and hold the ends with both hands.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, keeping your back straight and your feet on the ground.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse curl with a thick bar, which challenges your grip and the forearm muscles even more.
instructionsEn: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿单臂背阔肌划船
entries.nameEn: cable seated single arm lats focused row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm seated cable row that keeps the pull in the lats. Great for fixing side-to-side strength gaps.
instructionsEn: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a squat while pressing out against a machine pad. It trains the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.
