entries.descriptionEn: A plate raise that sweeps the weight out and up in a U shape, working the shoulders and upper traps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A close grip press on a decline bench that loads the triceps and lower chest together.
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机上斜窄握卧推
entries.nameEn: smith incline close grip bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A close grip press on an incline bench using the guided Smith bar to hit the triceps and upper chest.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃半跪姿单臂高翻推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell half kneeling single arm clean press
entries.descriptionEn: A half kneeling clean and press that trains the shoulder while the stance forces your core and hips to stay stable.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A medicine ball slam combined with a circular sweep, building power through the core, lats and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with a band, twisting the torso as you press. It trains the shoulders and core.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
将弹力带手柄保持在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
启动你的核心并将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
当你按压时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，保持臀部稳定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复按压和扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
As you press, twist your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the top, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the press and twist on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 站姿等长肩外旋(用毛巾)
entries.nameEn: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
entries.descriptionEn: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An underhand pulldown with a band, pulling toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧背阔肌，将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your lats and pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿等长腘绳肌弯举保持(健身球)
entries.nameEn: sitting isometric hamstring curl hold with exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: Hold a ball under your heels in a curled position. It builds endurance in the back of the thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.

entries.descriptionEn: A V-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带垂直帕洛夫推举
entries.descriptionEn: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带缠绕在胸部高度的坚固物体上。
用双手握住弹力带并远离锚点，在弹力带中产生张力。
使自己垂直于锚点，一侧面向弹力带。
将双臂伸直在身前，保持双手与胸同高。
收紧核心肌群，将弹力带压离胸部，充分伸展手臂。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢将弹力带拉回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and wrap the band around a sturdy object at chest height.
Hold the band with both hands and step away from the anchor point, creating tension in the band.
Position yourself perpendicular to the anchor point, with your side facing the band.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your hands at chest height.
Engage your core and press the band away from your chest, fully extending your arms.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then slowly bring the band back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A wrist curl with a band, curling the wrists upward. It strengthens the forearms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝上，前臂放在大腿上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing up, and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.
instructionsEn: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝内。
保持双臂伸直，将其向上举至两侧，与身体形成“Y”形。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing inwards.
Keep your arms straight and lift them up and out to the sides, forming a 'Y' shape with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug with a band, lifting the shoulders toward the ears. It trains the traps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下，用手握住两端。
保持手臂伸直并放松，让弹力带悬挂在大腿前面。
向上耸肩，尽可能高地举起弹力带，以启动斜方肌。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet, holding the ends with your hands.
Keep your arms straight and relaxed, and let the band hang in front of your thighs.
Engage your traps by shrugging your shoulders upward, lifting the band as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带交替分腿站姿帕洛夫推举
entries.nameEn: resistance band alternating split stance pallof press
entries.descriptionEn: A Pallof press from a split stance that resists the band pull and trains anti-rotation strength.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃熊爬平板交替划船
entries.descriptionEn: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge combined with a pullover and press, training the hips, chest and triceps in one flow.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片硬拉后撤弓步蹲转过头推举
entries.nameEn: weighted plate deadlift rear lunge with overhead press
entries.descriptionEn: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A goblet squat that steps around an imaginary clock, training the legs from several directions.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell swing that travels to the side, adding rotation work for the obliques to the hip snap.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
instructionsEn: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

entries.descriptionEn: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.
instructionsEn: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A half kneeling barbell lift that sweeps the bar diagonally up, training the core to control rotation.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A chained set of dumbbell shoulder moves done without rest, building shoulder strength and endurance.
instructionsEn: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive sideways medicine ball slam that builds rotational power in the chest, core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 雪橇交替单腿离心推举
entries.nameEn: sled alternating single leg negative press
entries.descriptionEn: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.
instructionsEn: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交叉罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift where the dumbbells reach across the body, training the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Crunch sideways against a band. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise a leg forward against a band loop. It targets the hip flexors and front thigh.
instructionsEn: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿后三角肌划船
entries.descriptionEn: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将弹力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips with a straight back. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在大腿上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲，铰接臀部并将弹力带降低到地面。
当你降低弹力带时，感受腿筋的拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper legs.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips and lower the band towards the ground.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the band.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 辅助站姿三头肌臂屈伸
entries.descriptionEn: A dip with machine assistance that lets you build triceps strength while handling less of your bodyweight.
instructionsEn: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine press with parallel handles, working the chest with a stable path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine fly where the arms sweep together in front, isolating the chest.
instructionsEn: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing machine move that drives one leg back to work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine curl done one arm at a time, so each biceps works independently.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated Russian twist with a kettlebell, taking the weight side to side to work the obliques and abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆腰带保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with your back foot raised, loaded through a belt machine to hit the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine extension that isolates the triceps through a stable path.
instructionsEn: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带负重站姿旋前扭转弯举(掰手腕)
entries.nameEn: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)
entries.descriptionEn: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine move that presses the leg out to the side, working the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine move that pulls the leg across the body, working the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing machine raise that lifts the leg forward to train the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐地胫骨前肌推
entries.nameEn: resistance band sitting floor tibialis press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated move that pulls the toes toward the shins against a band to strengthen the front of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine squat performed with a chair-like support, a stable way to train the legs.
instructionsEn: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.
instructionsEn: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a sandbag against the chest, training the legs and the core.
instructionsEn: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A lift that heaves the sandbag from the floor up onto your shoulder, building power and total body strength.
instructionsEn: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

entries.nameZh: 负重沙袋负重行走(扛肩)
entries.descriptionEn: A walking carry with a sandbag across the shoulders, building posture and trunk strength.
instructionsEn: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.

entries.nameZh: 负重沙袋负重行走(熊抱)
entries.descriptionEn: A walking carry with a sandbag held to the chest, taxing the core, arms and grip.
instructionsEn: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead press using a sandbag, which shifts as you push, so your shoulders and core must stay tight.
instructionsEn: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a sandbag, training the back and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A full range machine squat that builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
instructionsEn: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg squat on a machine that supports balance while you load one leg through full depth.
instructionsEn: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a steel mace across the shoulders or upper back. It builds leg strength and a braced trunk.
instructionsEn: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: Circle a steel mace around your head while standing tall. It trains shoulder control and stability under an awkward load.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.
instructionsEn: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂低位划船(用绳)
entries.nameEn: cable single arm low row (with rope)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-armed seated row with a rope handle on a low pulley. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.
instructionsEn: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.

entries.descriptionEn: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.
instructionsEn: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb and hold it. It builds finger and thumb grip strength.
instructionsEn: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃坐姿军事推举(深蹲架内)
entries.nameEn: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructionsEn: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable row where the handle sits higher than usual, pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.nameEn: seated hamstring stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿夹肩胛胸部拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

entries.nameEn: cable close grip front lat pulldown
entries.descriptionEn: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俯卧单臂后侧平举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.
instructionsEn: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 绳索反握窄距高位下拉
entries.nameEn: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown
entries.descriptionEn: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

entries.nameZh: 站姿单腿髋部画圈(椅子支撑)
entries.nameEn: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support
entries.descriptionEn: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.
instructionsEn: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
instructionsEn: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing single leg knee extension
entries.descriptionEn: Standing on one leg with a band behind the knee, you straighten the other knee. It builds quad strength with gentle load.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: seated single leg knee extension v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 负重坐姿单腿伸膝 v. 2
entries.nameEn: weighted seated single leg knee extension v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A seated knee extension with a light weight on the ankle. It adds load to build thigh strength.
instructionsEn: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.
instructionsEn: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.nameEn: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝(用毛巾)
entries.nameEn: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel
entries.descriptionEn: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.
instructionsEn: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: standing single leg concentration calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Press a plate out from your chest while lying on the floor, squeezing it with both hands. It targets the inner chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

entries.nameZh: 药球分腿站姿躯干扭转
entries.nameEn: medicine ball split stance torso twist
entries.descriptionEn: Rotate your torso side to side with a medicine ball in a split stance. It trains the trunk rotators.
instructionsEn: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

entries.descriptionEn: Swing a resistance band from overhead down in front of you in a chopping motion. It builds powerful chest and core strength.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank, tap a ball with alternating hands. It challenges your core to stay stable.
instructionsEn: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿颈屈曲到伸展
entries.nameEn: seated neck flexion to extension on chair
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

entries.nameEn: seated side to side neck twist on chair
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

entries.nameEn: seated side to side neck bend on chair
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit up while raising a medicine ball overhead and slam it down. It combines a crunch with power.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise a dumbbell in front of you all the way overhead and catch it with control. It trains the front shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press where you lower the bar and catch it quickly before pressing. It trains chest strength and control.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃同侧后撤弓步蹲高抬膝
entries.nameEn: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.
instructionsEn: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on a bench, you raise a barbell from your thighs to above your chest. It builds the front shoulder.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.
instructionsEn: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝
entries.nameEn: resistance band seated single leg hugging knee flexion
entries.descriptionEn: Seated knee flexion with a band under your foot, hugging one knee. It adds resistance to the bend.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.
instructionsEn: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 药球仰卧地面窄距推举接住
entries.nameEn: medicine ball lying floor close press catch
entries.descriptionEn: A floor press throw with narrow hands. It builds explosive pushing power through the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg version of the barbell hip thrust that demands more balance and glute strength on each side.
instructionsEn: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hip thrust with weight resting on your hips. It strengthens each glute separately and fixes side-to-side gaps.
instructionsEn: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

entries.nameZh: 臀腿伸展机全程仰卧起坐
entries.nameEn: glute ham developer full sit up
entries.descriptionEn: A full-range sit-up on a glute ham developer. The extended range makes the abs and hip flexors work through a long path.
instructionsEn: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row on an incline lever machine. The support keeps your back steady so the upper back does the work.
instructionsEn: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with your feet or upper back on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.
instructionsEn: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站在波速球上单腿外展
entries.nameEn: band standing on bosu ball single leg abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A standing hip abduction on a bosu ball against band tension. It works the outer hip and challenges your balance.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 普拉提器械仰卧踮脚伸膝
entries.nameEn: pilates machine lying knee extension on toes
entries.descriptionEn: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet on toes. It trains the front thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar, on your toes.
Bend your knees with a neutral spine.
Press the carriage away until legs straighten.
Return under control.
Keep your hips still.

entries.descriptionEn: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet flat. It trains the front thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your lower back stable.

entries.nameZh: 普拉提器械仰卧脚跟伸膝
entries.nameEn: pilates machine lying knee extension on heels
entries.descriptionEn: Straighten your knees on a reformer pressing through the heels. It works the thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: Press the carriage with just your toes on a reformer. It builds calf strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
Return slowly.
Keep your knees locked softly.

entries.descriptionEn: Pump your arms against the straps while holding your legs up. It builds core endurance.
instructionsEn: Lie on the carriage holding the straps.
Lift your head and legs.
Pump your arms in small movements.
Breathe in for five counts and out for five.
Continue for 100 pumps.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助单臂引体向上
entries.nameEn: resistance band assisted single arm pull up
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.
instructionsEn: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

entries.nameZh: 吊环弹力带辅助单臂引体向上
entries.nameEn: ring resistance band assisted single arm pull up
entries.descriptionEn: A band-assisted single-arm pull-up on gymnastic rings. The rings add instability and grip demand.
instructionsEn: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A ring pull-up variation where you pull up, then press down toward the hips. It builds pulling strength and shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.
instructionsEn: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.
instructionsEn: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

entries.descriptionEn: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿单臂水平划船
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling single arm horizontal row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带跪姿单臂水平划船
entries.nameEn: band kneeling single arm horizontal row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm band row from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and mid back with simple equipment.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆配重片坐姿上斜推胸
entries.nameEn: lever stack seated incline chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated press on an incline lever machine with a weight stack. It emphasises the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull a cable down with straight arms. It isolates the lats.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆配重片坐姿上斜单臂推胸
entries.nameEn: lever stack seated incline single arm chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm incline press on a lever machine. Working one side at a time evens out strength differences.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine press with a weight stack. It is a stable way to build the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆配重片坐姿单臂推胸
entries.nameEn: lever stack seated single arm chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm seated press on a lever machine. It builds the chest on each side and trains the core to resist twisting.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a kettlebell held across your upper back. It loads the legs and challenges your trunk.
instructionsEn: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a landmine bar at your chest, followed by a jump. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.
instructionsEn: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

entries.descriptionEn: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: Extend your arm back against cable resistance. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotate your torso against a cable. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Curl yourself toward the straps while leaning back. It works the biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Row yourself up under straps with knees bent. It builds the back.
instructionsEn: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Crunch while holding a plate. It works the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Dip between straps. It works the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

entries.descriptionEn: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.
instructionsEn: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: Press yourself away from the straps. It works the chest.
instructionsEn: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 负重沙袋罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rope climb done with your legs held out in an L shape. It is a tough test for the lats, grip and abs.
instructionsEn: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.

entries.nameEn: side to side jump over stepbox
entries.descriptionEn: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.
instructionsEn: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.
instructionsEn: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Open your arms wide against the straps. It stretches and works the chest.
instructionsEn: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

entries.nameZh: 木棍仰卧单臂三头肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: stick lying single arm triceps stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
