Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂三头肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing single arm triceps stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A standing triceps stretch with a band assisting. The band helps you ease into a deeper stretch.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

entries.nameEn: lying single arm slide from y to t
entries.descriptionEn: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐姿单腿腘绳肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: resistance band seated single leg hamstring stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated hamstring stretch with a band around your foot. The band lets you control the pull.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.

entries.nameEn: resistance band seated single leg knee extension
entries.descriptionEn: A seated knee extension against band tension. It isolates the quads one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

entries.nameZh: 站姿单腿前后左右点地
entries.nameEn: standing single leg front back side to side toe tap
entries.descriptionEn: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise your body with arms in front using straps. It works the front delts.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated knee raise against band tension. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: single leg calf jump step box supported
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

entries.descriptionEn: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral hop from leg to leg while holding a medicine ball. It trains balance and side-to-side power.
instructionsEn: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A walk on your toes with a band around your feet. It builds calf and ankle strength.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways walk on your toes against band tension. It works calves, ankles and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿单腿弯举(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever seated single leg curl (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg seated hamstring curl on a plate-loaded machine. It builds each hamstring separately.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg press-like squat on a sled while lying back. It builds leg strength with back support.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing leg raise to the side with one foot in a strap. It works the outer hip and stability muscles.
instructionsEn: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with heels in straps, which adds an instability challenge. It builds glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Hip hinge back extension with feet in straps. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row hanging under straps. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank with feet in straps, you pike the hips up. It hits the abs hard and challenges the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm drill where you rotate a dumbbell through your palm. It builds wrist and forearm control.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

entries.nameEn: split stance single leg calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.
instructionsEn: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank with feet in straps, you pull the knees toward the chest. It trains the abs and core control.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿平衡屈腿髋外展
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing balance bent leg hip abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A standing hip abduction on one leg with a band. The bent working knee changes the angle.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hamstring curl with heels in straps while bridging. It works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Mountain climbers with feet in straps, which adds instability. It trains the core and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

entries.nameZh: 普拉提器械仰卧蛙腿与腿画圈
entries.nameEn: pilates machine lying frog and leg circle
entries.descriptionEn: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.
instructionsEn: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Press your legs straight.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: Reformer footwork that alternates the legs like running. It trains the calves, quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on the reformer with the balls of your feet on the bar.
Straighten both legs.
Lower one heel while bending the other knee.
Alternate smoothly.
Keep your pelvis still.
Maintain steady breathing.

entries.nameZh: 普拉提器械仰卧骨盆上抬
entries.descriptionEn: A reformer bridge that lifts the hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet on the bar and knees bent.
Press your arms into the pad.
Lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Hold at the top.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your ribs relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer move where you open and close the legs sideways. It works the inner thighs and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Brace your core.
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer squat variation that builds the legs. It focuses on controlled bending and straightening.
instructionsEn: Set your feet on the carriage and platform.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees into a squat.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over toes.
Press back up to standing.
Move with the carriage smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer split stance with the carriage sliding. It works the legs, glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Place one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Slide the carriage back while lowering into a split squat.
Pause.
Press back to the start.
Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer roll-over that mobilises the spine. It stretches the back and works the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet against the shoulder rests.
Press your legs straight up.
Roll your hips off the pad.
Lift your hips over your shoulders.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
Avoid pressing on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer arm circle holding straps. It works the shoulders and the upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding the straps with arms up.
Bend your knees and brace your core.
Lower your arms out to the sides.
Circle them down and up in a smooth arc.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A reformer move pulling the straps behind you. It opens the chest and works the upper back.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: Reformer work with straps overhead. It trains the shoulders, abs and posture.
instructionsEn: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
Brace your core.
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow, loaded forward bend that rolls through the spine. Keep the barbell light and the motion smooth.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a very light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin and roll down one segment at a time.
Let the bar hang close to your legs.
Go only as low as feels controlled.
Roll back up slowly.
Keep your knees soft.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out and up in an L to U path. It builds shoulder strength and upper back control.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.

entries.nameZh: 站姿地面胫骨前肌上抬(扶墙)
entries.nameEn: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
entries.descriptionEn: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful pull from a long position under the straps. It builds the lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

entries.nameEn: cable side leg kick from back
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable kick that sweeps the leg out and back. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 负重球反向背伸(臀腿伸展机)
entries.nameEn: weighted ball reverse hyperextension on ghd
entries.descriptionEn: Reverse hyper on a GHD, with a ball held between your feet. It trains glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

entries.nameEn: bodyweight single leg deadlift against ball
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机坐姿单臂中立握肩部推举
entries.nameEn: smith seated single arm neutral grip shoulders press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm seated press on the smith machine with a neutral grip. It trains the shoulder while the bar path stays guided.
instructionsEn: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉(凳上)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell single leg romanian deadlift on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with the rear foot on a bench. It targets hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆俯身单臂背阔肌划船
entries.nameEn: lever bent over single arm lats focused row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm machine row done from a bent-over stance. It targets the lats with a strong squeeze.
instructionsEn: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆上斜俯卧中立握划船
entries.nameEn: lever incline prone neutral grip row
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat standing on a Bosu ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
instructionsEn: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat on a Bosu ball. It challenges the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with a strap held between your legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge held with a band while stepping sideways. It targets glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片卷腹(双手过头)
entries.descriptionEn: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃负重卷腹(双手过头)
entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a dumbbell held overhead. The extra load and long lever challenge your abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片卷腹(双手过头) v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second take on the overhead plate crunch. It trains the abs with a long, loaded lever.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 负重哑铃卷腹(双手过头) v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up using suspension handles. It builds the lats and arms.
instructionsEn: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.
instructionsEn: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.
instructionsEn: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg lift against a band that works the outer hip. Good for glute and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse fly using suspension handles. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm shrug with a dumbbell. It builds the upper traps and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
instructionsEn: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助单臂引体向上 v. 2
entries.nameEn: resistance band assisted single arm pull up v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm pull-up where a band takes some of your body weight. It helps you work toward an unassisted rep.
instructionsEn: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

entries.descriptionEn: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.
instructionsEn: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.

entries.descriptionEn: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A rollout using suspension handles. It challenges the abs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿单腿足部左右摆动
entries.nameEn: seated single leg foot side to side
entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle move that sweeps the foot from side to side. It improves ankle mobility.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Turn your foot inward, then outward, in a smooth motion.
Move through a comfortable range.
Repeat for your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Curling and squeezing the toes while seated. It wakes up the small muscles of the feet.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Curl all your toes down as if gripping the floor.
Squeeze for a couple of seconds.
Relax and spread your toes wide.
Repeat smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-foot toe curl while seated. It trains the muscles under the foot.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair and place one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and squeeze.
Hold for a second or two.
Relax and spread the toes.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise on one leg. It strengthens the thigh and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A shallow squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. Good for beginners and for warm-ups.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged hinge held at the bottom. It builds balance and the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

entries.nameEn: bodyweight single leg deadlift toe touch
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hinge where you reach to touch your toes. It trains balance and the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿单腿胫骨前肌推 v. 2
entries.nameEn: seated single leg tibialis press v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated press that engages the shin muscle. Useful for ankle control.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿单腿挤压脚趾 v. 2
entries.nameEn: seated single leg squeezing toes v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Another one-foot toe squeeze while seated. It strengthens the small muscles in the foot.
instructionsEn: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿单腿足部左右摆动 v. 2
entries.nameEn: seated single leg foot side to side v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second version of the side-to-side seated foot move for ankle mobility.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing the toes into the floor while seated. It activates the foot and calf muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with one foot on the floor.
Lift your heel slightly and press your toes into the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower your heel again.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐姿单腿伸膝保持
entries.nameEn: resistance band seated single leg knee extension hold
entries.descriptionEn: A seated band-resisted knee extension that you hold at the top. It builds quad endurance.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.
Straighten that knee against the band.
Hold the leg straight for 10-20 seconds.
Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch for the back of the lower leg and the Achilles area.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump taking off from two feet and landing on one. It builds power and landing control.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

entries.nameZh: 站姿靠墙下滑四分之一深蹲保持
entries.nameEn: standing wall slide quarter squat hold
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported quarter squat that you hold. It gently loads the thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

entries.nameZh: 站姿毛巾向前滑动推举
entries.nameEn: standing forward slide press with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A towel slid forward along a wall that presses the arm out. It builds gentle shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 站姿毛巾靠墙前锯肌滑动
entries.nameEn: standing wall serratus slide with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A towel slide up the wall that works the muscle along the ribs. It supports healthy shoulder blade motion.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.
Slide your arm upward along the wall.
Reach the top without shrugging.
Slide back down slowly and switch arms.

entries.nameEn: standing internal rotation slide with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder inward. It works the rotator cuff gently.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带自助胸部臂屈伸
entries.descriptionEn: A chest dip with your feet on the floor for help. It builds the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

entries.nameEn: standing external rotation slide with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder outward. It strengthens the back of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: standing external rotation behind back with towel
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a towel behind your back to rotate the shoulder outward. It improves shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

entries.nameEn: shoulder stretch behind the back with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A towel stretch behind the back that opens the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A light side-lying rotation for the back of the shoulder. Often used for shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: bodyweight side lying shoulder external rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying outward shoulder rotation with no weight. It trains rotator cuff control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 木棍背后外展肩部灵活性练习
entries.nameEn: stick shoulder mobilization in abduction behind back
entries.descriptionEn: Using a stick to guide the arm out and back behind you. It improves shoulder range.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back.
Hold it with one hand low and the other high.
Use the low hand to guide the top arm out and up.
Move only in a comfortable range.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Passing a stick overhead and around the body. It opens up the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold a stick with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead with straight arms.
Continue the arc behind your back as far as comfortable.
Return along the same path.
Narrow your grip over time.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating the shoulder against a wall. It gives gentle mobility and awareness.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place your forearm against it.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and down against the wall.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up using your legs for help. It builds back and arms.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A scapular pull-up with a gentle swing. It builds shoulder blade control and grip.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging the dumbbells with straight arms to load the biceps. A shoulder and arm builder.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Swing the dumbbells forward and up in a controlled arc.
Lower them back down.
Keep your torso still and avoid momentum.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带自助三头肌臂屈伸
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps dip with your feet on the floor for help. It trains the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

entries.nameEn: ring long arms push up hold
entries.descriptionEn: A push-up hold on rings with arms fully extended. It demands shoulder stability and core tension.
instructionsEn: Set the rings low and take a plank with your hands on them.
Keep your arms straight and rings close to your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor to rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A raise from an L-sit position. It builds strong abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

entries.descriptionEn: External rotation using straps. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

entries.descriptionEn: A side bend using a strap. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

entries.descriptionEn: Back extension holding a dumbbell. It trains the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Do not overextend.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with your feet in the straps. It strengthens the obliques and stabilisers.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A box jump holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top.
Step down carefully and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: Starting kneeling, you jump onto a box holding dumbbells. A very explosive move.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Swing your arms and drive up to your feet.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully and reset to kneeling.

entries.descriptionEn: A hold on parallettes with knees tucked and hips lifted. It builds shoulder and core strength.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带单腿分腿蹲(自助)
entries.nameEn: suspension single leg split squat (self assisted)
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat holding the handles for help. It trains the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A walk on hands and feet facing up. It works the arms, glutes and core.
instructionsEn: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

entries.nameEn: wall assisted handstand to tuck planche negative
entries.descriptionEn: Lowering from a wall handstand into a tuck planche. It builds advanced shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

entries.nameZh: 面墙单腿分腿倒立保持
entries.nameEn: wall facing single leg split handstand hold
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-facing handstand with one leg split off the wall. It trains balance and shoulder endurance.
instructionsEn: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with the rear foot in a strap. It builds the front leg and balance.
instructionsEn: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿手臂交叉与挺胸
entries.nameEn: seated arm crossover and chest out on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that crosses the arms and then opens the chest. It loosens the upper body.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hug yourself.
Open your arms wide and push your chest out.
Hold the open position for 5-10 seconds.
Repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat holding the handles for balance. It builds leg strength.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

entries.nameEn: hip lift low back off floor
entries.descriptionEn: A lying move where you lift the hips so the lower back leaves the floor. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with palms facing up. It targets the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃半跪姿单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell half kneeling single arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead press from a half kneeling stance. It trains the shoulder while the position challenges your balance and core.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃跪姿单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell kneeling single arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead press done on both knees. The kneeling position takes the legs out so your shoulder and core do the work.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg curl with your hips kept straight. It works the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A dip with suspension handles. It trains the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带三头肌伸展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension leaning on straps. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg raise that targets the outer hip. It is a simple way to strengthen the muscles that keep your pelvis steady.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you press your knees outward. It trains the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿屈膝外展(双脚离地)
entries.nameEn: seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
entries.descriptionEn: Seated knee abduction with the feet lifted. It trains the outer hips and core.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank with feet in straps, you twist the hips side to side. It trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐姿屈膝外展(双脚离地)
entries.nameEn: resistance band seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
entries.descriptionEn: Seated knee abduction against band resistance with feet lifted. It trains the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with a band around your thighs and feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees against the band.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿高位交叉中立握三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable standing high cross neutral grip triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps pushdown with the cable set high and the handles crossed, using a neutral grip. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust on the Smith machine with a staggered stance. It builds the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Stagger your feet, one slightly ahead.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

entries.nameEn: lever staggered stance hip thrust (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded machine hip thrust with a staggered stance. It targets the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips.
Stagger your feet.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips fully.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆腰带相扑硬拉(V形杠)
entries.descriptionEn: A sumo deadlift on a belt squat style lever machine holding a V bar. It loads the legs and hips with less strain on the back.
instructionsEn: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿肩胛回缩(挂片式)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine move where you pull your shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable move that trains your shoulder blades to pull back. It helps posture and builds the mid back.
instructionsEn: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃髋部支撑罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift with your hips supported against a surface. It teaches a clean hip hinge and loads the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带跪姿凳上腿后踢
entries.nameEn: resistance band kneeling leg kickback on bench
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling on a bench, you kick one leg back against band tension to work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band and loop it around one foot, then kneel on a bench with hands on the front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended.
Squeeze the glute for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly under control without letting the band yank your leg.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees toward one side of the chest, which hits the abs and obliques hard.
instructionsEn: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

entries.nameEn: cable face pull with external rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A face pull that finishes with a rotation of the arms. It hits the rear shoulders and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning back on the straps, you pull your arms up into a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell over the chest lying abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying hip abduction while you hold a dumbbell over your chest. It trains the outer hips and adds a core challenge.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hold a dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise your top leg without rotating your torso.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带手臂弯举至耳旁
entries.descriptionEn: You curl your body up toward your hands with the straps at head height, a bodyweight biceps builder.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

entries.nameZh: 后撤弓步蹲手臂伸展扭转
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach and a twist. It warms up the legs, hips and spine together.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Step one leg back into a lunge and reach both arms overhead.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Untwist, then push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A strap curl where you hold the contraction close to the head, great for biceps peak work and arm control.
instructionsEn: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

entries.nameEn: single arm hanging toes to bar
entries.descriptionEn: A hanging core move done from one hand. Lifting your toes to the bar trains the abs and grip.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling rotational move with a landmine bar, swinging it in a wide arc side to side. It builds strong, rotating abs.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your hips squared and core tight.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Swing across to the other side in a controlled sweep.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift variation with a two-thirds range of motion. It is a good way to drill the lower, hardest part of the lift.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip width and the bar over your mid foot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up.
Lower the bar back toward the floor under control.
Reset each rep and keep your back neutral.

entries.nameEn: sitting cat cow stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle spinal stretch you can do on a chair. It moves your back through flexion and extension to ease stiffness.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your hands on your knees and feet flat.
Inhale, arch your back and lift your chest.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 8-10 breaths.

entries.descriptionEn: From a forearm plank with feet in the straps, you rock your body back and forth like a saw to challenge the core.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

entries.descriptionEn: A narrow-hand push on the straps that shifts work toward the triceps and inner chest.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees in and curl the hips up, a direct ab move.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

entries.descriptionEn: A strap row to the face with elbows high that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced inverted press with hands on the straps, working the triceps and shoulders strongly.
instructionsEn: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with the hands in the straps and the body angled upward, a gentler version that builds the chest.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding the straps for balance, you squat and jump explosively to build leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带后撤交叉弓步蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A rear lunge where the back leg crosses behind the front one, hitting the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A strap row to mid-chest height that works the upper back and arms using your body weight.
instructionsEn: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

entries.descriptionEn: A hard conditioning move combining a push-up with mountain climber knee drives while the feet sit in the straps.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling out on the straps with a slight side angle, you hit the obliques and deep core.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: You curl yourself up with one arm holding a single strap, a tough unilateral biceps move.
instructionsEn: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm push on one strap that trains the chest while the core fights rotation.
instructionsEn: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带单臂单腿俯卧撑
entries.nameEn: suspender one arm leg push up
entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with feet in the straps and one hand lifted, building chest strength and total-body stability.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable fly that trains your chest through a wide hugging arc. The constant cable tension keeps the muscle working.
instructionsEn: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and lean slightly.
With soft elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable chop that works your obliques and core with a diagonal pull.
instructionsEn: Set the cable high, kneel side-on to it and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your hips square and your core tight.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body down toward the opposite hip.
Rotate through your torso, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat while holding a cable overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder stability and core control.
instructionsEn: Set a cable low and hold the handle overhead with straight arms, standing tall.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep the handle over your head and chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm style pulldown from a kneeling position. It targets the lats without help from your legs.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿反向飞鸟 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable reverse fly aimed at the rear shoulders and upper back. It helps balance all the pressing you do.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the opposite handles, arms crossed.
Stand tall with soft elbows.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the crossed start.

entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge with cable resistance. It builds strength in your hips and thighs through a sideways step.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your chest.
Step wide to the side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press using cables. The steady tension gives your chest and triceps constant work.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿高位划船 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A seated row with the handle pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit at a cable station with the pulley set high and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing move with one arm pressing while the other rows. It trains pushing and pulling together and tests your core.
instructionsEn: Stand in a staggered stance between two cables, one handle in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other back toward your ribs.
Reverse the roles slowly.
Alternate sides for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable kickback that targets the glutes. It teaches you to extend the hip without arching your back.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A strap chest press with one foot lifted, adding a balance challenge to the pressing movement.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿军事推举 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling overhead press with cables. The position keeps your legs out of it, so the shoulders do the work.
instructionsEn: Kneel between two low pulleys and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press both handles straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿二头弯举(绳索把手) v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable standing biceps curl (rope attachment) v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl with a rope on a low cable. The rope lets you turn your hands at the top for a stronger squeeze.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧交替屈腿折刀 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable lying alternating bent leg jackknife v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg-raise style core move against cable resistance, alternating legs. It hits the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂旋转划船 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable single arm row with rotation v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable row that adds a torso rotation. It trains the back and the twisting muscles of the core.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable press on an incline bench. It shifts the work toward the upper chest with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable knee raise that trains the hip flexors. It helps lifting your leg with control.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable leg raise to the side. It strengthens the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable move where you pull your leg across your body. It works the inner thigh.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a cable at the chest. The cable adds load and encourages an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

entries.nameZh: 绳索俯身单臂划船 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable bent over single arm row v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over one-arm row with a low cable. It builds the lats and mid back with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A strap-based pull-up variation that builds the lats and arms, with an angled body you can adjust.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable crunch that loads the abs. You curl your spine to bring your elbows toward your knees.
instructionsEn: Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿躯干扭转 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable rotation that trains the obliques. Turn through your torso with your arms staying in front.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿二头弯举转阿诺德推举 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable standing biceps curl to arnold press v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A combo of a biceps curl flowing into an Arnold press with cables. It works arms and shoulders in one fluid move.
instructionsEn: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying cable fly that stretches and squeezes the chest. The cables keep tension on at the top.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿交替斜向推胸 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable standing alternating diagonal chest press v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A standing diagonal cable press done one arm at a time. It trains the chest and challenges your core.
instructionsEn: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.

entries.nameZh: 绳索侧平板支撑划船 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank held while you row a cable. It trains the core, shoulders and back at the same time.
instructionsEn: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索俯卧单腿弯举 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable prone single leg curl v. 3
