entries.descriptionEn: A lying face-down leg curl on a cable. Training one leg at a time builds the hamstrings evenly.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise using a low cable. It builds the front of the shoulders with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend that loads the obliques with a cable. It trains your core to resist and control sideways motion.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单臂过头三头肌伸展 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable standing single arm overhead triceps extension v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead triceps extension with a cable. The overhead position stretches and works the long head of the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands in unstable straps, making the chest, arms and core work harder.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

entries.nameZh: 臀腿伸展机直臂仰卧起坐
entries.nameEn: glute ham developer straight arms sit up
entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up on a glute ham developer with your arms extended. The longer range makes your abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump where you tuck the knees and cross the feet in the air, great for conditioning and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying chest fly with a kettlebell, alternating arms. It trains the chest and challenges your control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

entries.nameEn: resistance band lying floor chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A floor chest press using a resistance band. It trains the chest and triceps with tension that increases at the top.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃半跪姿侧向弓步蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A half kneeling side lunge with a kettlebell. It opens the inner thigh and hips while loading the legs.
instructionsEn: Start in a half kneeling position holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Straighten the front leg to the side as you shift your weight back.
Feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Return to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃站姿背后罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.nameEn: kettlebell standing behind back romanian deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift holding a kettlebell behind you. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and reinforces a straight back.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug done with your arms overhead. It wakes up the upper traps and builds shoulder awareness.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill that loosens the ankles and hips. It is a good warm-up for squats and lunges.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge with the hands on the straps for balance, working the thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse fly on the straps that works the rear shoulders and upper back to improve posture.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat on the Smith machine to a bench. The bench gives you a consistent depth and a stable path.
instructionsEn: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆单臂反握高位下拉(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever single arm reverse grip lateral pulldown (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm pulldown on a plate-loaded machine using an underhand grip. It trains the lats and biceps one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带侧向交叉弓步蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge stepping out to the side and across, with straps for support, training the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 椅子靠墙上斜窄距俯卧撑
entries.nameEn: incline close grip push up with chair against wall
entries.descriptionEn: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
instructionsEn: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

entries.descriptionEn: A half squat with your back sliding against a wall. It builds leg strength with support and good alignment.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片背部伸展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A back extension holding a weight plate. The plate adds resistance for the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping wide to the side while holding the straps works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带单臂后三角肌划船
entries.nameEn: suspender single arm rear delt row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm strap row with the elbow flared, aimed at the rear shoulder.
instructionsEn: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂带单腿平板支撑(直臂)
entries.nameEn: suspender single leg plank straight arm
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm plank with feet in the straps and one leg lifted, which challenges core stability.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm plank with feet in the straps and one leg raised, fighting rotation and sag.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg squat holding the straps for support, building leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying down with your feet in the straps, you sit up to train the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying stretch that opens up the back of the shoulder. Handy for keeping internal rotation smooth.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with feet in the straps where one knee drives toward the elbow as you lower.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the muscles on top of the forearm that lift the wrist. Good after typing, climbing or heavy gripping.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A fly on the straps with a split stance, opening the arms to work the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

entries.descriptionEn: You hold the straps and drive the knees like a sprinter, a quick leg and cardio move.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat while holding the straps overhead, working the legs and mobility of the shoulders and torso.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat where you hold the straps for balance and can lean back for depth.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿中立握过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable standing neutral grip overhead triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: Overhead cable extension with a neutral grip that loads the long head of the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 悬吊带站姿腹肌滚轮前推
entries.descriptionEn: Standing with the straps, you lean forward and roll out with straight arms, a challenging core move.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with the feet in the straps spread wide like a star, challenging the core and hips.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

entries.nameZh: 上台阶(第一级和第二级台阶)
entries.descriptionEn: A simple stair step-up done on the first and second steps. It builds leg strength and balance using everyday stairs.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

entries.nameZh: 站姿靠墙滑动半蹲保持
entries.nameEn: standing wall slide half squat hold
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf stretch variation that lengthens the lower leg muscles and helps ankle mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with the feet spread in the straps, which adds a big core and hip challenge.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with your feet in the straps, you curl the hips up to work the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A back-facing plank with the heels in the straps that strengthens the glutes, back and core.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

entries.nameZh: 悬吊带三头肌伸展俯卧撑
entries.descriptionEn: Lowering your head toward the handles then pushing out, a strap extension that hammers the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning forward with the straps, you straighten the elbow behind you to isolate the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: From a side-facing plank position with the straps, you twist to hit the obliques.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

entries.descriptionEn: You pull the knees up and twist across the body from a plank with the feet in the straps.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆腰带单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.nameEn: lever belt single leg romanian deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hip hinge on a belt-loaded lever machine that trains hamstrings and glutes with extra balance support.
instructionsEn: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning back on the straps with your arms extended, you stretch the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and step back so your arms are straight.
Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.
Feel the stretch between the shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and return.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding the straps for balance, you rise onto your toes to train the calves.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip hinge with the straps for balance, training the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying or planking with the feet in the straps, you swing the legs side to side like a pendulum to train the obliques.
instructionsEn: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆俯卧腿弯举至反向山羊挺身
entries.nameEn: lever lying leg curl to reverse hyperextension
entries.descriptionEn: A combo move on a lever machine: curl the legs up, then lift the hips and legs to work hamstrings and glutes together.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机单侧保加利亚分腿蹲(垫高后脚)
entries.nameEn: smith unilateral bulgarian split squat from deficit
entries.descriptionEn: A Bulgarian split squat on a Smith machine with the front foot raised, giving extra depth for quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing side leg raise
entries.descriptionEn: Standing, you lift one leg out to the side against band tension, working the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding the straps, you hinge the hips back and forth to train the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing, you extend one leg behind you against band tension to work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, you shuffle forward on your glutes to warm up the hips and work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

entries.nameEn: lying thoracic extensions on foam roller
entries.descriptionEn: Lying over a foam roller, you gently arch the upper back to open up the thoracic spine.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

entries.descriptionEn: Using the straps for support, you sink into a wide side stance to stretch the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and step your legs wide.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Sit back into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge with the straps for balance, working the outer hips and legs.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A full-body move: squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. It builds endurance and strength.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将双手放在身前的地板上，将身体降低至蹲姿。
将脚踢回到俯卧撑位置。
进行俯卧撑，保持身体呈一条直线。
将双脚跳回蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起，将双臂举过头顶。
轻轻落地并立即回到蹲姿，开始下一次重复。
instructionsEn: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and placing your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet back into the squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.

entries.descriptionEn: Steady rowing on an indoor machine for full-body cardio conditioning.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructionsEn: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Calf raise under a Smith machine bar, working the calves with a fixed bar path for stable loading.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

entries.nameEn: resistance band side lying hip abduction
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg against band resistance to work the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 股四头肌静态收缩(等长)
entries.descriptionEn: Seated or lying with your leg straight, you tighten the thigh muscle and hold, an easy way to activate the quads.
instructionsEn: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Squeezing the glutes and holding without moving, a simple way to activate the hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Small, springy hops on one leg that build calf and ankle stiffness, elasticity and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone raise that moves the arms into a W shape to strengthen the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf stretch with a bent back knee that targets the deeper soleus muscle near the Achilles tendon.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃站姿军事推举(无架)
entries.descriptionEn: A strict overhead press where you clean or lift the bar to your shoulders without a rack.
instructionsEn: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

entries.nameEn: seated single leg calf raise on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
instructionsEn: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip opener that lets one knee drop to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

entries.nameZh: 负重杠铃片过头反向弓步蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge while holding a plate overhead, which trains the legs and challenges shoulder and core stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive lunge jump where you switch legs in the air. It builds power and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic chest stretch, swinging the arms out and across the chest. It loosens the chest and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢地将双臂向前伸，交叉在身体前面。
感受胸部肌肉的伸展。
保持拉伸 10-30 秒。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly bring your arms forward, crossing them in front of your body.
Feel the stretch in your chest muscles.
Hold the stretch for 10-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

entries.nameZh: 45度单腿山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)
entries.nameEn: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
instructionsEn: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up done hanging from ropes, which adds a big grip challenge to the vertical pull.
instructionsEn: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.

entries.descriptionEn: A horizontal row hanging under rope handles that works the back and grip.
instructionsEn: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.nameZh: 负重石头站姿过头爆发推举
entries.nameEn: weighted stone standing power overhead press
entries.descriptionEn: A strongman-style overhead press with a heavy stone, using a small leg drive for power.
instructionsEn: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆上斜胸部支撑反向飞鸟(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported reverse fly on a plate-loaded lever machine that isolates the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with extra load and assistance so you can adjust difficulty while keeping good form.
instructionsEn: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

entries.nameEn: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
entries.descriptionEn: An incline bench press with a wide underhand grip that emphasizes the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

entries.descriptionEn: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a forward torso lean that shifts more of the load onto the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise performed lying on an incline bench to reduce swinging and isolate the front delts.
instructionsEn: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机俯身划船(胸部支撑)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row on the Smith machine that takes stress off the lower back.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl on an incline seat with cable resistance for a deep, constant-tension biceps stretch.
instructionsEn: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单臂反握胸推
entries.nameEn: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃仰卧锤式推举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with dumbbells held in a neutral grip that is easier on the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.
instructionsEn: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃错位站姿直腿硬拉
entries.nameEn: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

entries.descriptionEn: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: single arm fingers press with ball
entries.descriptionEn: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.
instructionsEn: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.
instructionsEn: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

entries.nameEn: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.
instructionsEn: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

entries.nameEn: bent over back to side to front arms raise
entries.descriptionEn: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell bent over back to side to front arms raise
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over sweeping raise with light dumbbells that targets the rear and side delts through a long arc.
instructionsEn: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧同时交替直腿抬腿
entries.nameEn: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
entries.descriptionEn: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃地面仰卧单臂直臂推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧单腿股四头肌松动
entries.descriptionEn: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

entries.descriptionEn: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.
instructionsEn: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

entries.nameEn: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.
instructionsEn: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂弯举加等长保持
entries.nameEn: dumbbell single arm curl with isometric hold
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm curl that pauses at the halfway point to increase biceps tension.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.
instructionsEn: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.
instructionsEn: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆T杠窄握划船(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever t bar close grip row (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.
instructionsEn: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

entries.nameZh: 上斜扭转仰卧起坐 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.
instructionsEn: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交替二头弯举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

entries.descriptionEn: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.
instructionsEn: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance deadlift finished with an upright row. It works the thighs, glutes and shoulders in one smooth motion.
instructionsEn: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各拿一个哑铃。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将哑铃放在您面前的地面上。
将双脚踢回到俯卧撑位置，保持身体呈一条直线。
进行俯卧撑，弯曲肘部并将胸部降低到地面。
将脚向后跳向双手，以蹲姿着地。
爆发性地站起来，将哑铃从地上举起，放到肩膀上。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回到肩膀上，然后重复整个序列，达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Perform a push-up, bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat position.
Stand up explosively, lifting the dumbbells off the ground and bringing them to your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂内侧二头弯举
entries.nameEn: cable one arm inner biceps curl
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm cable curl with the elbow pointing slightly out to emphasise the inner biceps.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂扭转坐姿划船
entries.nameEn: cable one arm twisting seated row
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.
instructionsEn: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal cable rotation from low to high that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
instructionsEn: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索转体(由上向下) v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal cable rotation from high to low that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
instructionsEn: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead cable press where you rotate your torso as you push. It works the shoulders and the core together.
instructionsEn: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索扭转站姿高位划船
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable row at a high angle with a torso twist. It hits the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索扭转站姿单臂胸推
entries.nameEn: cable twisting standing one arm chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A standing single-arm cable press with a rotation. It trains the chest and the core's ability to resist and produce twist.
instructionsEn: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable row where you turn your torso as you pull. It works the back with some added core rotation.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable press performed upward or downward in a vertical line while holding the core still. It trains anti-rotation and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline reverse grip 30 degrees bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A low-incline dumbbell press with palms facing you. The reverse grip puts extra focus on the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral lunge with dumbbells that trains the glutes, quads and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

entries.nameEn: lever seated one leg calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg seated calf raise on a machine. Working each leg alone helps balance strength and targets the soleus.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise done on a chest press style lever machine, using the seat and handles to load the calves.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Shrugging with a lever press machine as the load. It builds the upper traps with a stable, guided path.
instructionsEn: Set the machine so the handles are at your sides and grip them firmly.
Stand or sit tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly without rolling them.

entries.nameZh: 辅助窄距反握引体向上
entries.nameEn: assisted close grip underhand chin up
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up with machine assistance and a narrow underhand grip. It lets you build pulling strength with less bodyweight.
instructionsEn: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row under a low bar with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机站姿肩部推举
entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead press on the Smith machine. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pushing.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at shoulder height and stand under it with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar and hold it at your collarbone.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders slowly.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing a weight plate overhead with both hands. A simple way to train the shoulders and arms.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your elbows slightly forward.
Press the plate overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with an EZ bar. The angled grips can feel kinder on the wrists while you train the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar at your upper chest with a comfortable grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest.
Keep your head neutral and avoid leaning back.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单臂三头肌下压(正握)
entries.nameEn: cable standing one arm triceps pushdown (overhand grip)
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm pushdown with an overhand grip. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with an overhand grip and tuck your elbow to your side.
Push down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let the handle rise slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿内侧二头弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A standing dumbbell curl with the elbows turned slightly out to emphasise the inner head of the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, elbows slightly out from your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower them slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿背阔肌下压(绳索把手)
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. It isolates the lats with almost no help from the arms.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿交替垂直前平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing alternate vertical front raises
entries.descriptionEn: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you with a neutral grip. It works the front shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing in.
Raise one dumbbell straight up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your body.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated one arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press with one dumbbell. Working one arm at a time shows any imbalances.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat on a seated lever machine with a supported torso. It loads the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Push through your feet to extend your legs.
Lower slowly until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜交替锤式弯举
entries.descriptionEn: Hammer curls on an incline bench, one arm at a time. The stretched position makes the biceps and brachialis work hard.
instructionsEn: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: A back extension holding a plate at your chest. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆单臂坐姿划船(坐姿划船机)
entries.nameEn: lever one arm seated row (seated row machine)
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm row on a seated machine. It lets you load one side of the back at a time.
instructionsEn: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂划船(架子支撑)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row with your free hand braced on a rack for support. It lets you pull heavy while keeping your back steady.
instructionsEn: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded machine row. The guided path lets you pull heavy with good back engagement.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable row using a bent bar. The angled bar suits many wrists while you train the back.
instructionsEn: Sit at a low cable station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the bent bar with both hands.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly without rounding forward.

entries.descriptionEn: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch on a bosu ball. The unstable surface asks more from your core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the bosu ball and lie back so it supports your lower back.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up by contracting your abs.
Hold the top briefly.
Lower slowly and keep your feet planted.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying core drill where arms and legs reach out while your back stays down. It trains core control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: Small alternating leg kicks while lying down. They fire up the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising your legs from the floor and holding them up. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating a medicine ball from side to side while seated. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
