entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your forearms on the floor instead of your hands. It is tough on the triceps and the core.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在地面上，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the ground and elbows directly below your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: From a crab position you twist and reach one hand to the opposite foot. It works the abs and obliques and gets the shoulders moving.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在身后，手指指向脚部，并将臀部抬离地面。
将一条腿伸直到您面前，同时将另一只手伸向脚趾。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by sitting on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet, and lift your hips off the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you while simultaneously reaching your opposite hand towards your toes.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An easier side plank with the bottom knee bent, building oblique and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and shoulders in a line.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A classic side plank that trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: You walk your hands out from standing into a plank and walk them back. It warms up the hamstrings, shoulders and core in one go.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
暂停片刻，然后将双手移回双脚，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
一旦你的手到达你的脚，站回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Pause for a moment, then walk your hands back towards your feet, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Once your hands reach your feet, stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight jump forward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and glutes.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
向后摆动手臂以获得动力。
爆发性地向前跳跃，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight jump backward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and trains control.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向后跳跃，用双脚蹬地。
脚掌轻轻着地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat on a single leg that challenges strength and balance. It targets the glutes and quads on one side at a time.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
向前伸出一条腿，使其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where your feet jump in and out like a jumping jack, combining core stability with cardio.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together.
Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising.
Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.

entries.descriptionEn: A lever machine chest press with an inclined path, version 2. It builds the upper chest, front delts and triceps.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机上的座椅高度和靠背角度调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并远离身体，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁定肘部。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部并将手柄放回胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and backrest angle on the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended, but without locking your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle yoga backbend that opens the chest and stretches the front of the abs while strengthening the back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Press the tops of your feet into the floor.
Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.

entries.nameZh: 蝗虫式瑜伽姿势(钢铁人式)
entries.descriptionEn: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up on handles that lets you go a little deeper and keeps the wrists neutral. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

entries.descriptionEn: An inverted yoga pose balanced on the shoulders. It builds shoulder and core control and stretches the neck-side muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands.
Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades.
Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders.
Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple stretch that opens the front of the shoulders and chest by clasping the hands behind you.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat where your knees travel far forward as you lean back. It isolates the quads with only your body weight.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并向后倾斜，慢慢降低身体，保持躯干直立。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能舒适地下降。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly lower your body by bending your knees and leaning back, keeping your torso upright.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise with your heels hanging off a stair step for extra range. It trains the calves through a deep stretch.
instructionsZh: 站在台阶或坚固平台的边缘，脚后跟悬垂，脚趾放在台阶上。
如果需要，抓住栏杆或墙壁以保持平衡。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧脊柱扭转瑜伽姿势
entries.descriptionEn: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the back of the upper arm, taken with the elbow bent overhead.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep yoga backbend with hands and feet on the floor and the body arched upward. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.
Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel.
Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
弯曲膝盖，将脚底并拢，让膝盖向两侧倾斜。
用手抓住脚踝或脚。
坐直并拉长脊柱。
轻轻地将膝盖压向地板，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
要放松，请慢慢抬起膝盖并伸展双腿。
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands.
Sit up tall and lengthen your spine.
Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An oblique crunch where you curl up and to the side, version 2. It trains the side abs.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the ground, rotating your torso to one side.
Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging a sledgehammer down onto a tire in a controlled arc. It trains the abs and obliques and also the shoulders and grip.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住大锤。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
使用核心和上半身的力量，将大锤向下挥向地面。
当你向下挥杆时，转动臀部并将力量传递到锤子上。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the sledge hammer with both hands.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Swing the sledge hammer down towards the ground, using your core and upper body strength.
As you swing down, pivot your hips and transfer the force to the hammer.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with bands that lighten the load at the bottom and add heavier tension near the top. It builds pressing strength.
instructionsEn: Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change.
Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.

entries.descriptionEn: A decline sit-up with a band adding resistance. It trains the abs through a long range.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band behind you and hold the other end at your chest.
Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Curl your torso up toward your knees, keeping tension on the band.
Pause at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down slowly under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A band-resisted overhead press from behind the neck. It trains the shoulders and triceps with rising tension.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends at the back of your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your head forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level.
Only use this variation if your shoulders move comfortably in that position.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带直立划船(踩于双脚下)
entries.descriptionEn: An upright row where the band is held under both feet. It builds the shoulders and upper traps.
instructionsEn: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading.
Pause briefly without shrugging too high.
Lower slowly back down.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带侧平板支撑划船(与搭档)
entries.nameEn: band side plank row with partner
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a rowing motion against a band held by a partner. It trains the lats and trunk stability.
instructionsEn: Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you.
Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted.
Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Return slowly without letting your hips drop.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A band version of the triceps pushdown that isolates the back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Pause and squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple band move pulling the arms apart in front of you. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders and helps posture.
instructionsEn: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying triceps extension using a band for resistance. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind your head and lie on your back holding the ends.
Start with your arms straight above your chest.
Bend only your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up against the band.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise using a band for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
instructionsEn: Secure the band under your feet or around your shoulders as set up.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly until your heels are back on the floor.

entries.nameEn: band ez barbell close grip curl
entries.descriptionEn: A close-grip curl on an EZ bar with a band adding tension near the top. It targets the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the EZ bar with a close grip, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing hip flexion with a band around the foot or leg. It trains the hip flexors and quads.
instructionsEn: Attach a band to a low anchor and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the knee forward and up toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A band lateral raise that builds the sides of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to your sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell squat to a bench with chains adding load as you stand. It builds leg and hip strength and teaches consistent depth.
instructionsEn: Set a bench behind you and load the bar with chains.
Place the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand, feeling the chains add weight.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge where the back leg steps behind and across the line of the front leg. It trains glutes, thighs and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the back of the thigh. You reach toward your toes with a long spine and feel the hamstrings lengthen.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，将重心转移到右腿上。
保持背部挺直，臀部慢慢向前弯曲，双手伸向右脚。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and shift your weight onto your right leg.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the hips, reaching towards your right foot with both hands.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.nameZh: 四点跪姿股四头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.
instructionsZh: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将一条腿向后伸直，保持膝盖弯曲和脚弯曲。
慢慢地将臀部降低到地面，感觉股四头肌的伸展。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并在另一侧重复拉伸。
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Extend one leg straight back, keeping your knee bent and your foot flexed.
Slowly lower your hips towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your quads.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with a band across your shoulders. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders.
Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

entries.descriptionEn: A short-range squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. It lets you handle heavier loads and builds leg strength.
instructionsEn: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your knees and hips a short way, about a quarter of the full depth.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift performed with a clean-style setup and path. It trains the pulling position used in the clean.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended.
Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.

entries.descriptionEn: A clean started from blocks at about knee height. It trains the explosive pull and the catch without the first pull from the floor.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a full squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: The explosive pull of a clean, finished with a shrug and without the catch. It builds power and bar speed.
instructionsEn: Set up over the bar with a flat back and a grip just outside your knees.
Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug.
Let your elbows rise high, but do not catch the bar.
Lower the bar with control and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with the back foot on a decline bench and a barbell on your back. It builds single-leg strength.
instructionsEn: Place the bar on your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a decline bench.
Step the front foot out to set a stable stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机早安式(从销钉位)
entries.descriptionEn: A good morning on the Smith machine starting from the pins. It builds the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it.
Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.

entries.descriptionEn: A clean that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive hip drive and the catch.
instructionsEn: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a grip just outside your legs and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.nameEn: barbell hang clean below the knees
entries.descriptionEn: A hang clean started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar just below your knees with a flat back and your shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive pull and catching the bar overhead.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a wide snatch grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.nameEn: barbell hang snatch below the knees
entries.descriptionEn: A hang snatch started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar just below your knees with a wide grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch drill where you dip, drive and drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds speed and overhead stability.
instructionsEn: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip and drive up explosively, pushing the bar off your shoulders.
Drop quickly into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms over your mid-foot.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.

entries.descriptionEn: The dip and drive part of the jerk, practised with a barbell on the shoulders. It trains a vertical dip and strong leg drive.
instructionsEn: Rack the bar on your front shoulders and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and your core tight.
Dip a short way by bending your knees straight down.
Drive up explosively through your whole foot.
Settle back to standing and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch lifted overhead with straight arms and no re-bend of the knees. It trains the upper pull and arm turnover.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar at the hips with a wide grip, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull the bar up high with your elbows, turn it over and press to locked arms overhead without squatting.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep, upright high-bar squat in the weightlifting style. It builds leg strength and mobility.
instructionsEn: Place the bar high on your upper back and set your feet about shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit straight down as deep as you can with heels flat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A clean caught above parallel, started from blocks. It builds explosive power.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull and catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a quarter squat.
instructionsEn: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and punch the bar overhead.
Dip under slightly and catch it with locked arms.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch caught overhead above parallel. It builds explosive power and speed.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar at your shins with a wide grip, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A power snatch started from blocks. It trains the explosive pull and the overhead catch.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃罗马尼亚硬拉(垫高站立)
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift standing on a small platform for extra range. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low platform holding the bar at your thighs.
Keep your knees soft and your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower as far as you can with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: The full snatch, lifting the bar from the floor to overhead in one motion and catching it in a deep squat.
instructionsEn: Grip the bar wide, with it over your mid-foot, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A drill where you drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds overhead stability and speed.
instructionsEn: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip a short way and drive up.
Drop into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms and your chest up.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with a wide snatch grip. It strengthens the pulling position used in the snatch.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip.
Set your back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close.
Stand tall with your hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar with control along the same path.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch started from blocks. It trains the pull and the deep overhead catch.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A clean caught in a split stance instead of a squat. It trains the explosive pull and the catch.
instructionsEn: Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Split your feet front and back and catch the bar on your front shoulders.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a split stance.
instructionsEn: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back and catch with locked arms.
Bring your feet back together and lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump with a barbell on the back where you switch the front and back leg in the air. It builds leg power.
instructionsEn: Rest a light bar on your upper back and take a split stance.
Lower into a shallow lunge.
Jump explosively and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
Keep your torso upright and continue alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together in one fluid rep.
instructionsEn: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly forward and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lock out the press with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Keep your core braced the whole time and avoid arching your lower back.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃深蹲至直立划船(大腿位)
entries.descriptionEn: Squat down with the bar hanging in front of you, then stand and pull it up to chest height. Works thighs, glutes and upper back in one move.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and squat down, letting the bar slide down to your knees.
Drive up through your heels to stand tall.
As you rise, pull the bar up close to your body until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar under control and go straight into the next squat.

entries.nameEn: barbell stiff leg deadlift on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-legged deadlift performed while standing on a bench, giving you extra range of motion. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a barbell at thigh level, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees almost straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar toward your toes with a flat back as far as your hamstrings allow.
Pause briefly, then squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
Keep the bar close to your legs and stay in control throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic stiff-legged deadlift, hinging at the hips with nearly straight knees. A great builder for hamstrings, glutes and the lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your back flat and your chest proud the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

entries.nameEn: barbell wide stance stiff leg deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-legged deadlift with a wide stance that brings in the inner thighs and glutes. It also keeps the hamstrings under a deep stretch.
instructionsEn: Take a wide stance, toes slightly out, with the barbell held in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs.
Squeeze your glutes to rise back to standing.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with the bar held in the crooks of your elbows at full depth. It hits the quads, glutes and upper back.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
将杠铃放在肘部的弯曲处，双手握住杠铃以保持稳定。
当你将臀部向后降低到蹲姿时，启动你的核心并保持胸部抬起。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚跟发力站起来，在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell in the crooks of your elbows, with your hands gripping the barbell for stability.
Engage your core and keep your chest lifted as you lower your hips back and down into a squat position.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with your back against a wall, which keeps your torso upright and takes pressure off the lower back. Good for building leg endurance.
instructionsEn: Lean your back against a wall with your feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the planned number of reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing on one leg, you curl the other against a low cable. It isolates the hamstrings one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine and hold on for balance, with the working leg slightly behind you.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Using a chair for support, you extend one leg to stretch the thigh and hip. It loosens up the quads.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受股四头肌的拉伸。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your quadriceps.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with the other foot resting on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells. It hammers the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand a step in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg.
Keep your front knee over your toes and your chest up.
Push through your front heel to stand, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A rear-foot-elevated lunge using a decline bench and dumbbells. The raised back foot shifts the load onto the front leg.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a decline bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front foot to rise, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive squat jump holding light dumbbells at your sides. It builds power in the legs and gets the heart pumping.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃侧弓步蹲加二头弯举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell lateral lunge with bicep curl
entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge combined with a biceps curl. It works the legs and arms together and also loosens the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a big step to the side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Curl both dumbbells up as you lower into the lunge.
Push off your bent leg to return to the middle while lowering the weights.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping lunge where you switch legs in the air while holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a lunge position.
Lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Explode upward and swap your leg positions in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Keep your torso upright and move fluidly from rep to rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple squat holding a dumbbell in each hand. It is a solid all-round leg builder that is easy to load.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor or a bit lower.
Keep your chest up and your heels planted.
Press through your feet to stand back up.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-legged deadlift with dumbbells while standing on a bench for extra depth. It targets the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells down your legs and below the bench level with a flat back.
Pause when you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunges done on the move with dumbbells in your hands. A great move for leg strength, glutes and coordination.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push off your back foot and step through into a lunge with the other leg.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A wall squat made harder by holding dumbbells. It keeps your back supported while loading the legs.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean your back against a wall.
Walk your feet forward so your knees stay over your ankles when you squat.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.

entries.descriptionEn: You kneel with a stability ball for support and push the hips forward. It stretches the hip flexors at the front of the hip.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上并跪在其前面。
将右脚放在稳定球上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
身体前倾，将臀部推向稳定球，直到感觉到右髋屈肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
instructionsEn: Place the stability ball on the ground and kneel in front of it.
Place your right foot on top of the stability ball, with your knee bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Lean forward, pushing your hips towards the stability ball, until you feel a stretch in your right hip flexor.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
慢慢地向前滚动球，双脚向外走，直到上背部靠在球上，双腿在身前伸直。
将双手放在臀部上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将上半身降低到地面，保持背部挺直，胸部抬起。
当您感觉到腿筋拉伸时停止，并保持该姿势 20-30 秒。
通过推动脚后跟并使用腿筋将自己拉回来，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly roll the ball forward, walking your feet out until your upper back is resting on the ball and your legs are extended straight in front of you.
Place your hands on your hips for support.
Engage your core and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your chest lifted.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, and hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your heels and using your hamstrings to pull yourself back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球坐姿股四头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle quad stretch using a stability ball for support. It opens up the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a stability ball with your torso upright.
Hold on to something steady for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glutes, holding your ankle.
Keep your knees close together and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball keeps the movement smooth and supports your back.
instructionsEn: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet forward about a step and stand shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and let the ball roll down your back as you squat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 中级髋屈肌与股四头肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: intermediate hip flexor and quad stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A deeper stretch for the hip flexors and quads, using a rope or strap to pull the foot toward you.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
抓住一个稳定的物体作为支撑。
弯曲右膝，将右脚移向臀部，用右手抓住绳子。
慢慢地将右脚拉向臀部，感受右股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在左侧重复。
instructionsEn: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Bend your right knee and bring your right foot towards your glutes, grabbing the rope with your right hand.
Slowly pull your right foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in your right quad.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the left side.

entries.descriptionEn: A clean that starts from a dead stop on the floor each rep, with no swing. It builds explosive hip drive and pulling power.
instructionsEn: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grab the handle.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the handle and catch the bell at your shoulder.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset before the next rep.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃单臂过头深蹲(大腿位)
entries.descriptionEn: A squat while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm. It trains leg strength together with shoulder stability and core control.
instructionsEn: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock out your elbow.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and keep your ribs down.
Squat down with your chest up while keeping the bell stable over your shoulder.
Go as low as you can with good control.
Drive up through your heels, then switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell clean where your palm stays open and you catch the bell on your forearm. It teaches a smooth hip-driven pull.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge down and grab the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to pull it up.
Keep your hand open and guide the bell to rest at your shoulder.
Lower it back with control and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-armed kettlebell swing driven by the hips. It builds the posterior chain and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and hold a kettlebell with one hand.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to chest height.
Keep your arm relaxed and your back flat.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, then switch hands after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hip hinge holding a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the bell toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return upright, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine leg extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and helps even out strength between sides.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and adjust the pad so it rests on your lower shin.
Set one foot under the pad and keep the other foot on the floor or footrest.
Extend your working leg until it is almost straight.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿单腿宽距深蹲
entries.nameEn: lever seated one leg wide squat
entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine squat using one leg in a wide stance. It loads the quads, glutes and inner thighs with back support.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot wide on the platform and keep the other leg off the load.
Lower by bending your working knee as far as is comfortable.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine squat done on one leg. It lets you load each leg separately with good support.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot on the platform at about shoulder width.
Lower under control by bending your knee.
Keep your heel flat and your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine squat with a wide stance. It puts extra emphasis on the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Set both feet wide on the platform with toes slightly out.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together. The narrow stance puts the focus on the quads.
instructionsEn: Sit in the sled with your back flat against the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.
Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with one leg raised, you draw it toward you to stretch the hamstring.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将其靠近胸部，握住大腿或小腿。
尽可能伸直腿，同时保持腿抬高。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring it towards your chest, holding onto your thigh or shin.
Straighten your leg as much as possible while keeping it elevated.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat with the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying stretch that opens the front of the hip. Handy after long periods of sitting.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the knee relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A hack squat on the sled using one leg at a time. It isolates each quad and glute with solid back support.
instructionsEn: Position yourself in the hack squat sled with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off.
Release the safety and lower by bending your working knee.
Go as deep as you can with control.
Press up through your heel, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.

entries.nameEn: reclining big toe pose with rope
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you hold your big toe with a rope and raise the leg straight. It stretches the hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将绳子绕在右脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
慢慢地将右腿抬向胸部，保持膝盖伸直，脚弯曲。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Loop the rope around the ball of your right foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Slowly raise your right leg towards your chest, keeping your knee straight and your foot flexed.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A hack squat done facing the pad on the sled. It puts more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Face the pad of the hack squat sled with your chest against it and feet on the platform.
Hold the handles and release the safety.
Lower by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest pressed against the pad.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat followed by a big vertical jump with your arms reaching up. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while swinging your arms back.
Explode upward and reach both arms overhead as you jump.
Extend your whole body like a rocket.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge position stretch for the hips, thighs and hamstrings, often used by runners to loosen up.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，降低身体，保持左腿伸直。
将双手放在右大腿上以获得支撑。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down, keeping your left leg straight.
Place your hands on your right thigh for support.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hamstring curl on a machine with one leg at a time. It isolates each hamstring.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and adjust the leg pad above your heel.
Place one leg under the pad and rest the other foot on the footrest.
Curl your heel down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstring at the bottom.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated sequence with legs wide that stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings. Move slowly with the breath.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿大角度伸展。
弯曲你的脚并锻炼你的股四头肌。
将双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
保持背部挺直，从臀部向前倾。
继续向前倾斜，直到感觉到腿筋被拉伸。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
慢慢释放拉伸并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in a wide angle.
Flex your feet and engage your quadriceps.
Place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Keeping your back straight, lean forward from your hips.
Continue leaning forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
Slowly release the stretch and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A hopping drill where you flick one heel up to your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted.
Hop lightly on your standing foot.
Kick your free heel toward your glutes each hop.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying hamstring curl on a machine using one leg at a time. It helps balance strength between legs.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on the machine and place one leg under the pad above your heel.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive single-leg push off the floor or a step. It builds leg drive useful for running and jumping.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a low step with one foot planted on it.
Lean slightly forward and keep your core tight.
Push off the step explosively with that leg and drive your opposite knee up.
Land softly on the same foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A bounding jump from one leg to the other leg. It develops power and single-leg control.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap forward as far as you can.
Land on the opposite leg and absorb the impact with a soft knee.
Hold the landing for a moment to stay balanced.
Repeat, alternating legs or staying on one side.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat down to a seat and back up. The chair gives you a depth target and builds confidence.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a chair or bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower yourself toward the seat.
Lightly touch the seat without relaxing completely.
Keep your chest up and your knees over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机弗兰肯斯坦深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A front-loaded squat on the smith machine with your arms stretched straight in front. It strongly challenges the quads and upper back posture.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your front shoulders.
Extend your arms straight forward, like a zombie, to keep the bar in place.
Unrack the bar and step into a stable stance.
Squat down with your chest up and your torso upright.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.

entries.descriptionEn: A smith machine squat down to a bench behind you. The bench gives a consistent depth target.
instructionsEn: Place a bench behind you under the smith bar.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.

entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-legged deadlift using the smith machine bar. The fixed path lets you focus on feeling the hamstrings work.
instructionsEn: Stand close to the smith bar with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand.
Unrack it and keep your knees nearly straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding the bar in the crooks of your elbows on the smith machine. It trains the legs while taxing the core and upper back.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at waist height and hook your elbows under it with your arms crossed.
Unrack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest up and the bar close to your body.
Go until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.

entries.nameZh: 站姿腘绳肌与小腿拉伸(用拉伸带)
entries.nameEn: standing hamstring and calf stretch with strap
entries.descriptionEn: Standing with a strap around your foot, you pull your toes toward you to stretch the hamstring and calf.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手握住带子并将其放在脚掌周围。
保持腿伸直，从臀部慢慢向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
感受腿筋和小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
放松拉伸并用另一条腿重复。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the strap with both hands and place it around the ball of your foot.
Keep your leg straight and slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your hamstring and calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat with the other leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump for distance from a standing start. It builds explosive power in the hips and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart at a clear starting line.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Swing your arms forward and jump as far as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿直腿腘绳肌收缩放松(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: standing straight leg hamstring contract relax on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring stretch with the heel on a stability ball, using a contract and relax method. It helps you ease deeper into the stretch.
instructionsEn: Stand and rest one heel on a stability ball in front of you with your knee straight.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Gently press your heel into the ball for about 5 seconds, then relax.
Lean a little deeper into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-up performed side-on to the bench. It works the glutes and quads while challenging your balance.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways next to a bench or step.
Place the inside foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel and step up until your leg is straight.
Bring your other foot up to meet it.
Step back down with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A wall squat with a stability ball behind you while holding extra weight. It adds load to a back-supported squat.
instructionsEn: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Hold your weight at chest level or at your sides.
Step your feet forward and squat as the ball rolls down your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing lunge with a twist and reach that opens the hips, hamstrings and upper back. A favorite warm-up move.
instructionsZh: 从弓步位置开始，右脚向前，左脚向后。
将双手放在右脚两侧的地面上。
将左膝降低到地面并伸展右腿，保持右脚平放在地面上。
向右旋转你的躯干，将你的右臂伸向天花板。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
换边并重复拉伸，左脚向前。
instructionsEn: Start in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your hands on the ground on either side of your right foot.
Lower your left knee to the ground and extend your right leg, keeping your right foot flat on the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, reaching your right arm up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Switch sides and repeat the stretch with your left foot forward.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable pushdown using an SZ bar, a staple for building the back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel.

entries.nameZh: 绳索反握三头肌下压(曲杆)
entries.nameEn: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz bar)
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps pushdown with an underhand grip on an SZ bar. The reverse grip shifts the feel slightly and works the forearms too.
instructionsEn: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it palms up with hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly without letting your elbows drift forward.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable curl with an SZ bar. The cable keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it with an underhand grip.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging your body.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿反握弯举(曲杆)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a cable SZ bar. It targets the brachialis and forearms.
instructionsEn: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up while keeping your wrists straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂侧向三头肌下压
entries.nameEn: cable one arm side triceps pushdown
entries.descriptionEn: A one-armed cable pushdown done from the side. It isolates each triceps and lets you focus on form.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with the arm closest to the stack and keep your elbow at your side.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm exercise where you hold the bar behind your back and roll it down to your fingertips. It builds grip and forearm strength.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers closed and lift the bar back into your palms.
Curl your wrists up a little at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding a dumbbell behind your back, you roll it down to your fingertips and curl it back up. It builds finger and forearm flexor strength and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a light dumbbell held in one hand behind your back.
Let the dumbbell roll down until it rests on your fingertips.
Close your fingers and curl the weight back into your palm.
Keep your wrist still and your arm close to your body.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone floor move where opposite arm and leg lift in alternation, training the back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Lift your chest slightly and brace your glutes.
Raise one arm and the opposite leg a few inches.
Switch sides in a controlled flutter.
Keep your neck neutral and breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: A preacher curl on a lever machine, version 2. The pad locks your upper arms in place so the biceps do the work.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气，同时将手柄向肩膀卷曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against the support.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the handles towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆锤式握牧师凳弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A preacher curl on a lever machine with a neutral hammer grip. It hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
将你的上臂放在讲道垫上，确保你的胸部压在上面。
用锤子握把抓住手柄（手掌相对）。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Place your upper arms on the preacher pad, ensuring your chest is pressed against it.
Grasp the handles with a hammer grip (palms facing each other).
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A preacher curl on a lever machine with an overhand grip. It shifts work to the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师垫上，确保肘部完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展肘部。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on the preacher pad, ensuring your elbows are fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃下斜单臂锤式推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell decline one arm hammer press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm press on a decline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the triceps and the lower chest.
instructionsZh: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将手臂伸直向上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your chest.
Extend your arm straight up, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell down towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Press the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜锤式推举(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline hammer press on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A neutral-grip press on an incline bench set on an exercise ball. The ball adds an unstable challenge for the triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
双脚向前走，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，保持手掌相对。
充分伸展双臂，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down the ball until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows bent and pointing out to the sides.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly inward, keeping your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms fully, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜单臂锤式推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline one arm hammer press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm neutral-grip press on an incline bench. It trains the triceps and upper chest on one side at a time.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩膀高度。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝内，朝向身体。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh.
Lean back on the bench and use your thigh to help raise the dumbbell to shoulder height.
Rotate your wrist so that your palm is facing inward, towards your body.
Press the dumbbell up and away from your body, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜单臂锤式推举(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline one arm hammer press on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm hammer press on an incline with an exercise ball. It works the triceps and adds a balance challenge.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手掌朝内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将哑铃向上推向天花板，伸直手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbell with your palm facing inward and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Press the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, straightening your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂锤式推举(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm hammer press on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm neutral-grip press while lying on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps while the core keeps you stable.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，掌心向内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing inwards and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your other hand on your hip for stability.
Press the dumbbell upwards, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm reverse grip press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm dumbbell press with your palm facing you. It shifts focus to the upper chest and biceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将双脚平放在地面上，并保持背部挺直。
将哑铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing towards your body.
Place your feet flat on the ground and keep your back straight.
Raise the dumbbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Press the dumbbell upwards until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃掌心向内上斜卧推
entries.nameEn: dumbbell palms in incline bench press
entries.descriptionEn: An incline bench press with palms facing in. It trains the triceps and the front delts with a shoulder-friendly grip.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃慢慢向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells slowly towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with a reverse grip using dumbbells. It targets the upper chest and the triceps.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握住，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸直向上伸向天花板，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部，让肘部向两侧张开。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing towards your feet.
Extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your chest, allowing your elbows to flare out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机下斜窄握卧推
entries.nameEn: smith machine decline close grip bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A close grip bench press on a decline bench in the smith machine. It builds the triceps and lower chest.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the bench on the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机反向下斜窄握卧推
entries.nameEn: smith machine reverse decline close grip bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse grip, close grip decline bench press in the smith machine. It works the chest and triceps.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
