instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm dumbbell triceps extension lying down. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂完全伸展到胸部上方。
以受控的方式将哑铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部短暂暂停，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your arm fully extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell in a controlled manner towards your forehead, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂法式推举(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm french press on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm French press on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps and tests balance.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部不动。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow stationary.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿俯身三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated bent over triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: Bent-over dumbbell extension that isolates the triceps while you sit and hinge forward. Great for building the back of the upper arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部抬起。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近头部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿反握单臂过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead extension done seated with an underhand grip on the dumbbell. It works the triceps through a long, stretched range.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿交替三头肌后踢
entries.descriptionEn: Standing kickbacks done one arm at a time with a hinged torso. Trains the triceps with a strong squeeze at full extension.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，每次重复时交替进行。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides with each repetition.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿俯身单臂三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing bent over one arm triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm triceps extension performed bent over with the upper arm pinned to your side. Builds triceps strength and control.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend your arm straight back, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿俯身双臂三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing bent over two arm triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: Both arms extend dumbbells backward at once from a hinged position. A simple way to load the triceps from the back of the arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃三头肌后踢(鹤立式站姿)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell tricep kickback with stork stance
entries.descriptionEn: A triceps kickback done in a stork stance, balancing on one leg. Adds a balance challenge to the usual triceps isolation.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将右肘举至身体一侧，保持弯曲 90 度角。
将右臂向后伸直，挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in your right hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your right elbow up to your side, keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your right arm straight back, squeezing your triceps.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell bench press with a wrist twist through the rep. Works chest and triceps while adding a rotating element.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌背向自己。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
放下哑铃时，扭转手腕，使手掌在动作底部面向自己。
在底部暂停片刻，然后通过将哑铃推回到起始位置来反转动作。
当你向上推哑铃时，将手腕扭转回起始位置，手掌背向自己。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face towards you at the bottom of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then reverse the movement by pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
As you press the dumbbells up, twist your wrists back to the starting position with palms facing away from you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight dip using a stability ball as the support. The unstable surface makes your triceps and shoulders work harder to stay steady.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在臀部旁边的球上，手指指向前方。
启动你的三头肌并用力推动你的身体，将你的身体抬离球，伸直你的手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低，使其靠近身体两侧。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the ball beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your triceps and push through your hands to lift your body off the ball, straightening your arms.
Lower your body back down by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球坐姿三头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, done on a stability ball. Helps loosen tight triceps and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶上方。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up above your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm close to your ear.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球仰卧三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell triceps extension done on an exercise ball, lowering the weight behind your head. Targets the triceps and challenges your balance.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直向天花板方向伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: ez bar french press on exercise ball
entries.descriptionEn: A french press with an EZ bar while seated on an exercise ball. Builds triceps strength and asks your core to keep you stable.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，正手握住 EZ 杠铃。
向上伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on an exercise ball and hold an EZ barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: EZ杠仰卧窄握脑后三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: ez bar lying close grip triceps extension behind head
entries.descriptionEn: A lying close-grip extension with an EZ bar, lowering the bar behind your head. Puts strong focus on the long head of the triceps.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
紧紧握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the ez barbell with a close grip, palms facing up, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead EZ bar extension, bending only at the elbows. Builds triceps size and strength.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive chest throw with a medicine ball while lying on your back. Develops fast pressing power in the triceps and chest.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住药球，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将健身球降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
爆发性地将药球向上推，充分伸展双臂并将球扔得尽可能高。
接住药球并重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands, extending your arms straight up above your chest.
Lower the medicine ball towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Explosively push the medicine ball upwards, extending your arms fully and throwing the ball as high as possible.
Catch the medicine ball and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell press from pins set in a rack, starting from a dead stop. Builds pressing strength through the triceps and chest.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃放在与胸部同高的力量架上。
面向杠铃站立，将自己置于杠铃下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up a barbell on a power rack at chest height.
Stand facing the barbell and position yourself underneath it, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest, with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机上斜三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: An incline smith machine extension that lowers the bar toward your forehead. Guided path lets you focus on the triceps.
instructionsZh: 调整史密斯机的座椅，使杠铃处于肩部高度。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到前额，保持肘部靠近头部。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
Lower the bar slowly towards your forehead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench dip with hands on the bench edge and body hanging off the front. A classic bodyweight move for the triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench dip with extra weight added for more resistance. Builds triceps and front shoulder strength once bodyweight gets easy.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，并用手臂支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench and supporting your weight with your arms.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted dip off a bench or chair with legs extended. Loads the triceps harder than the bodyweight version.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将你的屁股从长凳前面滑下来，双腿在你面前伸展。
保持背部靠近长凳，肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your butt off the front of the bench with your legs extended in front of you.
Keep your back close to the bench and your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip hinge holding a barbell. Trains the glutes and hamstrings while challenging balance and core stability.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，正手握住杠铃在大腿前面。
将重心转移到左脚上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，右腿向后伸展以保持平衡。
将杠铃向地面降低，使其靠近身体，左腿稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance.
Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body and your left leg slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip hinge holding a dumbbell. Works the glutes and hamstrings and improves balance.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将体重转移到左腿上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
保持背部挺直，臀部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
同时，将右腿伸直在身后，保持左膝轻微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到躯干和右腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后收紧臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up with your feet held down by a partner or anchor. Trains the abs through a full curling motion.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘或让某人按住你的脚。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench or have someone hold your feet down.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep single-leg squat with the other leg held out in front. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右脚抬离地面并向前伸展。
弯曲左膝并将臀部向后推，慢慢降低身体。
降低身体时，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低直到左大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down.
Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Trains the quads and glutes while keeping your torso upright.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住哑铃垂直放在胸前。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging knee raise with a twist to each side. Targets the obliques and abs, and challenges your grip.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, twisting your torso to the side as you do so.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A pistol squat where you hold onto a support to help with balance. It builds single-leg strength and control on the way to an unassisted pistol.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with hands about shoulder-width apart. Builds the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructionsZh: 握距与肩同宽，抓住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
双臂完全伸展，自由悬挂。
启动背部肌肉，将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging raise where you lift your legs and curl your hips up. Strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，收紧核心并抬起双腿，直到大腿与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃直立划船(背面视角)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing upright row with dumbbells, pulling the weights up toward your chin. Trains the shoulders and traps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展，手掌面向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
继续举起哑铃，直到哑铃与肩同高，肘部指向两侧。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended and your palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Continue lifting until the dumbbells are at shoulder height, with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight leg curl on a lying leg curl station. Works the hamstrings with a controlled curl and slow lowering.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在腿弯举机上，双腿伸展，脚踝钩在带衬垫的杠杆下。
将双手放在机器的侧手柄上以获得支撑。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a leg curl machine with your legs extended and your ankles hooked under the padded lever.
Place your hands on the side handles of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 高双杠负重三头肌臂屈伸
entries.nameEn: weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
entries.descriptionEn: A dip between two high parallel bars with extra weight attached. Builds triceps, chest and shoulder strength.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双手握住杠，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your hands gripping the bars and your arms fully extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight curl performed while lying on your side. A gentle way to train the biceps without equipment.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
将上臂靠在身体两侧，弯曲肘部，将前臂卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Isolates the biceps and cuts out swinging.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling bodyweight triceps press with elbows kept tight to your sides. Builds triceps strength without equipment.
instructionsZh: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Kneel down on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs straight behind you, balancing on your toes and hands, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor push-up variation that lifts the upper body with elbows close to your sides. Works the upper back and posture muscles.
instructionsZh: 首先，脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸展，双手直接放在肩膀下方。
收紧核心并用手掌按压，将上半身抬离地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压上背部肌肉。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by lying face down on the ground with your legs extended and your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and press through your palms to lift your upper body off the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause at the top for a moment, squeezing your upper back muscles.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row using a towel while hinged forward. Trains the upper back and builds grip strength.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
完全伸展手臂，让毛巾挂在您面前。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arm fully, allowing the towel to hang in front of you.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A side bridge with a top leg lift. Works the outer hips and glutes plus the core.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持核心肌群参与的同时，尽可能高地抬起上面的那条腿，但不要旋转臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后将腿放下。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a top leg raise. Challenges the inner and outer thighs while keeping the core braced.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将上面的腿抬向天花板，保持笔直。
慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: lying single straight leg hip extension
entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift one straight leg off the floor. It strengthens your glutes and hamstrings with a gentle load on the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Tighten your abs and glutes.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching both arms overhead and back opens the front of your chest and shoulders. It is an easy stretch to undo hunched posture.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A partner draws your arms back while you stand, opening up your chest. It is a deeper stretch than you can usually reach alone.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated with a partner pulling your arms back, you stretch your chest and the front of your shoulders. Sitting keeps your trunk stable.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing a bent arm against a wall or frame stretches the chest and front shoulder. Changing the arm height shifts which part you feel.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Using a wall corner to lean into, you stretch both sides of the chest at once. The corner lets you control the depth easily.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them stretches the chest and front of the shoulders. It is a classic posture reset.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 站姿胸部拉伸(用训练肋木)
entries.nameEn: standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a wall bar and turning away from it stretches your chest and shoulder. The bars let you pick the exact height that suits you.
instructionsEn: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 辅助向后拉背部胸部拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A partner pulls your arms backward to deepen the chest stretch. It works well when you want more range than you get alone.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling with your arms reaching forward onto a support lets your chest sink down. It stretches the chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 辅助躯干屈曲胸部拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: With a partner helping you lean the trunk forward, you stretch your chest and front shoulders. It gives a controlled, deeper opening.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching straight arms backward opens your chest and the front of your shoulders. Simple, quick and good between sets or after a desk session.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Straight arms overhead lengthen the chest, shoulders and sides of your back. A simple full-reach stretch.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 辅助仰卧直臂拉伸(胸部)
entries.descriptionEn: Lying down with your arms out, a partner gently presses your arms toward the floor. It stretches the chest and the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 辅助俯卧拉臂胸部拉伸
entries.nameEn: assisted pulling arms in prone position chest stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, your partner lifts your arms back to open your chest. A deep, controlled chest and shoulder stretch.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Tilting your head to the side while anchoring the opposite shoulder stretches the upper traps and the side of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Wrapping one arm across your body and hooking it with the other stretches the back of the shoulder and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling one arm across your chest stretches the rear shoulder. It is a staple warm-up and cooldown stretch.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching forward with rounded shoulders opens up the space between your shoulder blades. It helps relieve a tight upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 站姿上举背部旋转拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing reach up back rotation stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Reaching one arm up and rotating your trunk stretches the lats and the muscles around your spine. It also gives your mid back some rotation.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 双手悬挂背部拉伸(用肋木)
entries.nameEn: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
entries.descriptionEn: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.
instructionsEn: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.
instructionsEn: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿下躯干伸肌侧屈肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameEn: sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameEn: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.
instructionsEn: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameEn: extension of arms in vertical stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.
instructionsEn: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.
instructionsEn: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameEn: suspension in pulley machine in supination stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Hanging lightly from a pulley handle with palms up stretches the biceps and forearm. The pulley lets you control how much weight you load.
instructionsEn: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Resting your arms on a preacher bench while holding an EZ bar lets the arms extend fully, stretching the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameZh: 肘伸展及前臂旋后旋前拉伸
entries.nameEn: elbow extension and supination pronation forearm stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Straightening your elbow and rotating your forearm stretches the muscles on both sides of the lower arm.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.nameEn: wrist ulnar deviator and extensor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with ulnar deviation, easing tightness after gripping or typing.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: wrist radial deviator and extensor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with radial deviation.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: wrist radial deviator and flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with radial deviation.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching your hand down your upper back stretches the triceps and the back of the shoulder. A common warm-up and cooldown stretch.
instructionsEn: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning into a wall with your elbow bent overhead stretches the triceps. The wall gives a steady anchor.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm and elbow stretch for the small muscle at the back of the elbow along with the triceps. Useful after pressing or typing.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Tilting your head diagonally forward stretches the back and side of the neck. It targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Tilting your head back stretches the front of the neck. Go slowly and stay within a comfortable range.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle stretch that glides the head forward to open the back of the neck and the base of the skull.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated chin-to-chest stretch for the muscles along the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Bends the neck forward to lengthen the muscles at the back of the neck and upper shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: Lengthens the extensor muscles at the back of the neck by tucking the chin down.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Combines forward bending with a turn of the head to stretch the back and side of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Tilts the head back to stretch the muscles at the front of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the front and side of the neck by combining a head tilt back with a turn.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lets gravity help stretch the back of the neck while you lie on your back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the front of the neck by letting the head drop back from the edge of a bench or bed.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: A hand-assisted head turn that stretches the muscles at the side of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Tilts the head back and to the side to stretch the front and side of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Reverse crunch on a decline bench that curls the hips toward the chest and trains the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A static calf stretch that lengthens the lower leg muscles and the Achilles area.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple forearm stretch for the wrist flexors, helpful after gripping or typing.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: An incline press with a small leg drive that lets you move heavier loads and trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise finished with a hip lift that targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg raise with slightly bent knees, a gentler version for the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.nameEn: leg raise hip lift with head up
entries.descriptionEn: Lying leg raise finished with a hip lift while the head stays raised, working the whole abdominal wall.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Machine-based lying leg raise with bent knees that loads the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated machine crunch that works the abs through a full range, loading the crunch with plates.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.

entries.descriptionEn: Decline sit-up on a lever machine that adds resistance for stronger abdominal work.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower back slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿三头肌伸展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling cable extension that isolates the triceps by pushing the handle down from head height.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: Back extension on a bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.

entries.nameEn: cable curl with multipurpose v bar
entries.descriptionEn: Standing cable curl using a V bar, giving constant tension on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated machine press that builds the shoulders and triceps along a guided path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: Machine pulldown behind the line of the body that trains the lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A steeper decline sit-up that increases the load on the abs.
instructionsEn: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.

entries.nameZh: 双杠架锤式握引体向上
entries.nameEn: hammer grip pull up on dip cage
entries.descriptionEn: Pull-up with palms facing each other on the dip cage handles, hitting the lats and arms.
instructionsEn: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

entries.nameEn: wide grip pull up on dip cage
entries.descriptionEn: Wide-grip pull-up performed on the dip cage that emphasises the lats.
instructionsEn: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated machine move that squeezes the legs together to train the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Squeeze your legs together smoothly.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃低杠深蹲(用深蹲架)
entries.descriptionEn: Squat with the bar low on the back, taken from a rack, that works the glutes, thighs and back.
instructionsEn: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated machine move that pushes the legs outward to train the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Hold the handles for stability.
Push your legs apart smoothly.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded machine pulldown that trains the lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full stretch.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆三头肌臂屈伸(挂片式)
entries.descriptionEn: Seated plate-loaded dip machine that builds the triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆牧师凳弯举(挂片式)
entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded preacher curl that isolates the biceps with the arms supported.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded leg extension that isolates the front of the thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆交替腿屈伸(挂片式)
entries.descriptionEn: One leg at a time on a plate-loaded extension machine, evening out strength between the legs.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Hold the handles.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded squat machine that lets you load the legs with a supported back.
instructionsEn: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded machine raise that targets the side of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 站姿髋外展内收肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Standing stretch that pushes the hip out to the side to lengthen the inner thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿交叉腿外展肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Cross one leg behind the other to stretch the outer hip and thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿抬腿搭放髋部拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Rest one leg on a raised surface and lean in to stretch the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning stretch for the outer hip and thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿腿置下方外展肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Tuck one leg under the other in standing to stretch the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Floor stretch that pulls one leg across the body to open the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 健身球仰卧外展肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Lying stretch using a stability ball for support while opening the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on a bench and let one leg hang across for a gravity-assisted hip stretch.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿脚尖上翘跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the calf and Achilles by lifting the toes against a wall.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 单脚脚跟下落跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Lets one heel drop off a step to stretch the Achilles and calf.
instructionsEn: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Classic lunge-style calf stretch with the back heel kept down.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Simple standing stretch for the Achilles tendon and calf.
instructionsEn: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch where you pull the toes toward you.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 蹲姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Low crouch stretch with one heel pushed back to lengthen the Achilles.
instructionsEn: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling on the toes to stretch the feet and front of the ankles.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.

entries.nameZh: 跪姿脚跟下压跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling stretch with the heel pressed down to lengthen the Achilles.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Deep squat hold that opens the ankles and calves.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing wide-stance stretch for the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotates the hip in standing to stretch the glutes and deep hip muscles.
instructionsEn: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
