Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿抬腿髋内收肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing raised leg hip adductor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch with one leg raised on a support that opens the inner thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 站姿腿上抬内收肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Stretch for the inner thigh with one leg raised and out to the side.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling stretch with one leg extended to the side to open the inner thigh and groin.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide side lunge that stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿屈膝髋内收肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing bent knee hip adductor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Standing stretch with a bent knee that opens the inner thigh and hip.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor stretch that opens up the inner thighs while you rest face down on your forearms.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated straddle that stretches the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.

entries.nameEn: hip abduction with flexion in front stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Brings the leg forward and out to open the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side lunge position that lengthens the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: lying leaning against the wall stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Lie with your legs resting on a wall and let them fall open to stretch the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.

entries.nameEn: abduction of one leg flexion stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you open one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh and groin.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Partner-assisted stretch for the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
Keep your hips level.
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿脚尖下压腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the back of the thigh with the toes lowered.
instructionsEn: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 站姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Standing stretch with one heel on the floor and toes pulled up, lengthening the back of the thigh and calf.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rest one heel on a raised surface and lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring stretch with one leg raised onto a support, easing tension in the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 站姿高抬腿屈膝腘绳肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing high leg bent knee hamstring stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring stretch with the foot raised high and the knee slightly bent for a deeper but friendlier pull.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 跪姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling on one knee with the other leg extended and toes up to stretch the hamstring and calf.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿膝屈肌和髋内收肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated knee flexor and hip adductor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated wide leg stretch that opens the inner thighs while lengthening the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 站姿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and calves.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 站姿交叉腿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing reach down hamstring crossed legs stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward fold with the legs crossed, which shifts the stretch to the back of the rear leg.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated figure four style stretch for the buttocks and deep hip rotators.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿对侧腿从后方髋部拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated hip stretch with opposite leg from behind
entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip stretch with one leg folded in front and the other tucked behind you.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Pointing the foot downward to stretch the front of the ankle and shin.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you lift one straight leg to stretch the hamstring with the lower back supported.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸(用毛巾)
entries.nameEn: recumbent knee flexor stretch with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A lying hamstring stretch where a towel around the foot lets you pull the leg closer without strain.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A partner lifts your straight leg to deepen a relaxed hamstring stretch.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 站姿脚尖上翘小腿拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Standing with the toes lifted against a surface to stretch the calf.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 单脚脚跟下落小腿拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Dropping one heel off a step to stretch the calf through a full range.
instructionsEn: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 跖屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: plantar flexor and foot everter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the calf and the outer side of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 跖屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: plantar flexor and foot inverter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the front of the lower leg and the inner side of the ankle.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
entries.descriptionEn: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 蹲姿脚跟后踩小腿拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A deep crouch with the heels pressed back to stretch the calves and Achilles area.
instructionsEn: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: assisted lying hip stretch in supine position
entries.descriptionEn: A partner guides your bent knee toward your chest to stretch the hips and glutes while you stay relaxed.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿屈膝伸展旋转拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated knee up extended rotation stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with the raised knee and the back leg extended, giving the hip a longer stretch.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: lying cross over knee pull up stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back and drawing a crossed knee up toward the opposite shoulder to stretch the glutes and hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: lying cross over knee pull down stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back and guiding a crossed knee down across the body to stretch the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿屈膝抱胸臀部拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: seated hip stretch with slightly bent leg
entries.descriptionEn: A relaxed seated hip stretch with the front leg slightly bent, easy on the knee.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameZh: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lying stretch for the deep hip rotators and glutes, pulling the knee toward the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿脚拉向胸臀部拉伸
entries.nameEn: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Crossing one leg behind the other and leaning aside to stretch the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side lean that stretches the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A yoga-style hip opener with one shin folded in front, stretching the glutes and the hip flexors of the back leg.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor stretch for the deep hip rotators and buttock muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch drawing one knee up and in to open the hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side stretch that lengthens the outer hip and thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotation that works the hip through a twisting stretch.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing lunge-style stretch for the front of the hip and thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A partner-assisted leg movement that gently stretches the hip and thigh.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and relax.
Have a partner support one leg and gently extend it.
Let the partner move the leg only to a mild stretch.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 扶持单腿站姿髋屈肌和膝伸肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: supported one leg standing hip flexor and knee extensor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A supported standing quad stretch that also opens the front of the hip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 单腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 双腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Sitting back on your heels and leaning back to stretch both quadriceps at once.
instructionsEn: Kneel and sit back so your hips rest on your heels.
Place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly and lift the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of both thighs.
Stop if you feel any pinch in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing with the top of the foot on the floor to stretch the muscles at the front of the shin.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing the tops of the toes against the floor to stretch the front of the foot and shin.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch with the foot raised on a support, easing the shin and top of the ankle.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat on the balls of the feet that stretches the toes and the bottom of the feet.
instructionsEn: Crouch down with your heels lifted and toes tucked under.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the toes and soles stretch.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch for the muscles that lift the toes, using your hand to point the toes downward.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足外翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated toe extensor and foot everter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole outward.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足内翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated toe extensor and foot inverter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch pulling the toes back to lengthen the bottom of the foot.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated toe flexor and foot everter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole outward.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated toe flexor and foot inverter stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole inward.
instructionsEn: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling the toes back against a wall to stretch the sole of the foot and the calf.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle rocking stretch that improves ankle movement and loosens the calf.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, toes a few inches from it.
Keep your front heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and glide it toward the wall.
Return and repeat slowly for 10-15 reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A tall standing stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them to open the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.

entries.nameZh: 辅助坐姿反向肩部拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A partner gently draws your arms back to stretch the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and put your arms behind you, palms facing down.
Have a partner stand behind and hold your wrists or forearms.
Ask them to lift your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing with your hands clasped behind you to open the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that lengthens the shoulder and chest by pressing the arms back and down.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Place your hands behind you on the seat, fingers pointing back.
Press your shoulders down and back, opening your chest.
Lean slightly forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretching one arm back and down to lengthen the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: adduction of arm in back stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Reaching one arm behind your back and pulling it across to stretch the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 肩伸肌内收肌和回缩肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: shoulder extensor adductor and retractor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 肩内收肌上提肌和前伸肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: shoulder adductor elevator and protractor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A classic cross-body stretch for the back of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A cross-body shoulder stretch with the elbow bent, easing the back of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle rotation stretch for the shoulder joint.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the elbow lifted out to the side.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead stretch for the rotator cuff and back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the arm held low behind the body.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 跪姿单臂体前交叉拉伸
entries.nameEn: kneeling one arm cross body stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling stretch where you reach one arm across the body to open the back of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging stretch between parallel bars that opens the shoulders and lengthens the lats.
instructionsEn: Stand between parallel bars and grip them at hip height.
Walk back slightly, letting your arms straighten.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press your head between your arms.
Feel the stretch in the lats and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then walk forward to release.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch that eases the shoulder into outward rotation.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch that eases the shoulder into inward rotation.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A hack squat on a sled machine through a full range of motion, loading the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Unlock the safety and straighten your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs are below parallel.
Keep your back flat against the pad and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip thrust that works the glutes hard and challenges balance and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the heel to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 肩内收肌前伸肌和上提肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: shoulder adductor protractor and elevator stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles along the upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: shoulder stretch with towel behind the back
entries.descriptionEn: Using a towel behind the back to ease the shoulders into a deeper stretch.
instructionsEn: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple stretch that opens the fingers and forearm muscles, useful after typing or gripping.
instructionsEn: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Clasped hands pressed forward with the palms facing out to stretch the forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms outward and straighten your arms in front of you.
Push your hands gently away until you feel the stretch in the forearms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch for the top of the forearm with the fingers pointing down.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing the palm against a wall to stretch the forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle stretch for the thumb and the muscles at its base.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch that bends the fingers back to lengthen the palm side of the forearm.
instructionsEn: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Gently bends the fingers down to stretch the tight tissue on the top of the hand and fingers. Handy after typing or gripping work.
instructionsEn: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other hand.

entries.descriptionEn: Spreads the fingers wide apart to open up the hand and loosen the small muscles between the fingers.
instructionsEn: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax the hand and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: adduction hand with elbow extended stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Tilts the hand sideways at the wrist with a straight elbow to stretch the forearm muscles along the outer edge of the arm.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

entries.nameZh: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
entries.nameEn: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
entries.descriptionEn: A reclined figure four stretch for the buttocks and deep hip muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the front of the thigh from a seated position by folding one leg back while the other stays supported.
instructionsEn: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulls the toes back toward the shin while sitting, giving the calf and the back of the lower leg a gentle stretch.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Spreads the toes apart to wake up and loosen the small muscles of the foot.
instructionsEn: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
Hold the spread for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch feet.

entries.nameZh: 倾身脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Targets the lower calf and Achilles tendon area by leaning into a wall with the back heel pressed down and the knee bent.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A backbend style stretch that lengthens the front of the abdomen and hips.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Rounds the spine upward from all fours to loosen the back and gently engage the abs. A classic mobility move for stiff backs.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Lets the belly sink and the chest lift from all fours to stretch the front of the trunk and mobilise the spine.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: Combines a gentle lift of the chest with a twist to stretch the stomach muscles and the sides of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: Lifts the hips while the upper back is supported, teaching the glutes to extend the hip through a full range.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
Repeat for 10-12 reps.

entries.nameZh: 站姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: standing lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Bends the lower trunk sideways from a standing position to stretch the muscles along the flank and low back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated side bend that lengthens the muscles along the side of the waist.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Repeat for 8-12 reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolls the knees to one side while lying on your back to twist the lower spine and loosen the hips and sides.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend for the sides of the waist and ribs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated side bend that stretches the sides of the waist and the lats.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaches an arm overhead and leans to the side to lengthen the flank, lats and obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: Uses a stick held overhead to guide a deeper side bend, stretching the flank and the lats.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: Curves the body sideways while lying down, which stretches the flank without any need to balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A partner helps guide a sideways bend of the trunk, making it easier to relax into the stretch along the flank.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: With help from a partner, this stretch lengthens the oblique muscles on the side of the trunk through a slow bend or twist.
instructionsEn: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come back to upright and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: lateral bend on floor by kneeling
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.nameEn: lateral stretch on floor lying down
entries.descriptionEn: A lying side stretch that gently lengthens one side of the body.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

entries.descriptionEn: A captain's chair leg raise with added weight, building lower ab and hip flexor strength.
instructionsEn: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A decline bench crunch with a weight held at the chest, adding resistance for the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A loaded carry holding a dumbbell in each hand while walking tall. Builds grip, core and total-body strength.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
保持背部挺直，肩膀向后。
向前迈出小步，控制住，保持直立姿势。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
最后，停止行走并小心地将哑铃降低到身体两侧。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm plank held with extra weight on your back. Builds core strength and stability.
instructionsZh: 首先脸朝下躺在地板上。
将前臂放在地面上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
将双腿伸直在身后，脚趾着地。
启动你的核心并将你的身体抬离地面，用前臂和脚趾保持平衡。
保持身体从头部到脚跟呈一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将身体放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by lying face down on the floor.
Place your forearms on the ground, with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, with your toes on the ground.
Engage your core and lift your body off the ground, balancing on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A cuban press variation with dumbbells that mixes a press and a wrist rotation. Works the shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，将哑铃垂直推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃放回至肩膀高度，将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing down.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, press the dumbbells straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder height, rotating your wrists back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing you to facing forward as you lift. Hits all three heads of the shoulder.
instructionsZh: 坐在有背部支撑的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝向身体，肘部弯曲。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，手掌朝前。
抬起时旋转手腕，使手掌在动作的最高点朝前。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms are facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Steady pedalling on a stationary bike at a pace that suits you. Builds endurance and leg conditioning.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和位置以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏板。
保持稳定的节奏并根据需要增加阻力。
调动核心肌肉以保持稳定性和正确的姿势。
继续踩踏板达到所需的锻炼时间。
逐渐减小阻力并减速，然后完全停止。
锻炼后伸展双腿并放松。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Engage your core muscles to maintain stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.

entries.descriptionEn: Cranking pedals with your hands on an upper body ergometer. Gets your heart rate up using the arms and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和车把位置调整至舒适的水平。
坐在测力计上，背部挺直，双脚放在踏板上。
双手抓住手柄，并将手臂呈 90 度角。
开始用手踩踏板，以受控的动作推拉手柄。
继续踩踏所需的持续时间或重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to a comfortable level.
Sit on the ergometer with your back straight and feet on the pedals.
Grasp the handles with your hands and position your arms at a 90-degree angle.
Start pedaling with your hands, pushing and pulling the handles in a controlled motion.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A low-impact cardio machine session that works the legs in a smooth walking motion to raise your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.

entries.descriptionEn: Smooth walking-style motion on an elliptical cross trainer. Low-impact cardio that builds endurance.
instructionsZh: 将椭圆机的阻力水平和倾斜度调整到您想要的设置。
踩上机器的踏板并轻轻握住手柄。
首先用脚向下压，然后将手柄拉向身体。
继续这个动作，交替推和拉，以模拟行走或跑步动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的步伐并保持核心参与。
继续进行有氧运动所需的持续时间。
下车前逐渐降低机器的强度和速度。
instructionsEn: Adjust the resistance level and incline of the elliptical machine to your desired settings.
Step onto the pedals of the machine and grip the handles lightly.
Begin by pushing down with your feet and pulling the handles towards your body.
Continue this motion, alternating between pushing and pulling, to simulate a walking or running motion.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the intensity and speed of the machine before stepping off.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
坐直，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧三头肌并将手柄向下推向大腿。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Sit up straight with your feet flat on the footrests.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your triceps and push the handles down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Dumbbell circles around the body with straight arms, going out to the side and overhead. Works the shoulders through a wide range.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
将手臂伸直至两侧，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢地以圆周运动旋转手臂，将哑铃放在身体前面，然后举过头顶。
继续圆周运动，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing down.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly rotate your arms in a circular motion, bringing the dumbbells in front of your body and then overhead.
Continue the circular motion, bringing the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable press pushing the handles away from your chest. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和电缆手柄调整至舒适的位置。
坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住电缆手柄，与肩同高。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，充分伸展双臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and cable handles to a comfortable position.
Sit on the bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip at shoulder height.
Push the handles forward and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.

entries.nameEn: lever hip thrust with resistance band
entries.descriptionEn: A machine hip thrust with a band around the thighs, adding hip abductor work to the glute drive.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.

entries.descriptionEn: A one sided machine hip thrust that hits each glute on its own and challenges hip stability.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling kickback with a band that isolates the glutes by pressing the bent leg up and back.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around one foot, then get on all fours.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Press the foot with the bent knee up toward the ceiling against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying clam with a band around the thighs that strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Lower the knee slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotates the arm outward against band tension to strengthen the small muscles that stabilise the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带前平板支撑后踢腿
entries.nameEn: resistance band front plank with kicked leg
entries.descriptionEn: A plank hold while one leg kicks back against a band, working the glutes and core together.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Return the leg with control.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat with a band for added resistance, training the thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
Sit your hips back and down into a full squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and heels on the floor.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor bridge with a band around the thighs to keep the glutes working hard.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Place your feet flat, hip width apart.
Push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带跪姿侧平板支撑
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank from the knees with a band, training the sides of the waist and the hips with less load than a full plank.
instructionsEn: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A side lying leg raise against a band that works the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band one leg glute bridge with straight leg
entries.descriptionEn: A single leg bridge with a band and the free leg held straight, demanding strong glutes and a level pelvis.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and one knee bent, foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight, in line with your thigh.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: resistance band one leg glute bridge
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg glute bridge with a band added, making your glutes and hamstrings work harder on each side.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing or all fours kickback with a band that targets the glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it and loop it around one foot.
Stand holding a support, or get on all fours, with your core braced.
Kick one leg back against the band, keeping the knee straight.
Squeeze your glute and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Marching the knees while holding a plank with a band around the legs, which challenges the core and hips together.
instructionsEn: Place a loop band around your thighs or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Return it quietly and lift the other knee.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side.
Alternate for the planned time or reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Swings the legs up behind you against a band to train the glutes and the muscles along the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
Lower the legs slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a band around the legs to fire up the hips and the sides of the waist.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral band walk that strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.

entries.nameEn: resistance band supine hip bridge march
entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge held while you march your knees one at a time against a band, testing hip stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot off the floor, drawing the knee toward your chest.
Lower it and lift the other foot, keeping your hips level.
Continue alternating at a steady pace, then lower your hips.

entries.descriptionEn: A decline EZ bar triceps extension lowering the bar toward your forehead. Builds triceps strength.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头低于脚，双脚固定。
正手握住 ez 杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
将杠铃慢慢降低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your feet secured.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A close-grip bench press using a reverse (underhand) grip. Emphasises the triceps and upper chest.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃向胸部降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
