Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 双哑铃坐姿三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，正握，将其举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
伸展双臂，将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands with an overhand grip, and raise it above your head.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Extend your arms and raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A steady, low-impact walk on the elliptical that builds endurance and works the legs without pounding the joints.
instructionsEn: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Continue for 15-45 minutes.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.

entries.descriptionEn: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.
instructionsEn: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Continue for 15-30 minutes.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.

entries.descriptionEn: Running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build endurance and burn energy.
instructionsEn: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine-based triceps extension that lets you load the back of the arm with a steady, guided path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust done by rolling a ball under your body, which trains the glutes and challenges your balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and your arms by your sides.
Brace your core and press your heels into the ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball drift away.
Repeat for the planned reps, keeping the ball steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A roller-assisted hip opener for the glutes. Helps loosen tight hips with a controlled rolling motion.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮放在臀部下方、膝盖上方。
向后倾斜，双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
收紧臀部，慢慢向前滚动滚轮，弯曲膝盖并将其拉向胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，感受臀部的拉伸。
慢慢地将滚轮滚回起始位置，伸展双腿。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller under your glutes, just above your knees.
Lean back and place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Engage your glutes and slowly roll the roller forward, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly roll the roller back to the starting position, extending your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 滚轴坐姿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌
entries.nameEn: roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated roller drill that rolls forward and back to work shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向前倾，将滚轮滚离身体，将手臂伸直在身前。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将滚轮向身体方向滚动，弯曲手臂，将滚轮拉回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean forward slightly and roll the roller away from your body, extending your arms straight in front of you.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the roller back towards your body, bending your arms and bringing the roller back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with forearms on a roller, rolling forward and back like a saw. Challenges the abs and core.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在滚轴上，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并缓慢向前滚动滚轮，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the roller and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and slowly roll the roller forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the roller back towards your starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling roller stretch that opens the hips and glutes. Helps release tension around the hips.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，将滚轮放在臀部下方。
将双手放在滚轮上以获得支撑。
慢慢地向前滚动滚轮，伸展臀部并伸展臀部。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后滚回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
Slowly roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse crunch where you roll a roller toward you with your feet. Trains the lower abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂伸直过头顶，双腿伸直在身前。
将滚筒放在双脚之间，并用脚趾抓住它。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖向胸部弯曲，将滚轮向身体方向滚动。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置，将滚轮滚离身体。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight above your head and your legs straight out in front of you.
Place the roller between your feet and grip it with your toes.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground and curl your knees towards your chest, rolling the roller towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position, rolling the roller away from your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A roller stretch that reaches forward to lengthen the sides of your back. Helps loosen the lats.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住滚轮放在身体前方。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
向前伸展双臂，将滚轮向脚部方向滚动，感受背阔肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸几秒钟，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚动回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the roller with both hands in front of your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms forward and roll the roller down towards your feet, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly roll the roller back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling your back over a roller to loosen it up. Helps ease stiffness along the spine.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮垂直于您的身体放置，位于臀部下方。
慢慢向后滚动你的身体，让滚轮向上移动你的背部。
继续滚动，直到滚轮到达您的上背部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller perpendicular to your body, just below your glutes.
Slowly roll your body backwards, allowing the roller to move up your back.
Continue rolling until the roller reaches your upper back.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 滚轴坐姿单腿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌
entries.nameEn: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated single-leg roller drill for shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向后倾斜并锻炼核心肌肉。
将滚轮抬高至肩部高度，保持手臂伸直。
慢慢地将滚轮放回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean back slightly and engage your core muscles.
Raise the roller up to shoulder level, keeping your arms straight.
Slowly lower the roller back down to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg press on a 45 degree sled that loads the thighs and hips while your back stays supported.
instructionsEn: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising dumbbells out to your sides to build the middle part of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable pushdown with a V bar that isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructionsEn: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Plain walking at an easy to brisk pace, a simple way to build endurance and stay active.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
Walk for 20-60 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking on a treadmill lets you control speed and incline for steady, low-impact cardio.
instructionsEn: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded seated row that trains the upper back and lats through a guided pulling path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine back extension that strengthens the muscles along the lower back with support from the pad.
instructionsEn: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine leg press that drives the legs forward to build thigh and glute strength with back support.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine crunch where the hands press on a pad, working the abs against steady resistance.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch done with an ab wheel that works the abdominal wall through a compact range.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Round your lower back slightly and brace your abs.
Roll forward a short distance while keeping your hips stable.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Exhale as you crunch and avoid arching your back.
Repeat with smooth control.

entries.descriptionEn: A boxing left hook thrown with a hip and torso rotation. Builds rotational power and conditioning.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
左手举起以保护脸部，右手握住下巴。
旋转臀部并以左脚为轴心，同时以出拳动作向前伸展左臂。
扭转你的躯干并调动你的核心肌肉以产生出拳的力量。
将手臂拉回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your left hand up to protect your face and your right hand by your chin.
Rotate your hips and pivot on your left foot as you extend your left arm forward in a punching motion.
Twist your torso and engage your core muscles to generate power in the punch.
Snap your arm back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, used to build speed, shoulder endurance and timing.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful straight punch with the rear hand, driven by a turn of the hips and back foot.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rising punch with the right hand aimed upward, using leg drive and a hip turn.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rising punch with the left hand, thrown upward from the hips and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine crunch performed lying back, letting you load the abs while the lower back stays supported.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded chest press that trains the pecs and triceps along a guided path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Do not lock your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A decline-angle machine press that emphasises the lower part of the chest.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
Return slowly under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded machine movement that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆颈部左侧屈(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever neck left side flexion (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the left to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructionsEn: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆颈部右侧屈(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever neck right side flexion (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the right to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructionsEn: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine pullover that sweeps the handles toward you. Works the lats with a long range of motion.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅和手柄调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，并用正手握住手柄。
保持手臂稍微弯曲，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将手柄拉向胸部，挤压背阔肌。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and handles of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms slightly bent and your core engaged.
Slowly pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your lats.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine hip extension that drives your leg back against resistance. Targets the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将脚放在脚踏板上并握住手柄以保持稳定。
启动臀肌和腿筋，然后推动脚踏板以伸展臀部并向后抬起双腿。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to extend your hips and raise your legs backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine leg press done one leg at a time, alternating. Builds the quads and glutes.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅和脚踏平台调整到您想要的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
将一只脚推到脚平台上，伸展腿直到几乎完全伸直。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲腿，回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine gripper where you squeeze the handles closed. Strengthens the forearms and grip.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并握住杠杆机的手柄。
保持背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
呼气并挤压手柄，收缩前臂。
保持收缩一秒钟，然后慢慢释放并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Exhale and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine calf press pushing the pad with your toes. Builds the calf muscles.
instructionsZh: 调整杠杆机的座椅，使肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在杠杆垫上，脚跟悬在边缘上。
抓住手柄或侧面支撑以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，收缩小腿肌肉，将杠杆垫向下推。
在动作的底部停顿片刻。
让脚后跟重新抬起，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat of the leverage machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lever pad, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or side supports for stability.
Push the lever pad down by extending your ankles, contracting your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by allowing your heels to rise back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with the back foot raised, building leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid swinging your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over dumbbell raise to the sides. Trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿佐特曼牧师凳弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A standing zottman curl against a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将上臂靠在牧师凳上，并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place your upper arms against the preacher bench and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as well.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃佐特曼牧师凳弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A seated zottman curl on a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部放在垫子上。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止，手掌朝上。
在弯举的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and elbows resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary and your palms facing up.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling a ball forward with your forearms to challenge the abs and core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
Repeat slowly.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球卷腹(全幅度手放脑后)
entries.nameEn: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
entries.descriptionEn: A full-range crunch on a stability ball with hands behind your head. Works the abs through a longer range.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前弯曲上半身，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.
instructionsZh: 设置一张长凳，其高度应让您的身体可以自由地悬挂在其下方。
面朝上躺在地上，头朝向长凳。
向上伸手，正手握住长凳，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，手臂完全伸展。
当你将胸部拉向长凳时，启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.
instructionsZh: 在腰部高度设置一根横杆，然后躺在其下方。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将胸部向上拉向杠铃。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up a bar at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your body is straight.
Pull your chest up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.
instructionsZh: 将步进机调整到舒适的水平。
走上机器，将双手放在扶手上以获得支撑。
开始行走时，将一只脚放在台阶上，然后将另一只脚放在台阶上，双腿交替。
保持直立姿势并锻炼核心肌肉。
继续步行所需的时间或距离。
当您对锻炼感到更加舒适时，逐渐增加强度或速度。
完成练习后记得冷静下来并伸展身体。
instructionsEn: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Maintain an upright posture and engage your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将右腿伸直并抬离地面。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝盖并伸展左腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out and lift it off the ground.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and extending your left leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine crunch performed lying back, targeting the abdominal muscles with adjustable resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotary calf raise on a machine. Builds the calf muscles.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
用脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬高脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A seated lateral raise with bent elbows. Targets the side delts with a shorter lever.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持肘部弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your elbows bent, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine shoulder press, pushing the handles overhead. Builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿内侧二头肌弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A standing biceps curl with the palms turning to face forward as you lift. Works the biceps and brachialis.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
保持上臂不动，弯曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
While holding your upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

entries.nameEn: cable straight legs pull through (with rope)
entries.descriptionEn: A cable hinge with straight legs that trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back with control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃旋前转中立握划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell pronated to neutral grip row
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell row that begins with an overhand grip and turns to a neutral grip, working the back and arms.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid jerking with your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝向身体。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让你的手臂伸直垂下，完全伸展，肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down, fully extended, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A close-hand push-up with hands on a stability ball. Hits the triceps and chest while the ball challenges your balance.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地面上，将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在球上，距离略窄于肩宽。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近球，使胸部靠近球。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ball, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向右扭转躯干，将右肘拉向左膝盖。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向左侧重复扭转，将左肘拉向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
entries.descriptionEn: A cable lat pulldown using the full range of motion. Builds the lats and upper back.
instructionsZh: 坐在高位下拉机上，膝盖位于护垫下方。
正手握住电缆杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，挺胸，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the lat pulldown machine with your knees positioned under the pads.
Grasp the cable bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在自行车交叉训练机上。
将脚放在踏板上并抓住车把。
开始以平稳且受控的动作踩踏。
保持稳定的步伐并根据需要增加阻力。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the cycle cross trainer.
Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handlebars.
Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion.
Maintain a steady pace and increase the resistance if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直向下。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight down.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在平台上。
将脚趾和脚掌放在平台边缘，脚跟悬空。
伸展脚踝，将平台推离您，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
继续用力，直到小腿完全收缩。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将平台放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine calf press. Builds the calf muscles.
instructionsZh: 调整机器的座椅，使您的肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在平台的下部，并将膝盖放在杠杆垫下方。
抓住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，将杠杆垫压下，尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃卧推前臂(动作检查)
entries.nameEn: barbell chest bench press forearms (form check)
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press form check that shows how the forearms should line up under the bar for a safe and strong press.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃飞鸟手臂(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest fly form check that shows how to keep a soft elbow bend and a wide, smooth arc through the movement.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for keeping your butt on the bench during a chest press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameEn: chest bench press grip width (form check)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for shoulder position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for arm path during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for elbow position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 俯身划船背部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for back position during a bent over row, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 滑车哈克深蹲腿部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for leg position on the hack squat sled, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 凳上臂屈伸背部手臂(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 前平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.
instructionsEn: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.

entries.nameZh: 牧师凳弯举手腕(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for wrist position during a preacher curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 侧平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 俯卧撑起始姿势(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 俯卧撑结束姿势(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 二头肌弯举手臂身体(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 集中弯举手臂(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for arm position during a concentration curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your upper arm rests against the inner thigh and only the forearm moves.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for back position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays neutral and braced from the floor to lockout.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameEn: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
entries.descriptionEn: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，尽可能靠近肘部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and set your hips at a mid height before gripping.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips start above the knees and rise together with your shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃深蹲膝盖结束姿势(动作检查)
entries.nameEn: barbell squat knees end position (form check)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 深蹲膝盖中间姿势(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for knee position midway through a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and begin to squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees keep tracking in line with your toes on the way up and down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃深蹲髋部(动作检查)
entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and squat down to depth.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips and chest rise together, without the hips shooting up first.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-by-side form check for back position during a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core and squat down.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays flat and braced without rounding at the bottom.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

entries.nameZh: 高平行杠宽握胸部臂屈伸
entries.nameEn: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
entries.descriptionEn: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
稍微向前倾，弯曲肘部降低身体，直到胸部位于杠铃上方。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 辅助宽握胸部臂屈伸(跪姿)
entries.descriptionEn: A machine-assisted wide-grip dip with your knees on a pad. Lets you train the chest with less bodyweight.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您想要的高度，并将膝盖固定在垫子上。
宽握手柄并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with a wide grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A pullover with straight arms that stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your upper back supported and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips stable.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge from a raised step that works the legs and glutes with a deeper range.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low step with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
一只脚向前迈出一步，并将其放在另一只脚前面约两英尺处。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到前大腿与地面平行，后膝盖悬停在地面上方。
暂停片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted russian twist, rotating a weight side to side while leaning back. Works the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
稍微向后倾斜以锻炼核心肌肉。
将躯干向右扭转，将重量移至身体右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将重量移向身体的左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂肩部推举 v. 3
entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead press that builds the shoulders and challenges your core.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Stand or sit tall and brace your core.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm bent over row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row in a bent-over position that works the back and arm.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a bench or knee for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.

entries.descriptionEn: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧二头肌弯举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩部高度，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.
instructionsZh: 首先双手和膝盖着地，双手与肩同宽，膝盖与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将上身压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by getting on your hands and knees, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable twist, rotating the torso against resistance. Works the obliques and core.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持核心参与，慢慢地将躯干旋转到一侧，将电缆拉过身体。
在动作范围结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢旋转回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the range of motion, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 反向腿弯举(引体向上绳索机)
entries.nameEn: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使踝带处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸展，脚踝带固定在脚上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀部弯曲，挤压腿筋。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing dumbbell curl with an arm blaster to keep your upper arms still. Isolates the biceps.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃锤式弯举(用手臂塑形板)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing hammer curl with an arm blaster to prevent swinging. Targets the biceps and brachialis.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂不动，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交替二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster)
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your upper arms fixed so the biceps do the work.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将手臂冲击波放在上臂上，确保牢固贴合。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place the arm blaster on your upper arms, ensuring a secure fit.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: EZ杠二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
entries.descriptionEn: An EZ bar curl with an arm blaster. Isolates the biceps with a comfortable wrist angle.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，在整个练习过程中保持静止。
保持肘部靠近身体，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping them stationary throughout the exercise.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 绳索三头肌下压(V形杆)(用手臂塑形板)
entries.descriptionEn: A cable pushdown with a v-bar and an arm blaster. Isolates the triceps.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将 V 形杆附件连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆，手掌朝下，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
收紧三头肌并呼气，同时向下推 V 形杆，直到手臂完全伸展。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，挤压你的三头肌。
吸气，同时缓慢地将 V 形杆返回到起始位置，保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 绳索反握三头肌下压(曲杆)(用手臂塑形板)
entries.nameEn: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) (with arm blaster)
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse grip cable pushdown with an arm blaster. Targets the triceps with a different hand angle.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
启动你的三头肌，慢慢地向下推杠铃，直到你的手臂完全伸展。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a straight bar to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and slowly push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your elbows still so the biceps do the work.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，保持肘部靠近躯干。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 负重仰卧颈部伸展(用头带)
entries.nameEn: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.

entries.nameZh: 负重仰卧颈部屈曲(用头带)
entries.nameEn: weighted lying neck flexion (with head harness)
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with a weighted head harness, you lift your chin toward your chest to train the neck flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and the harness fitted.
Let your head hang back slightly in a comfortable range.
Curl your chin toward your chest slowly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and keep the weight light with smooth reps.

entries.nameZh: 负重站姿颈部伸展(用头带)
entries.nameEn: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
entries.descriptionEn: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿颈部伸展(用头带)
entries.nameEn: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
entries.descriptionEn: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.
instructionsEn: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿颈部屈曲(用头带)
entries.nameEn: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
entries.descriptionEn: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.
instructionsEn: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with a wide grip, targeting the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell with a wide underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pointing back and the bar close to your body.
Drag the bar up your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm barbell curl while standing, with the other hand resting on your thigh. Isolates the biceps.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住杠铃，掌心朝上。
将另一只手放在大腿上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将重量向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
