Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A V up where you pass a stability ball between hands and feet. Works the abs and builds control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A rear lunge while pushing or holding a power sled. Builds leg strength with extra resistance.
instructionsEn: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.
instructionsEn: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: An inverted row on suspension straps with added weight on your body. Builds the back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted sit-to-stand with a narrow stance and cable resistance.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.

entries.nameEn: cable stiff leg deadlift from stepbox
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-leg hinge from a raised box for a longer range on the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge from a step box with cable tension, training the glutes and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

entries.descriptionEn: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.
instructionsEn: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.
instructionsEn: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

entries.descriptionEn: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.
instructionsEn: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

entries.descriptionEn: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.
instructionsEn: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

entries.descriptionEn: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.
instructionsEn: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

entries.descriptionEn: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.
instructionsEn: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging leg raise with cable resistance at your feet. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

entries.nameZh: 交替打腿(手放臀下抬头)
entries.nameEn: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
entries.descriptionEn: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
instructionsEn: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 前平板支撑抬臂(俯卧撑姿势)
entries.nameEn: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
entries.descriptionEn: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

entries.nameZh: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(俯卧撑姿势)
entries.nameEn: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
entries.descriptionEn: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A biceps curl using a power sled as the resistance. Adds a unique load for arm strength.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 动力雪橇后撤弓步划船
entries.descriptionEn: A rear lunge combined with a row using a power sled. Works legs and back together.
instructionsEn: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.

entries.nameZh: 动力雪橇后撤弓步 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A rear lunge using a power sled for resistance. Builds glute and thigh strength.
instructionsEn: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A movement with a power sled where you pull the handles out and back like wings. Works the hamstrings, back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A rear fly done with a power sled for resistance. Works the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking backward while dragging a power sled. Great for quads and conditioning with low joint stress.
instructionsEn: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: Pushing a power sled while walking backward. Builds quad strength and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

entries.nameEn: power sled anti rotation forward walk
entries.descriptionEn: Walking a loaded sled forward while resisting twist from a side-on pull or hold. It builds hip and trunk stability under load.
instructionsEn: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull from low to chest height on a sled, using hip drive. It trains the shoulders and upper back with a bit of power.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Carrying one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. It challenges your grip and forces your trunk to resist leaning.
instructionsEn: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.
instructionsEn: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Carrying a loaded trap bar at your sides while walking. It works grip, traps and the whole trunk together.
instructionsEn: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking with a dumbbell held overhead. It builds shoulder stability and a strong, braced trunk.
instructionsEn: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking while holding a barbell locked out overhead. It trains shoulder stability and whole-body bracing.
instructionsEn: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.

entries.descriptionEn: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.
instructionsEn: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking while hugging a kettlebell at chest height. It trains posture, the trunk and the upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking while holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand. It builds grip strength, traps and overall posture.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down and brace your abs.
Walk with quick, controlled steps without swinging the weights.
Cover the set distance, then lower the dumbbells safely.

entries.descriptionEn: Carrying a barbell off to one side with a single-handed grip. It trains your trunk to resist leaning and builds grip.
instructionsEn: Stand with the barbell at your side and grip it near its center of balance.
Lift it while keeping your torso tall and level.
Walk with steady steps and resist tilting toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then lower the bar carefully.
Switch hands and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A press with the weights squeezed together, done on a Smith machine. The squeeze keeps tension on the chest throughout.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Rerack the bar when done.

entries.nameZh: 徒手单腿硬拉(手臂和腿伸直)
entries.nameEn: single leg bodyweight deadlift with arm and leg extended
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hinge with your arms extended that trains hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise performed while lying on your side with a cable. Lying down keeps constant tension on the side delt.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping up onto a bench with one leg while holding dumbbells. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping sideways against a band anchored in an X pattern. It fires up the hips and outer glutes.
instructionsEn: Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃跪姿单臂倒握推举
entries.nameEn: kettlebell kneeling one arm bottoms up press
entries.descriptionEn: Pressing a kettlebell held upside down from a kneeling position. The unstable load demands shoulder control and grip.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug done with the barbell locked out overhead. It targets the traps and helps with overhead stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.

entries.descriptionEn: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A band pull-apart with palms facing up and elbows bent at 90 degrees. It targets the rear delts and external shoulder rotation.
instructionsEn: Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising your arms overhead while your back stays against a wall. It improves shoulder mobility and posture.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃跪姿单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: kettlebell kneeling one arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm kettlebell press from a kneeling position. Kneeling takes the legs out of it and challenges your trunk.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating rear lunges while making waves with heavy ropes. It combines leg work with a hard cardio effort.
instructionsEn: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm kettlebell press from a half-kneeling stance. The position teaches hip stability while you press.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 半跪姿pvc管胸肌活动拉伸
entries.nameEn: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rocking forward over a bent knee to open the ankle and calf. It helps ankle mobility for squats and walking.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A rollout on a stability ball with a rounded back that trains the abs hard.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带上肢抗阻死虫式
entries.nameEn: band upper body resistance dead bug
entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug with a band resisting your arms. It adds shoulder and trunk demand to a classic core drill.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Circling a kettlebell around your head, also called a halo. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.

entries.descriptionEn: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Sliding your forearms up a wall to wake up the shoulder blade muscles. It improves overhead movement.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A spider crawl performed with a band around your legs. The band adds hip effort to a classic core and shoulder crawl.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up where your hands lift off the floor and reach out at the top. It builds chest and back strength together.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Sliding your shoulder blades along a wall to improve their control. It helps shoulder blade mobility and posture.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 滚压小腿前侧泡沫轴放松
entries.descriptionEn: Rolling the front of the lower leg on a foam roller. It can loosen the muscles beside your shin.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling the chest on a foam roller. It can loosen tight pecs before pressing or after desk work.
instructionsEn: Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

entries.nameZh: 滚压背阔肌泡沫轴放松
entries.descriptionEn: Rolling the side of your back on a foam roller. It can loosen tight lats before overhead work.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat on a machine where the weight hangs from a belt at your hips. It loads the legs without stressing your spine.
instructionsEn: Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg press on a horizontal lever machine. It builds the quads and glutes with back support.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机跪姿后踢(与搭档)
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling glute kick using a Smith machine with a partner helping. It works the glutes with a steady guided path.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿反握弯举(直杆)
entries.nameEn: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a straight cable bar. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
entries.descriptionEn: A goblet split squat with the front foot on a raised platform. The extra height deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat holding dumbbells at your sides with the front foot raised. It deepens the range for the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A stationary lunge with dumbbells at your sides. It strengthens one leg at a time, mainly the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank sequence combining a push-up and a row. It trains the chest, back and core in one flowing move.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿锤式握肩部推举
entries.nameEn: lever seated hammer grip shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine shoulder press with a neutral hammer grip. It trains the delts with a joint-friendly hand position.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 坐在船长椅上，背部靠在靠背上，前臂放在扶手垫上。
保持上半身稳定，背部挺直。
收紧腹肌并将双腿抬起到身前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the captain's chair with your back against the backrest and your forearms resting on the arm pads.
Keep your upper body stable and your back straight.
Engage your abs and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with the barbell resting on your hips and your hands on the bar. It builds the glutes and hamstrings with load.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with dumbbells held at your shoulders. The front load keeps your chest upright and challenges the quads and core.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat that flows into an overhead press. It is a hard whole-body move that raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat into overhead press with dumbbells that works the legs and shoulders in one flow.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat into an overhead press using a band for resistance. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart in one move.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping out to the side into a deep lunge. It works the quads and glutes while opening the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

entries.nameEn: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm chest press on a plate-loaded machine. It lets each side work on its own.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that flows into a press with a landmine bar. It works legs and shoulders in one smooth motion.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 肘撑上下动态平板支撑
entries.nameEn: elbow up and down dynamic plank
entries.descriptionEn: Moving between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time. It builds the core and shoulders under constant tension.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

entries.descriptionEn: A row from a plank position with dumbbells. It builds the back while your core fights rotation.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor press where you press one dumbbell at a time. It trains the chest and triceps with a limited range for the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 负重锤式握法双杠架引体向上
entries.nameEn: weighted hammer grip pull up on dip cage
entries.descriptionEn: A weighted pull-up with a neutral hammer grip on a dip cage. It builds the lats and arms with extra load.
instructionsEn: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 负重窄握反手引体向上(双杠架)
entries.nameEn: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
entries.descriptionEn: A weighted close-grip chin-up on a dip cage. Builds the lats, biceps and upper back.
instructionsZh: 站在俯卧撑前面，用反握抓住双杠，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand in front of the dip cage and grab the parallel bars with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bars with your arms fully extended, feet off the ground, and body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bars, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bars, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat hold and rock that opens the hips and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: A short flow of deep squat positions that opens up the hips, knees and ankles. Good as a warm-up before leg work.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking on the balls of your feet with a barbell on your back to wake up the calves before heavy lower body training.
instructionsEn: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.

entries.nameZh: 滚球坐姿单腿肩部屈伸收缩
entries.nameEn: rollball seated single leg shoulder flexor depressor retractor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated shoulder control drill on a ball with one leg lifted. It challenges balance while you raise, lower and pull back the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A self-massage for the calves using a barbell to roll over tight spots.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃高脚杯深蹲灵活性练习
entries.descriptionEn: A goblet squat held low with a kettlebell as a counterweight, used to loosen the hips and ankles.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

entries.nameZh: 小腿前侧自我泡沫轴放松
entries.descriptionEn: A foam roller technique for the front of the lower leg that eases tightness.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead press against a band. It trains the shoulders and makes your core resist twisting.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助引体向上 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up where a band under your foot or knee takes some of your weight, so you can build up to full reps.
instructionsEn: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated stretch for the front of the ankle and shin that eases stiffness after sitting or training.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿后侧跟腱拉伸
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing back achilles stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A calf and Achilles stretch with a band that gently pulls the toes toward you while the leg is behind you.
instructionsEn: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿前侧跟腱拉伸
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf stretch with a band around the forward foot, pulling the toes back to lengthen the Achilles area.
instructionsEn: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm push-up from the knees, a stepping stone toward the full single-arm version. It builds chest and trunk strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A fast-paced walk that lifts your heart rate without the impact of running. Easy on the joints and good for steady fitness.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip abduction pushing your knees apart against a resistance band. Works the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在椅子或长凳的两侧以获得支撑。
启动外展肌（大腿外侧肌肉），并克服弹力带的阻力，慢慢将膝盖分开。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回一起。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg extension with a resistance band around your ankle. Builds the quads.
instructionsZh: 将阻力带固定在坚固的锚点上，并将其固定在脚踝上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
保持核心参与并保持上半身稳定，将腿伸直到身前。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
instructionsEn: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping up stairs at a steady pace to train the legs and raise your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.

entries.nameEn: ez bar lying bent arms pullover
entries.descriptionEn: A lying EZ bar pullover with slightly bent arms. Works the lats and chest.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
旋前握住 EZ 杠铃（手掌背向您），双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后通过反向弧线运动将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将双手放在长凳上，距离略比肩宽。
将双脚放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将胸部向长凳方向降低，保持肘部内收。
当你降低时，缩回肩胛骨，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place your hands on the bench slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your feet on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the bench, keeping your elbows tucked in.
As you lower, retract your shoulder blades, squeezing your scapulae together.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂在身前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
弯曲肘部并缩回肩胛骨来降低身体，就像你试图在它们之间挤一支铅笔一样。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力，伸展肘部，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A low glute bridge on the floor, lifting your hips. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl-up lifting your shoulders off the floor. Works the abs.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A pendlay row from the floor, pulling the barbell to your upper abdomen. Builds the upper back and lats.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight calf raise that builds lower-leg strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight bench pull-up variation hanging beneath a bar. Works the lats and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar or surface.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你下降时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将胸部向前推。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower, squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带仰卧髋内旋 v. 2
entries.nameEn: band lying hip internal rotation v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Lying hip internal rotation against a band to build control through the hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A split-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It works each leg on its own and builds strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From all fours, you drive one bent knee up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes without any equipment.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From all fours, you lift one bent leg out to the side. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A running drill where your heels flick up toward your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架直杆高位头上三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable bar high pulley overhead tricep extension
entries.descriptionEn: A cable overhead extension from a high pulley that isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing hip abduction against a low cable that trains the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架站姿二头弯举(绳索)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable curl with a rope for constant tension on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A press with dumbbells held close together that shifts the work toward the triceps and inner chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated curl that keeps the body steady while the biceps do the work.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm curl braced on a preacher pad for strict biceps isolation.
instructionsEn: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.

entries.descriptionEn: Explosive hops from a deep squat, like a frog. They build leg power and get your heart pumping.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A bouncy skip with high knee lifts. It warms up the legs and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat followed by a high knee drive as you stand. It combines leg strength with a cardio push.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic jump where your arms and legs swing out and back. A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate fast.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways leap from one leg to the other. It builds lateral power and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆交替窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded seated row with a narrow grip, one arm at a time for balanced back strength.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded machine row with a narrow grip for the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping jack with a squat landing. The extra depth makes it harder on the legs and your heart.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side leap like a speed skater. It trains leg power, balance and stamina.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with the bar on a Smith machine, giving a steady path to load the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping move where your legs split front and back while your arms swing. It's a light, fast cardio burst.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: From all fours, you extend one straight leg back and up. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带固定背后反握下拉
entries.descriptionEn: A band pulldown with an underhand grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢释放带子的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the band down towards your chest, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带固定背后窄握下拉
entries.nameEn: band fixed back close grip pulldown
entries.descriptionEn: A band pulldown with a close grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在您上方的固定点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
坐在面向乐队的长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
紧紧握住弹力带，手掌朝向您。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢地将弹力带释放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a fixed point above you, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Sit down on a bench or chair facing the band, with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Grasp the band with a close grip, palms facing towards you.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the band back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat done as a deep, comfortable squat. Works the legs, glutes and core.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise holding on for balance, so you can focus on the calves.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated row with a band and a straight back that trains the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated shoulder press using a resistance band. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住阻力带，手掌朝前，将其拉至肩部水平。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带降低至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with both hands, palms facing forward, and bring it up to shoulder level.
Press the band overhead, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated biceps curl using a resistance band. Builds the biceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住阻力带，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将阻力带向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢降低阻力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the resistance band up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the resistance band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated chest press using a resistance band. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住阻力带手柄，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向前伸展双臂，将阻力带推离胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band handles in each hand, with your palms facing down and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
