Extend your arms forward, pushing the resistance band away from your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle drill where you turn the foot outward against a band. It strengthens the outer ankle muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Pointing the foot against a band to strengthen the calf and ankle.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Turning the sole of the foot outward against a band to train the muscles on the outer side of the ankle.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Turning the sole of the foot inward against a band to train the muscles on the inner side of the ankle.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder blade drill where you pull the blades together and then spread them apart. It improves control of the scapulae.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A drill where you shrug your shoulders up and then press them down. It builds control of the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat done holding a support for balance. Works the glutes and legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor stability move reaching opposite arm and leg to train the back and core.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A sumo squat on a smith machine. Targets the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在上背部和肩膀上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: resistance band seated straight back row
entries.descriptionEn: A seated straight-back row using a resistance band. Builds the upper back and lats.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸展，将阻力带绕在脚上。
双手握住阻力带的两端，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向后倾斜，锻炼核心肌群。
将阻力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with your hands, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, engaging your core.
Pull the resistance band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up finished with an extra shove that spreads the shoulder blades at the top. It trains the chest and the serratus muscles that stabilise the shoulder blades.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，用力推动你的手臂，伸展你的手臂并抬起你的上半身。
在动作的最高点，将上背部推向天花板，从而伸展肩胛骨。
暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to extend your arms and lift your upper body up.
At the top of the movement, protract your shoulder blades by pushing your upper back towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement by retracting your shoulder blades and lowering your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A small rocking movement of the pelvis while lying on your back. It wakes up the abs and teaches you to control the position of your lower back.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides.
Engage your abs and tilt your pelvis upward, pressing your lower back into the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, focusing on contracting your abs.
Release the tilt and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Drawing your chin straight back to line up your head over your shoulders. It's a simple neck posture exercise.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

entries.descriptionEn: A chin tuck with light help from your hand to guide the movement and feel the right position.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that finishes with a side kick. It's a tough full-body conditioning move.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.

entries.nameZh: 自重站姿窄握单臂划船
entries.nameEn: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A standing, bent-over one arm row with a close grip, working the muscles between and around the shoulder blades. A light handheld weight keeps the pull honest.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一只手握住哑铃，握姿中立。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over standing row with a close grip, pulling the hands toward your body. It builds the upper back and the muscles that squeeze the shoulder blades together.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将双臂伸直在身前，紧紧抓住杆或手柄。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, gripping the bar or handles with a close grip.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 自重站姿单臂划船(用毛巾)
entries.nameEn: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing one arm row using a towel as the handle, pulled toward the chest. It trains the upper back with very little equipment.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing one arm row from a hip hinge, pulling a weight toward your chest one side at a time. Good for the upper back and lats.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一手握住哑铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让哑铃垂直悬挂在您面前，手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down in front of you, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing row done with both hands on a towel, pulling toward your chest. It trains the upper back and shoulder blade squeeze with no gear.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在身前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel in front of you with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing, bent-over row pulling a bar or handles toward your body with an overhand grip. It builds the upper back and the muscles that retract the shoulder blades.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杆或手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grasp a bar or handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat combined with a towel row, so legs and upper back work together. You pull the towel toward your chest as you sink down.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你下蹲时，同时将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a towel in front of you with your palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
As you lower into the squat, simultaneously pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then slowly return to the starting position while extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat paired with a pulling motion on a sturdy anchor or suspension trainer. It trains the legs and upper back in one flowing movement.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding onto a sturdy object or suspension trainer with your arms extended.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your knees behind your toes.
From the squat position, pull your body up towards the object or suspension trainer, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with your feet up and your knees bent to 90 degrees. This keeps your lower back flat and your trunk working.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell fly with your feet lifted and knees at 90 degrees. It stretches the chest and keeps your back flat.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃直臂上拉(膝盖成90度)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell straight arm pullover (knees at 90 degrees)
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm pullover with knees bent to 90 degrees on a bench. It works the chest and lats and keeps the trunk braced.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.

entries.nameEn: stability ball reverse hyperextension (off a bench)
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse hyperextension over a ball at the edge of a bench for glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse hyperextension on an incline bench that trains the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together, taking glute work to the next level.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.

entries.descriptionEn: A frog-style glute bridge with extra weight on your hips for stronger glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃悬垂高翻(膝下) v. 2
entries.nameEn: barbell hang clean below the knees v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A clean started with the bar hanging below the knees. It builds explosive hip power.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃深蹲(悬挂弹力带技术)
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell squat with bands hanging weights from the bar. The wobble forces you to stay stable.
instructionsEn: Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃卧推(悬挂弹力带技术)
entries.nameEn: barbell bench press (with hanging band technique)
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The shaky load trains control and stability.
instructionsEn: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃军事推举(悬挂弹力带技术)
entries.nameEn: barbell military press (with hanging band technique)
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The unstable load trains control in the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A goblet squat that finishes with an explosive jump for leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃直臂上拉(悬挂弹力带技术)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell straight arm pullover (with hanging band technique)
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm pullover with weights hung from the dumbbell by a band. The swing makes your shoulders and trunk work harder.
instructionsEn: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring exercise where you lift your torso from a face-down position on a glute-ham bench. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructionsZh: 调整臀肌提升机以适合您的身体。
将自己面朝下放在机器上，固定脚踝。
将双手放在胸前或交叉在胸前。
调动腿筋和臀肌，将上半身抬向天花板。
继续抬起，直到身体从头部到脚后跟成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the glute-ham raise machine to fit your body.
Position yourself face down on the machine with your ankles secured.
Place your hands on your chest or cross them over your chest.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift your upper body up towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body is in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A front-loaded barbell squat held out in front of the body with straight arms. It hits the glutes and quads and demands a tall, braced torso.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂伸直将杠铃举在身体前方。
保持背部挺直，弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your body with straight arms.
Keeping your back straight, lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆仰卧双腿屈单腿还原腿弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A lying machine leg curl that starts with both legs and finishes with one. It targets the hamstrings with a controlled, heavier lowering phase.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将双腿放在脚踝上方的杠杆垫上。
抓住机器两侧的手柄以提供支撑。
保持上半身不动，呼气并将双腿向上弯曲至臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your legs on the lever pad, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body still, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A light, springy trot with high knees, like a pony. It's a fun cardio warm-up.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Hopping diagonally forward in a zigzag pattern. It trains agility and lower leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple skipping step with a hop on each foot. A playful way to warm up and lift your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine row done in a bent-over stance with a v-bar handle. It builds the upper back and lats by pulling the handle toward your abdomen.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住 V 形杆，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将 V 形杆拉向腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放重量回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the v-bar towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A short-range sit-up where you curl only partway up. It keeps tension on the abs and is easier on the lower back than a full sit-up.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up that stops at roughly half height, keeping constant tension on the abs. A gentle way to train the midsection.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A half sit-up with the hands held behind the head, like a prisoner. It trains the abs through a short, controlled range.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 双臂过头全程仰卧起坐(男)
entries.descriptionEn: A full sit-up with the arms stretched overhead, which makes the lever longer and the move harder. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂伸过头顶，保持伸直。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干直立。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms overhead, keeping them straight.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，使身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，保持核心靠近身体两侧，将身体压向地面。
继续降低，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后伸直手臂，将其推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple standing forward fold to reach your toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back and gets the hips moving.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with your hands, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend where each hand slides down toward the same-side foot in turn. It mobilises the trunk and trains the obliques.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向右弯曲，将右手伸向右脚，同时保持左手向一侧延伸。
返回起始位置，然后腰部向左弯曲，将左手伸向左脚，同时保持右手向侧面延伸。
重复左右弯曲动作达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 双臂展开绕圈触脚尖(男)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
保持双腿伸直，腰部向前弯曲，右手向下伸向脚趾。
当你向下伸展时，同时将左腿在身后伸直，保持平衡。
返回起始位置，重复该动作，左手伸向脚趾，右腿在身后抬起。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 反手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
entries.nameEn: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
entries.descriptionEn: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸，并在腿后将它们握在一起。
慢慢地将双手举过头顶，做圆周运动，保持双腿伸直。
继续圆周运动，直到双手触及脚趾。
反转动作并将双手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你降低身体时，用右手拍打胸部。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次用左手敲击胸部。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将身体向地面降低，弯曲肘部并保持核心参与。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心向后转移，并将臀部向上抬向天花板，与你的身体形成一个倒V形。
继续降低身体，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后反向运动，将臀部向下推，并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and keeping your core engaged.
As you lower your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 双手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手合十放在胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双手向脚趾方向以打圈的方式降低，尽量伸得尽可能远，但不要用力。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
跳离地面，同时将右腿交叉到左腿前面。
落地时，快速换腿，将左腿交叉在右腿前面。
继续交替双腿并尽可能快地跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性向上跳跃，伸展双腿和手臂。
在空中时，将双腿分开，并将双臂向两侧伸出。
双脚分开与肩同宽，轻轻落地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively upwards, extending your legs and arms.
While in the air, spread your legs apart and bring your arms out to the sides.
Land softly with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性跳跃，伸展臀部和膝盖，同时摆动手臂以获得动力。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
稍微弯曲膝盖并爆发性地跳起来。
跳跃时，张开双腿，将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体形成星形。
膝盖轻轻弯曲，脚掌轻轻着地。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump up explosively.
As you jump, spread your legs and extend your arms out to the sides, forming a star shape with your body.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.
instructionsZh: 双脚并拢站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
跳起来，分开双脚，将手臂举过头顶。
当你落地时，迅速跳回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 俯卧眼镜蛇式掌心置于大腿下
entries.descriptionEn: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

entries.nameZh: 俯卧眼镜蛇式双手交扣
entries.descriptionEn: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架站姿后三角肌水平划船(绳索)
entries.nameEn: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable row with a rope that pulls the elbows wide. It targets the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable row with an underhand grip that brings the biceps and lats into play.
instructionsEn: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以宽弧线将哑铃向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架辅助反向腿弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A cable-resisted leg curl from a face-down position. It isolates the hamstrings with smooth, constant tension.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使脚踝附件处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸直，将脚踝固定装置固定在脚踝上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气并慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling hip thrust against a resistance band around the thighs. It trains the glutes with a hip extension.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，双脚弯曲。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在臀部或向前伸展以保持平衡。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
当你将膝盖抬离地面时，向前推动臀部并挤压臀部，伸展臀部直到大腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在肩膀前面。
保持核心收紧并保持背部挺直，将杠铃向上举起并远离身体，将其提升至肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on the front of your shoulders.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, lift the barbell up and away from your body, raising it to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
instructionsZh: 从跪姿开始，双手放在地上，与肩同宽。
将双腿伸到身后，用脚趾支撑，将身体抬起成平板支撑姿势。
保持核心参与并保持臀部稳定，将一只手抬离地面并拍打另一侧的肩膀。
将手放回地面并用另一只手重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes, and lift your body into a plank position.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 健身球靠墙提踵(两膝间夹网球)
entries.nameEn: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the knees. It trains the calves and inner thighs.
instructionsZh: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微位于您的前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在膝盖之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 健身球靠墙提踵(两踝间夹网球)
entries.nameEn: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the ankles. It trains the calves.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
在墙壁和下背部之间放置一个健身球。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在脚踝之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

entries.nameEn: feet and ankles side to side stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

entries.descriptionEn: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: kneeling push up to child pose
entries.descriptionEn: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
instructionsEn: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

entries.descriptionEn: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

entries.nameZh: 脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
entries.nameEn: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A full-depth back squat on the smith machine, where the fixed bar path gives extra stability. It trains the glutes, quads and thighs.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
松开杠铃并后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
保持胸部挺直，核心参与，通过将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低你的身体，直到你的大腿与地面平行，或者在你的灵活性允许的范围内尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 负重脚放凳上地面卷腹
entries.nameEn: weighted floor crunch feet on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A loaded crunch with the calves on a bench, for stronger abs once bodyweight crunches feel easy.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 负重脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
entries.nameEn: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A loaded twisting crunch with the legs on a bench, building the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A muscle up with added weight, pulling from a hang up and over the bar into a dip position. It is an advanced move for lats, chest and triceps.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续拉起自己，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest reaches the bar, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部向前滑离长凳，伸直双腿，保持脚后跟着地。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂伸展并支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.
instructionsZh: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，调动核心力量，将身体拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸过头顶。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，同时保持手臂伸过头顶。
当你蹲下时，将手臂向下压向地面，锻炼三头肌。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟站起来，同时将手臂举过头顶。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body down into a squat position while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, engaging your triceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或交叉放在胸前。
保持背部挺直，腰部慢慢向前弯曲，将上半身向地面降低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
当你站起来时，弯曲一只手臂并将肘部移向身体一侧，同时保持另一只手臂伸直。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方并且弯曲的手臂完全弯曲。
有控制地放低自己，伸直弯曲的手臂并在另一侧重复该动作。
每次重复时交替进行。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
As you pull yourself up, bend one arm and bring your elbow towards your side, while keeping the other arm straight.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar and your bent arm is fully flexed.
Lower yourself back down with control, straightening the bent arm and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alternate sides with each repetition.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，将另一只手臂伸出到一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
保持身体挺直，抬起双腿直至与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，目标是 10-20 秒。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your body straight, lift your legs up until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for 10-20 seconds.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
同时，抬起双腿并将其伸直在您面前，保持身体与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持此位置，以达到完全前杆位置。
要释放，请慢慢降低双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
慢慢抬起双腿，保持伸直，直到身体与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, keeping them straight, until your body is parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚分开。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的肩膀放在你的手上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet spread wide apart.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders over your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并缓慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的脚抬离地面。
继续向前移动体重，直到身体与地面平行，并用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双脚放回地面，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体伸直。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，让你的肩膀越过你的手。
向前倾时，保持肘部稍微弯曲，身体伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部挺直。
当你降低身体时，将双脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后向后伸展双腿，并将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.
instructionsZh: 找到一个有足够空间的空地来进行倒立。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿向上踢向墙壁，用核心和肩膀保持平衡。
处于倒立位置后，用三头肌来支撑体重。
只要能保持平衡，就保持倒立。
下降时，慢慢将双腿放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.
instructionsZh: 首先，双手握住一根垂直杆，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
利用核心和上半身的力量，抬起双腿，直到它们与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.
instructionsZh: 首先，将双臂完全伸展，身体放松地悬挂在杆上。
收紧核心并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
继续将双腿举过头顶，让身体穿过手臂。
一旦双腿完全伸过头顶，就开始将它们放回起始位置。
当你降低双腿时，让你的身体通过手臂向后移动，直到你再次完全伸展手臂悬挂。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat followed by an overhead press in one fluid movement with a barbell. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart rate.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，与肩同高。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低至蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地通过脚后跟站起来，同时将杠铃压过头顶。
当你回到深蹲位置时，将杠铃降低到肩膀高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.
instructionsEn: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.
instructionsEn: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.

entries.descriptionEn: The standard flat bench press with a loaded barbell, the staple lift for chest size and pressing strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted muscle up performed with the added load on a bar. An advanced pull and dip that trains the lats, chest and triceps.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃杆，保持身体挺直。
当你的胸部到达杠铃时，用手向下推并将肘部向后推，将身体提升到杠铃上方。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted dip on a straight bar or parallel bars. It builds the chest, triceps and shoulders with added resistance.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.
instructionsZh: 首先，悬挂在一对环上，双臂完全伸展，身体呈一条直线。
双腿分开，形成跨坐姿势。
启动你的核心并慢慢降低你的身体，直到你的手臂与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸直至两侧。
慢慢向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，直到上半身与地面平行。
启动你的核心并保持这个姿势几秒钟。
通过双脚推动并站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Slowly lean forward, keeping your arms straight, until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and hold this position for a few seconds.
Return to the starting position by pushing through your feet and standing back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.
instructionsEn: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

entries.descriptionEn: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.
instructionsEn: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.

entries.descriptionEn: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
启动你的核心并以圆周运动摆动你的手臂，同时旋转你的躯干。
继续圆周运动，摆动手臂并旋转躯干，达到所需的重复次数。
记住在整个练习过程中保持呼吸。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
