Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
entries.descriptionEn: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃锤式握法上斜凳双臂划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.
instructionsEn: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A band version of the reverse fly that works the back of your shoulders and upper back, handy for posture.
instructionsEn: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.

entries.descriptionEn: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: The first half of a turkish get up, moving from lying to a seated position with the kettlebell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and core strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带交替上斜胸推并转体
entries.nameEn: band alternate incline chest press with twist
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating band press angled upward, with a torso twist added to bring in your core. It works the upper chest and trunk together.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带交替低位划船并转体
entries.nameEn: band alternate low row with twist
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带交替高位下拉并转体
entries.nameEn: band alternate lat pulldown with twist
entries.descriptionEn: A standing band pulldown done one arm at a time with a trunk twist. It trains your lats and adds core work.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体高度时，身体向前倾斜，双脚离开地面，用双手保持平衡。
继续降低身体，直到胸部略高于地面。
用手推动并伸展双臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
在整个运动过程中，从头部到脚后跟保持一条直线。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, lean your body forward and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your hands.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃组合直腿硬拉翻举上步
entries.nameEn: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell complex that links a stiff leg deadlift into a clean and then a step. It builds posterior chain power and rhythm.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

entries.nameEn: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
entries.descriptionEn: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

entries.nameEn: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
entries.descriptionEn: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm wide grip bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A one arm dumbbell bench press with a wide elbow path, stressing the chest while your core resists rotation.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A one arm fly lying on the floor, a safe way to stretch and load the chest with a limited range.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs holding dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell lunge variation for leg strength and balance, working quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable raise that moves your arms into a Y shape, building the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine lateral raise that isolates the side delts with smooth, guided resistance.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine crossover that brings your arms together across the body, isolating the chest.
instructionsEn: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A wrist curl using a hand grip spring, strengthening your forearms and grip.
instructionsEn: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a cable held at your chest, keeping you upright while the quads and glutes work.
instructionsEn: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways lunge against cable tension, training glutes, inner thighs and side to side strength.
instructionsEn: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with cable resistance, building leg strength with a constant load.
instructionsEn: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架单臂高位头上三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable one arm high pulley overhead tricep extension
entries.descriptionEn: A single arm overhead extension on a high pulley that stretches and loads the long head of the triceps.
instructionsEn: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A second take on the cable front squat, holding the handle at your chest to stay upright and hit the quads.
instructionsEn: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.

entries.descriptionEn: A second variation of the cable side lunge for the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward stepping lunge with cable tension, working quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

entries.nameEn: cable seated on floor row with rope
entries.descriptionEn: A floor seated cable row using a rope, which lets you pull the hands apart and squeeze the mid back.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架地面平行握高位下拉
entries.nameEn: cable parallel grip lat pulldown on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A lat pulldown done from the floor with a neutral grip, focusing on the lats.
instructionsEn: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing press with cables that trains the chest while your core keeps you steady.
instructionsEn: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.
instructionsZh: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平坦并收紧核心。
同时向前移动右手和左脚，然后是左手和右脚。
继续向前爬行，手脚交替动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并保持核心紧张。
继续所需的距离或时间。
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向右跳，右脚着地。
落地时，将左腿摆动到右腿后面，并用左脚趾敲击地面。
立即向左侧跳跃，左脚着地。
落地时，将右腿摆动到左腿后面，并用右脚趾敲击地面。
继续交替两侧，跳跃并用每条腿敲击地面。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A close grip press lying down with a cable, putting emphasis on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing close grip cable press that focuses on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated close grip cable press for the triceps with a stable base.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

entries.nameZh: 战绳交替甩臂跳跃深蹲
entries.nameEn: battling ropes alternate arms jump squat
entries.descriptionEn: A high energy move combining a jump squat with alternating rope waves. It builds power and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.

entries.nameEn: battling ropes side to side arms
entries.descriptionEn: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

entries.nameEn: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
entries.descriptionEn: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

entries.descriptionEn: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.
instructionsEn: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.
instructionsEn: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Jumping lunges while waving the ropes, a demanding mix of power and cardio.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.
instructionsEn: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.
instructionsEn: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

entries.nameEn: inverted row bent knee under table
entries.descriptionEn: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.
instructionsEn: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.
instructionsEn: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.
instructionsEn: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine press that loads the thighs and glutes with a stable path.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine isolation move for the front of the thighs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.

entries.descriptionEn: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.
instructionsEn: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
instructionsEn: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

entries.nameEn: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.
instructionsEn: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.
instructionsEn: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

entries.nameEn: lying leg hip raise on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

entries.nameEn: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle hip stretch that moves through flexion and extension to loosen the hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip-driven swing with a dumbbell, taking the weight from between the legs to overhead.
instructionsEn: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with dumbbells held at your shoulders, which challenges your legs and trunk.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs for each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with the barbell in the front rack, emphasizing quads and an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell clean followed by an overhead press for total-body power.
instructionsEn: Stand over two dumbbells and grip them with a flat back.
Pull the weights up explosively and catch them at your shoulders.
Dip slightly and drive them overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the floor with control.
Keep the weights close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A pike push-up with your feet on one bench and your hands between benches for extra depth.
instructionsEn: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A pike push-up with your hands on two chairs so your head can drop lower.
instructionsEn: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the lower traps and shoulder stabilisers.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift your arms out to the sides into a T shape to train the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull your elbows back into a W shape to strengthen the mid-back and rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing trunk rotation at lower body level to loosen the hips and waist.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing rotation of the upper body that mobilises the thoracic spine and warms up the waist.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: Swim-style arm swings that loosen the shoulders and chest as a warm-up.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Twist your torso with arms wrapped as if wringing a towel, mobilising the waist and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: Circle your hips to loosen the hip joints and warm up the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.

entries.descriptionEn: Squeeze your glutes while lying down to activate them before heavier lower body work.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Slide your arms along the floor in a wide arc to mobilise the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotate your upper body while lying down to loosen the mid-back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A supported nordic-style curl where assistance lets you control the lowering for the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your ankles secured and your torso upright.
Use the assistance as needed.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and hands if needed.
Keep your hips extended.

entries.descriptionEn: Circle your shoulders to loosen the joint and ease tension in the upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.

entries.nameZh: 跪姿单臂伸展滚动抬起
entries.nameEn: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背阔肌和二头肌，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Try to bring your legs parallel to the floor, forming an 'L' shape with your body.
Hold this position for as long as you can.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Simultaneously, lift your upper body off the ground and reach your arms towards your legs.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift dumbbells in front of you to work the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs back down to the starting position.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive overhead throw behind you that trains the hips and posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive overhead throw with a medicine ball, working the upper body and trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.
instructionsEn: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.

entries.descriptionEn: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.

entries.descriptionEn: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.

entries.nameZh: 侧平板支撑髋内收(屈膝)
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 2 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 6 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，将身体降低到弓步位置。
将右膝盖弯曲约 90 度，保持膝盖与脚踝对齐。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.
instructionsEn: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸(双手过头)
entries.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
entries.descriptionEn: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

entries.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧屈腿髋部扭转拉伸
entries.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧屈腿髋背部向右拉伸
entries.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧屈腿髋部向左扭转拉伸
entries.nameEn: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

entries.nameEn: alternate heel touch side kick squat
entries.descriptionEn: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.nameEn: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
entries.descriptionEn: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

entries.nameZh: 椅间屈膝反向下巴弯举
entries.nameEn: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
entries.descriptionEn: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.
instructionsEn: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.

entries.nameEn: pull up with bent knee between chairs
entries.descriptionEn: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.
instructionsEn: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.

entries.nameEn: decline kneeling push up on box
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.
instructionsEn: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: lying floor row with bent knee
entries.descriptionEn: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.

entries.descriptionEn: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.
instructionsEn: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

entries.nameZh: 地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
entries.nameEn: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.
instructionsEn: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 肘触膝侧平板支撑卷腹
entries.nameEn: elbow to knee side plank crunch
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.
instructionsEn: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 站姿平衡股四头肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.
instructionsEn: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

entries.descriptionEn: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.
instructionsEn: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.

entries.nameZh: 自我辅助反向腿弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.

entries.nameEn: resistance band seated single leg curl
entries.descriptionEn: A seated leg curl with a band around the foot. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: seated in out leg raise on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

entries.descriptionEn: A bird dog with a band for extra resistance, training the lower back, glutes and core stability.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band upper body dead bug
entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug with a band held in the hands, pulling it as the arms move. It builds core stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.

entries.nameEn: resistance band shoulder stretch behind the back
entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder and chest stretch holding a band behind the back. It opens the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

entries.nameZh: 单腿地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
entries.nameEn: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell single leg glute bridge pullover
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg glute bridge with a kettlebell pullover, working glutes and lats.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘，背靠着长凳，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带水平帕洛夫推举加弹力带深蹲
entries.nameEn: band horizontal pallof press with resistance band squat
entries.descriptionEn: A squat combined with a Pallof press. It builds leg strength with anti-rotation core work.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 地雷杆跪姿单臂肩上推举
entries.nameEn: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling single-arm press with a landmine. It trains the shoulders and builds core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.
instructionsEn: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

entries.nameZh: 下犬式脊柱灵活性练习
entries.descriptionEn: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A landmine move combining a stand-up with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and core.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell squat with bands attached to increase tension at the top.
instructionsEn: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.

entries.descriptionEn: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.
instructionsEn: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.nameZh: 三椅间抬高反手握反向划船
entries.nameEn: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
entries.descriptionEn: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.

entries.nameEn: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
entries.descriptionEn: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.
instructionsEn: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling thoracic rotation stretch.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
稍微向前倾，让手臂伸直垂下，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将手臂向两侧抬起并呈 Y 形，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
