Lean forward slightly and let your arms hang straight down, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides and up in a Y shape until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
向前倾斜，让手臂笔直向下垂，垂直于地板。
保持手臂伸直，将它们向两侧举起，直到与地板平行，与身体形成“T”形。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起来，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将双脚并拢。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即回到蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately drop back into a squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放回到地面，然后在另一侧重复。
instructionsEn: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the ground and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
到达肩膀高度后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
用胸部和肩膀将哑铃向上推，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。
instructionsEn: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back on the bench and use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Once at shoulder height, rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward.
Push the dumbbells up with your chest and shoulders, extending your arms fully.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，将哑铃举至肩高。
将一个哑铃举过头顶，同时将另一个哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置。
将举起的哑铃放回肩高，同时将另一个哑铃推过头顶。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards, and raise them to shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell up overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other dumbbell up overhead.
Continue alternating between arms for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿二头弯举至肩上推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
前臂垂直后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
通过反向运动将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Once your forearms are vertical, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂过头负重行走
entries.descriptionEn: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
向前行走时，启动核心肌群并保持背部挺直，将哑铃举过头顶。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
交换双手并重复练习。
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you walk forward, maintaining the dumbbell overhead.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat the exercise.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.
instructionsEn: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
首先快速上下移动双脚，就像原地跑步一样。
保持动作快速而轻盈，重点放在脚掌上。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Begin by rapidly moving your feet up and down, as if you were running in place.
Keep your movements quick and light, focusing on staying on the balls of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A hammer curl with water bottles as light weights. It trains the biceps and forearms.
instructionsEn: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿交替锤式弯举加推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
entries.descriptionEn: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，背部挺直。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复卷发动作。
左手完成弯举后，呼气，将右手的哑铃压过头顶。
完全伸展手臂并在顶部保持片刻。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复按压。
继续交替进行弯举和推举，达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your back straight.
Exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the curl with your left hand.
After completing the curl with your left hand, exhale and press the dumbbell in your right hand overhead.
Extend your arm fully and hold for a moment at the top.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the press with your left hand.
Continue alternating between curls and presses for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将一只脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将脚放回地面，然后用另一条腿重复该动作。
继续交替双腿进行行进动作，同时保持桥式姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, lift one foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your foot back to the ground and repeat the movement with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs in a marching motion while maintaining the bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell glute bridge with your upper back on a bench and a bar across the hips. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在长凳边缘，上背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，与臀部同宽。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀肌和核心肌肉，然后用脚后跟将臀部抬离长凳，形成从膝盖到肩膀的一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by sitting on the edge of a bench with your upper back resting against it and your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then press through your heels to lift your hips off the bench, creating a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A one arm cable pulldown from a high pulley, pulling the handle down to your side. It trains the lats.
instructionsZh: 将单个手柄连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并完全伸展手臂。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄向一侧拉，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压背阔肌。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手臂重复练习。
instructionsEn: Attach a single handle to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and extend your arm fully.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handle down towards your side while keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your lat muscle.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿肩部屈伸收缩拉伸(屈膝)
entries.nameEn: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.
instructionsEn: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.

entries.nameZh: 滚动仰卧髋外旋与髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
entries.nameEn: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Use a small ball under the buttock to ease tension in the piriformis and deep hip muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pin a ball between your chest and a wall to release tight pectoral muscles.
instructionsEn: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Roll a ball against a wall under the top of your shoulder to relieve tight upper trapezius muscles.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell and no leg drive, focused on shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Press kettlebells overhead from the bottom of a deep squat to challenge shoulder stability and hip mobility.
instructionsEn: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell, friendly on the knees while building glutes and thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk while holding heavy kettlebells at your sides to build grip, posture and total body stability.
instructionsEn: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.

entries.descriptionEn: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.
instructionsEn: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Pass a kettlebell around your waist in a circle to build core control and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.

entries.descriptionEn: Roll back onto the floor holding a kettlebell from a squat, then roll up into a squat again.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with hands on kettlebell handles to lower the chest deeper than the floor allows.
instructionsEn: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
右脚蹬地，跳到空中，在空中改变脚的位置。
左脚向前轻柔落地，并立即将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续在弓步和跳跃之间交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and jump into the air, switching the position of your feet mid-air.
Land softly with your left foot forward and immediately lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating between lunges and jumps for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: single leg bridge with hip flexion
entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.

entries.nameEn: side bridge with arm leg swing
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: single leg deadlift with knee lift
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift one leg while loaded with ankle weight, targeting the glutes and hip extensors.
instructionsEn: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing rotation against band resistance for the obliques and core.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch on a stability ball combined with extending the legs for a deep ab workout.
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.

entries.nameEn: sled 45 degrees narrow stance leg press
entries.descriptionEn: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
instructionsEn: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

entries.nameEn: sled 45 degrees wide stance leg press
entries.descriptionEn: A 45 degree sled leg press with a wide foot position that brings in the inner thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a twist and arms extended to work the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift your legs and torso together to form a V, a demanding core move.
instructionsEn: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.

entries.nameEn: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: Support yourself on parallel bars and lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 站姿腘绳肌和背部拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Fold forward from standing to lengthen the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit with legs wide and lean forward to open the inner thighs and hips.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿相扑向右扭转拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: From a wide seated position, twist toward the right leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
instructionsEn: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿相扑向左扭转拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: From a wide seated position, twist toward the left leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
instructionsEn: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿相扑双臂上举灵活性拉伸
entries.nameEn: sitting sumo with arms up mobility stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A wide seated stretch with arms overhead to open the hips, inner thighs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with the opposite arm movement. It trains the glutes, quads and balance.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直并启动核心。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
交替腿进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A high-knee run in place with the hands on a wall for support. It raises the heart rate and trains the hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在墙上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将右膝抬向胸部，同时将左脚保持在地面上。
快速换腿，将左膝抬向胸部，然后将右脚放低。
继续交替双腿进行跑步动作，将膝盖尽可能抬高。
在整个练习过程中保持快节奏并保持上半身稳定。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the wall for support.
Engage your core and lift your right knee up towards your chest, while keeping your left foot on the ground.
Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee up towards your chest and lowering your right foot back down.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, bringing your knees up as high as possible.
Maintain a fast pace and keep your upper body stable throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A fast running motion while holding on to a wheel. It raises your heart rate and challenges the core and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，双手放在方向盘上，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并通过伸展双臂开始向前滚动轮子。
继续滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
使用你的核心和手臂将轮子拉回你的身体，从而扭转运动。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a plank position with your hands on the wheel and your body straight.
Engage your core and start rolling the wheel forward by extending your arms.
Continue rolling until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Reverse the movement by pulling the wheel back towards your body, using your core and arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up that flows into fast alternating knee drives in the plank position. It raises the heart rate and trains the chest and core.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
用手推动以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
快速将一个膝盖靠近胸部，然后快速切换并将另一只膝盖靠近胸部。
继续尽可能快地交替膝盖，同时保持良好的姿势。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Quickly bring one knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring the other knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating knees as fast as you can while maintaining good form.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying twist with the knees bent, lowering them to each side. It loosens the lower back and hips.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体垂直。
保持膝盖并拢，慢慢地将它们降低到一侧，旨在用膝盖接触地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并慢慢将膝盖抬回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your knees.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and slowly lift your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch where the opposite hand reaches toward the knee on each rep. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，并将右手伸向左膝盖。
返回起始位置并重复，这次将左手伸向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and reach your right hand towards your left knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat, this time reaching your left hand towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling step combined with a weighted swing. It trains the shoulders and core.
instructionsZh: 从跪姿开始，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，背部挺直。
每只手各握一个重物，双臂在身前笔直向下伸展。
启动你的核心肌群，将重物向上举过头顶，保持手臂伸直。
将重量放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight.
Hold a weight in each hand, with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Engage your core and swing the weights up and overhead, keeping your arms straight.
Lower the weights back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted lunge into a deep stretch for the hips. It trains the glutes and quads while opening up the hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直。
弯曲膝盖降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted side-to-side squat, shifting weight deeply over one leg with the other straight. It trains the glutes, quads and adductors.
instructionsZh: 站立时双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
将您的体重转移到一侧，并通过弯曲您转移一侧的膝盖来降低身体，同时保持另一条腿伸直。
尽可能降低身体高度，同时保持平衡并挺胸。
推动弯曲腿的脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，双腿之间交替。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and keeping your chest up.
Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating between legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted lunge with an arm swing as you step forward. It trains the glutes, quads and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个重物。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前冲时，向前和向上摆动重物，保持手臂伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置，将重物向下摆动。
用左脚重复上述动作，并继续交替双腿，完成所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, keeping your arms straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position, swinging the weights back down.
Repeat with your left foot and continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameEn: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
entries.descriptionEn: A single leg glute bridge with the other leg held straight out. It trains the glutes and hamstrings and tests the core.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将一条腿伸直在您面前。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive jump onto a box that builds leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉死亡行进
entries.descriptionEn: Walk forward doing Romanian deadlifts with dumbbells, a balance and hamstring challenge.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.

entries.nameZh: 六角杠分腿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance using a trap bar for hamstring and glute strength.
instructionsEn: Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish reps, then switch the stance.

entries.descriptionEn: A sprinting drill with band assistance to practice fast leg turnover.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie under a barbell on a rack and pull your chest up to it for the back muscles.
instructionsEn: Set a barbell on a rack at a height you can reach lying down.
Lie under it and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking lunge with a high knee between each step. It raises your heart rate and trains the legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
将右膝尽可能高地抬向胸部，同时用左腿保持平衡。
右脚向前迈出一步，身体降低成弓步姿势，双膝弯曲成 90 度角。
用右脚推出，并将左膝抬向胸部。
左脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续交替双腿并向前冲刺，保持核心参与并保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee up towards your chest as high as you can while balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position, bending both knees to a 90-degree angle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left knee up towards your chest.
Step forward with your left foot and lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating legs and lunging forward, keeping your core engaged and maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A run with short, quick strides. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.
instructionsZh: 找一个空地或跑步机来进行锻炼。
站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
开始原地慢跑，抬起膝盖并挥动手臂。
几秒钟后，开始小步前进，保持快速的步伐。
继续小步跑所需的时间或距离。
instructionsEn: Find an open space or a treadmill to perform the exercise.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start jogging in place, lifting your knees high and pumping your arms.
After a few seconds, start taking short strides forward, maintaining a quick pace.
Continue running with short strides for the desired duration or distance.

entries.nameEn: static position lying back with pad
entries.descriptionEn: Hold a lying position on your back with a pad as a reference for setup and posture.
instructionsEn: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

entries.nameEn: static position seated back with pad
entries.descriptionEn: Sit with your back against a pad to hold a proper seated posture.
instructionsEn: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a tall standing posture as a reference position.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a face-down position to practice setting up for prone exercises.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold an upright seated posture with no pad.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up flow that moves from pike position down and through to a cobra. It trains the shoulders, chest and spine mobility.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，与身体形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，使上半身靠近地面，使上半身靠近地面。
当你下降时，将你的重心向前移动，并通过伸直手臂并抬起胸部来过渡到眼镜蛇姿势。
通过弯曲肘部并将胸部放回到地面来扭转运动。
双手用力推回到倒V字形。
通过将臀部放回地面继续运动，回到起始俯卧撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
As you lower down, shift your weight forward and transition into a cobra pose by straightening your arms and lifting your chest up.
Reverse the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chest back down towards the ground.
Push through your hands to return to the inverted V position.
Continue the movement by lowering your hips back down towards the ground, returning to the starting push-up position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse plank where you lift one leg at a time. It trains the abs, glutes and the back of the body.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向脚部。
双手用力，将臀部抬离地面，进入反向平板支撑位置。
启动你的核心并将一条腿抬离地面，将其笔直向上伸向天花板。
保持一会儿，然后将腿放下。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your hands resting on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet.
Press through your hands and lift your hips off the ground, coming into a reverse plank position.
Engage your core and lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight up towards the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃侧平板支撑后束飞鸟
entries.nameEn: dumbbell side plank with rear fly
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell side plank with a reverse fly. It trains the rear delts, upper back and obliques.
instructionsZh: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
用你的上手握住哑铃，手臂垂直向下伸向地面。
收紧核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将哑铃向天花板方向举起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, keeping your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, with your arm extended straight down towards the ground.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you shift from your hands to your forearms and back, one arm at a time. It trains the abs and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
启动你的核心并挤压你的臀肌以保持稳定的位置。
将身体放低到前臂上，一次一只手臂，从头到脚保持一条直线。
保持这个姿势所需的时间，保持核心肌群和臀肌的参与。
要返回到起始位置，请推动前臂并将身体抬回到高位平板支撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes to maintain a stable position.
Lower your body down onto your forearms, one arm at a time, maintaining a straight line from head to toe.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, keeping your core and glutes engaged.
To return to the starting position, push through your forearms and lift your body back up into a high plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A walk on a treadmill with an incline, which makes the glutes and calves work harder. A steady, low impact cardio option.
instructionsZh: 将跑步机的倾斜度调整到您想要的强度。
站在跑步机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始以舒适的步伐行走，确保保持正确的姿势。
在整个练习过程中，调动核心肌肉并保持背部挺直。
继续在倾斜跑步机上行走，完成有氧运动所需的时间。
逐渐降低跑步机的坡度和速度，使其冷却后再停止。
instructionsEn: Adjust the incline level on the treadmill to your desired intensity.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, ensuring that you maintain proper form.
Engage your core muscles and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Continue walking on the incline treadmill for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the incline and speed of the treadmill to cool down before stopping.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg exercise that targets the inner thighs. It trains the adductors and hip stability.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动内收肌并尽可能高地抬起上面的腿，但不要旋转臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell lying on floor chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell press performed lying on the floor, which limits the range of motion and is easy on the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing movement that rotates the torso and draws one arm back like pulling a bow. It mobilises the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高，与地面平行。
将躯干向右旋转，保持双臂伸展，背部挺直。
旋转时，向前伸展右臂，向后伸展左臂，模仿拉弓弦的动作。
保持该姿势片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将躯干向左旋转，左臂向前伸展，右臂向后伸展。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, extend your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the position for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the motion, this time rotating your torso to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted sit-up on a decline bench. It trains the abs through a long range.
instructionsZh: 平躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲，直到躯干垂直于地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side hopping drill that imitates a skier. It raises the heart rate and builds leg stamina.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖并保持背部挺直。
跳到右侧，右脚着地，同时将左腿摆动到右腿后面。
立即向左侧跳，左脚着地，同时将右腿摆动到左腿后面。
继续从一侧到另一侧交替跳跃，模仿滑雪动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A stepping drill moving forward and back with the legs alternating. It raises the heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置。
用右脚蹬地，然后回到起始位置。
用左脚重复该动作，每一步交替双腿。
继续来回走动，保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot, bending your knee and lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and step back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot, alternating legs with each step.
Continue stepping back and forth, maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A front-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump rope while hopping side to side to raise your heart rate and improve agility.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump rope with an alternating skip step for a lighter, rhythmic cardio workout.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump rope while driving your knees high for a hard cardio effort.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump rope with higher jumps to add power and intensity.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up with the arms crossed on the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双臂交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell swing with an overhand grip that builds explosive hip power and a strong posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with dumbbells pressed together to keep constant tension in the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜交替二头弯举
entries.descriptionEn: Curl dumbbells one at a time while lying back on an incline bench to stretch and work the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃高脚杯屈膝礼弓步
entries.descriptionEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and step behind and across into a curtsey lunge.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A light external rotation for the rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Lateral raises with your chest on an incline bench to remove cheating and isolate the delts.
instructionsEn: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: Move from a kneeling position to standing while holding a dumbbell.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿反握二头弯举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated reverse grip biceps curl
entries.descriptionEn: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated one arm front raise
entries.descriptionEn: A seated single-arm raise that targets the front of the shoulder without leg drive helping out.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃健身球坐姿肩上推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated on exercise ball shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Great for working each leg on its own while the front load keeps you upright.
instructionsEn: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.
instructionsEn: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.

entries.descriptionEn: A light rotation exercise lying on a bench that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles around the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜交替反向飞鸟
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported reverse fly done one arm at a time, aimed at the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交替卧推(高位起始)
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell bench press where you press one arm at a time, starting with both weights held high. It challenges chest strength and stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俯身交替后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: dumbbell bent over alternate rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架跪姿后三角肌划船(绳索)(男)
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) (male)
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable row with a rope that targets the rear delts. It trains the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器跪下。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，通过收缩肩胛骨将绳子拉向身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起并保持短暂的停顿。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Attach a rope handle to a low cable pulley and kneel down facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and extend your arms fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, pull the rope towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement and hold for a brief pause.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An inchworm walk-out, walking the hands forward into a plank and the feet back in. It stretches the hamstrings and trains the core and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
保持双腿伸直，将脚移向双手，将臀部抬向天花板。
继续向前移动双手，重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Keeping your legs straight, walk your feet towards your hands, bringing your hips up towards the ceiling.
Continue walking your hands forward, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A high plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with each hand. It trains the abs and builds shoulder stability.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右手抬离地面，伸手拍打你的左肩。
将右手放回地面，然后用左手轻拍右肩，重复此操作。
继续交替轻拍肩膀，同时保持臀部和躯干稳定。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right hand off the ground, reaching across to tap your left shoulder.
Place your right hand back on the ground and repeat with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps while keeping your hips and torso stable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.

entries.nameEn: forward pulse lunge with hands overhead
entries.descriptionEn: A forward lunge held in the bottom position where you pulse up and down with your arms overhead. It burns the legs and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.
instructionsEn: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat followed by two quick jumps in a row. It builds explosive leg power and stamina.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee without the push-up and jump. You drop to a plank and spring back to your feet for a steady conditioning move.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that explodes into a tuck jump. It trains explosive leg power and fast landings.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunges done at a brisk pace to lift your heart rate while working the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with dumbbells held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands strong shoulders and core.
instructionsEn: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃分腿蹲前脚抬高(波速球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated with bosu ball
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with the front foot on a bosu ball for a deeper range and extra balance work.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Step up onto a box or bench with one leg to build single-leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: standing single leg calf raise with support
entries.descriptionEn: Raise your heel on one leg while holding a support for balance, building the calf.
instructionsEn: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿单腿提踵 v. 2
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple balance hold on one leg that trains stability in the ankle, hip and core.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.nameEn: single leg stand on bosu ball
entries.descriptionEn: A balance hold on one leg on an unstable bosu ball. It challenges the ankle and hip stabilisers.
instructionsEn: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat paired with a backward roll to challenge your control and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral squat done from a split position, followed by a roll, for leg strength and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架站姿高位交叉三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable standing high cross triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable pushdown from a high pulley, crossing the body to isolate the triceps.
instructionsEn: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Explosive jumps up a flight of stairs that build leg power and speed.
instructionsEn: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

entries.nameEn: barbell bent over wide grip row
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a wide overhand grip that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃上斜俯卧后三角肌上举
entries.nameEn: barbell incline lying rear delt raise
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported raise with a barbell that isolates the rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Lower the barbell slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge where you step diagonally behind you with a barbell on your back. It works the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell press from the floor. The floor limits the range and takes pressure off your shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up to full extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge performed with a barbell held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands shoulder and core stability.
instructionsEn: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated front raise with a barbell that trains the front delts without using leg drive.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat to a bench behind you, which helps with depth control and keeps the load in front.
instructionsEn: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.

entries.descriptionEn: A step up with a barbell racked on your front shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and works the quads.
instructionsEn: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: barbell chest press on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell press with your upper back on a stability ball, which adds a core and balance challenge.
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug with the bar held behind your thighs, which shifts the load slightly to the mid traps.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with straight arms.
Keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃相扑罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A romanian deadlift in a wide stance, hitting the hamstrings, glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Push your hips back, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃高脚杯屈膝礼弓步
entries.descriptionEn: A curtsey lunge holding a kettlebell at your chest. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A stiff-legged deadlift with a kettlebell that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg deadlift with the back foot lightly touching the floor for support, so you can focus on the working leg.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell and stand with one foot slightly behind, toes on the ground as a kickstand.
Hinge at the hips over your front leg.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying pullover with a kettlebell that stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms slightly bent.
Lower the bell back over your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃站姿底朝上单臂肩上推举
entries.nameEn: kettlebell standing bottoms up one arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, which demands wrist and shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃坐姿单臂军事推举
entries.nameEn: kettlebell seated one arm military press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press with one kettlebell, which removes leg drive and keeps the work on the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell held at your shoulder.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with one kettlebell at a time, adding stability demand for the shoulder and core.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your wrist straight and your feet planted.
Lower the bell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell bottom up one arm bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press holding the kettlebell upside down, which forces tight control of the shoulder and wrist.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise using a kettlebell, which trains the side delts.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A no-equipment side raise using a towel for resistance, so you can train the delts at home.
instructionsEn: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.

entries.nameZh: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: sliding leg curl on floor with towel v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel across the floor.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
Slowly slide them back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with your rear foot resting on a chair, which builds strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: rear delt fly with bed sheet
entries.descriptionEn: A no-equipment fly that uses a bed sheet pulled apart to work the rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.

entries.nameEn: overhead triceps extension with bed sheet
entries.descriptionEn: A home triceps exercise that uses a bed sheet as resistance.
instructionsEn: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.

entries.nameEn: rear delt row with bed sheet
entries.descriptionEn: A rowing pattern that uses a bed sheet anchored around a door handle or post to work the upper back.
instructionsEn: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.nameEn: assisted pistol squat with bed sheet
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat where you hold a bed sheet anchored to something sturdy for assistance.
instructionsEn: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A bicep curl using a bed sheet and your own opposing arm for resistance.
instructionsEn: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row using a bed sheet looped around a sturdy anchor, such as a closed door.
instructionsEn: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Hop your feet side to side from a high plank for a core and cardio challenge.
