instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.

entries.descriptionEn: A pushup where your hands are behind you, working the triceps hard.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.

entries.nameZh: 毛巾仰卧双腿二头弯举
entries.nameEn: lying double legs biceps curl with towel
entries.descriptionEn: A lying curl where you pull a towel wrapped around your feet with your hands, so your legs provide resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows at your sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A band chest fly from a high anchor, pulling downward to work the lower chest.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band high and hold one end in each hand, facing away.
Step forward and lean slightly.
Bring your hands together in front of your waist with a soft elbow.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing chest press on a lever machine, pressing the handles forward. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，并将双手置于胸部水平。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将手柄拉回到胸部，在整个动作过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿早安式体前屈
entries.descriptionEn: A seated good morning on a lever machine, hinging forward at the hips and back up. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使臀部略高于膝盖。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
保持背部挺直，从臀部开始慢慢向前倾斜，直到上半身与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后通过推动臀肌和腿筋慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height so that your hips are slightly higher than your knees.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean forward from your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.descriptionEn: A second take on the seated machine crunch, curling forward against resistance. It trains the abs.
instructionsZh: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将手放在把手上或座椅两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压腹肌。
慢慢回到起始位置，让背部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the seat for support.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position, allowing your back to round slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿交替二头弯举
entries.descriptionEn: Seated curls, alternating arms, to build the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜二头弯举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Curling from an incline bench stretches the biceps at the bottom for a deep contraction.
instructionsEn: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A step up with an explosive jump at the top, which builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one foot on top.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell for balance and extra load.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated leg press on a lever machine that builds the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safety and press the platform away.
Stop just before your knees lock.
Lower the weight slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your hips down and your back flat on the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat where the leg steps diagonally behind and across the body, like a curtsy. It trains the glutes and outer thighs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向斜后方跨出一步，跨过身体，交叉在左腿后面。
弯曲双膝，就像行屈膝礼一样，将身体降低到地面。
保持躯干直立，将体重放在前脚上。
推动前脚返回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚斜向后方跨过身体。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带深蹲加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band squat with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A squat combined with a one-arm band row. It trains your legs and your back together.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带硬拉加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band deadlift with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge paired with a one-arm band row. It works your posterior chain and your upper back.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带高抬膝弓步加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band high knee lunge with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单腿直腿硬拉加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band single stiff leg deadlift with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg hip hinge with a one-arm band row. It challenges your balance and trains hamstrings, glutes and back.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带深蹲加水平帕洛夫保持
entries.nameEn: band squat with horizontal pallof hold
entries.descriptionEn: A squat while holding the band out in front of you against sideways pull. It trains your legs and anti-rotation core strength.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带分腿蹲加水平帕洛夫保持
entries.nameEn: band split squat with horizontal pallof hold
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带侧步加水平帕洛夫保持
entries.nameEn: band side step with horizontal pallof hold
entries.descriptionEn: Side steps in a half squat while holding the band out in front of you. It works your hips and resists rotation through the core.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Step back in under control.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带前平板支撑加单臂下拉
entries.nameEn: band front plank with single arm pulldown
entries.descriptionEn: A front plank with a one-arm band pulldown. It trains core stability while your arm works against the band.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带上身仰卧空中蹬车
entries.nameEn: band upper body lying air bike
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you pedal your arms against the band like a bicycle. It hits your abs with added resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A skiing motion with the band: swing both arms down and back while hinging at the hips. It works your lats, hips and core.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing press against band tension. It builds your chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the handles at your chest.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press both hands forward until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to your chest.
Keep your shoulders down and your back still.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带分腿跳加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band split jump with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: An explosive split jump with a one-arm band row. It builds power in your legs and trains your back.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带跳跃弓步加单臂划船
entries.nameEn: band jump lunge with single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance move where one arm extends sideways like drawing a bow. It trains your shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Shift your weight toward the empty-hand side and bend that knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower with control and shift back to the center.
Repeat all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands crossed under your chest. It puts extra load on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands crossed under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Switch which hand is on top each set.

entries.descriptionEn: An incline push-up with the hands on a box. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps with less load than a floor push-up.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在盒子或高架表面的边缘，距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向箱子方向降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
instructionsEn: Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.

entries.nameEn: resistance band split squat with horizontal pallof hold
entries.descriptionEn: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward punch against a resistance band. It trains your chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand in a staggered stance with a braced core.
Punch one hand forward and rotate your torso slightly.
Return the hand and punch with the other side.
Keep the movement quick but controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. It works your upper back, lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands on a raised surface. It is easier than a floor push-up and a good way to build chest strength.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch where your arms and legs spread like a starfish and then come together. It is a beginner-friendly ab move.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

entries.descriptionEn: A front plank where you tap one foot out to the side at a time. It challenges core stability and hips.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Tap one toe out to the side and bring it back.
Repeat with the other foot.
Keep your body steady and avoid rocking.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with your arms reaching toward your knees. It focuses on your upper abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your arms straight toward your knees.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms reaching.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A rowing movement with small pulses at the top of the pull. It builds endurance in your upper back.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with your feet raised where you tap alternate shoulders. It trains shoulder strength and core stability.
instructionsEn: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands near your hips and your body leaning forward. It strongly loads shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your hands turned out beside your lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders forward beyond your hands.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press up while keeping the lean.
Keep your core braced.

entries.nameEn: mid air lateral raises with switching palms
entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise where you turn your palms over at the top. It works the side of your shoulders from two angles.
instructionsEn: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height with palms down.
Turn your palms up in mid air, then back down.
Lower the weights slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you sweep your arms in a big arc overhead. It opens up your shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise your arms to the ceiling.
Sweep them in a wide arc overhead toward the floor.
Continue the arc back down to your sides.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift your chest and legs off the floor. It strengthens your lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A row using a towel for resistance. It trains your back and arms with no equipment.
instructionsEn: Hold a towel with both hands and stretch it taut.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pulling it apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying back extension while holding a towel taut. It builds your lower back and glutes with extra upper back work.
instructionsEn: Lie face down holding a taut towel in front of you.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor.
Keep pulling the towel apart.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down with control.

entries.nameZh: 毛巾仰卧双腿锤式弯举
entries.nameEn: lying double legs hammer curl with towel
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you loop a towel around your feet and curl it with a hammer grip. It trains your biceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pushing your feet against it.
Pause, then slowly extend your arms.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

entries.nameZh: 毛巾仰卧单腿反握二头弯举
entries.nameEn: lying single leg reverse biceps curl with towel
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you curl a towel looped around one foot with an overhand grip. It targets your forearms and biceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a towel around one foot.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward you while the foot resists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hang from a sloped hangboard hold. It builds finger and forearm strength for climbing.
instructionsEn: Grip the sloped hold with open hands.
Step off the ground and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders active and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hang from a hangboard using an open hand grip. It builds finger strength with less strain on your joints.
instructionsEn: Grip the edge with fingers extended and a slight arch.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down and rest before the next hang.

entries.descriptionEn: A hang from a hangboard in a half crimp grip. It builds finger strength for climbing.
instructionsEn: Place your fingers on the edge with the knuckles bent at about 90 degrees.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully between hangs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to 90 degrees. It builds pulling strength and grip.
instructionsEn: Grip the hold and pull yourself up until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

entries.descriptionEn: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to about 135 degrees. It builds grip and pulling strength in a partly pulled position.
instructionsEn: Grip the hold and pull up slightly so your elbows bend to about 135 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch performed lying on a bench. It trains your abs with a slightly larger range of motion.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend against band tension. It trains your obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand.
Keep your chest up and your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the band hand.
Return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated row with a band while keeping your back straight. It builds your upper back and lats.
instructionsEn: Sit with legs extended and the band around your feet.
Hold the handles with your arms straight and your back tall.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal twisting movement against band tension. It trains your obliques and rotational strength.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at a low point and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Rotate your torso and pull the band diagonally upward across your body.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated row using a towel for resistance. It trains your lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs extended and loop a towel around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms straight.
Pull the towel toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly.

entries.nameZh: 毛巾双腿反握二头弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: two legs reverse biceps curl with towel v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and forearms.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 毛巾双腿锤式弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: two legs hammer curl with towel v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A hammer curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you lift one arm out to the side. It challenges your core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms and avoid twisting.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing leg lift to the side against band tension. It trains your outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it to one foot.
Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side, keeping your toes forward.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: From standing, you walk your hands out to a plank and back. It trains your core, shoulders and hamstring flexibility.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a front plank.
Hold briefly with your hips level.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing movement where you arch and then round your back. It warms up your spine.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip width apart and hands on your hips.
Gently arch your back and look slightly up.
Round your back and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between positions.
Stay within a comfortable range.

entries.descriptionEn: A smith machine squat with resistance band tension added. It builds your quads and glutes under a guided bar path.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on the smith machine and attach the band as required.
Place the bar on your upper back with your feet slightly forward.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat against band tension that builds the quads and glutes while the band pulls you forward, so your core has to work too.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles at your chest, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand up.
Repeat for the desired reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A hinged rowing move with a band that works the muscles between and around the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A hinged row on the cable stack that trains the mid back and lats with steady tension all the way through.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle or bar to a low pulley and grab it.
Step back and hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Start with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

entries.descriptionEn: A rowing movement holding a weight plate, good for the mid back and for grip strength.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate firmly with both hands at its edges.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Let the plate hang below your chest with arms extended.
Pull the plate toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Keep your hips still and your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with your forearms on a stability ball, rocking back and forth to challenge deep core control.
instructionsEn: Place your forearms on a stability ball and extend your legs into a plank.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms a straight line.
Slowly push your elbows forward a few inches by shifting your body weight.
Pull back to the start without letting your hips sag.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
Repeat for time or reps.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive forward jump against band resistance that builds power in the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your hips.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump forward as far as you can against the band.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat jump with the rear foot elevated, building explosive power and balance in each leg.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that adds a kettlebell for extra load, giving you a hard full-body conditioning move.
instructionsEn: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A running-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee drive together to work the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Extend the other leg out low above the floor.
Switch sides in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set.

entries.nameEn: resistance band anti rotation dead bug
entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug with a band pulling you sideways, so your core works hard to keep your torso from twisting.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at the side and lie on your back, holding the band above your chest with both hands.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Brace your core so the band does not pull you sideways.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm back.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A walk in a deep squat that challenges the quads, hips and balance.
instructionsEn: Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
Step forward with one foot, keeping the squat low.
Step with the other foot and continue walking.
Keep your heels down and your back straight.
Walk for a set distance or time.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable fly with your chest against a bench, which isolates the pecs with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys at about shoulder height and position an incline bench facing the stack, chest against the pad.
Hold a handle in each hand with arms out to the sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, sweep your arms forward in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as the handles meet.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated fly on the cable machine that isolates the chest with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench between two cable stacks with the pulleys at chest height.
Grab a handle in each hand and hold your arms out with soft elbows.
Press your back firmly into the bench.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze, then open your arms slowly.
Stop when you feel a good stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse hyperextension with the legs in a frog position, aimed at the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃胸前深蹲加弹力带
entries.nameEn: barbell front chest squat with resistance band
entries.descriptionEn: A front squat with a band adding resistance, building strong quads and a tall, braced torso.
instructionsEn: Set up a band under your feet or anchored to the floor and attach it to the bar.
Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels against the band tension.
Keep your chest tall throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A controlled drop of the heels off a step that stretches and strengthens the calves and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it.
Hold a rail for balance.
Rise onto your toes.
Slowly lower your heels below the step level.
Pause and feel the stretch in your calves.
Raise up and repeat.

entries.nameEn: barbell hip thrust with resistance band
entries.descriptionEn: A barbell hip thrust with a band adding extra tension at the top, focused on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the loaded bar across your hips.
Set a band over your hips or around your thighs as the setup allows.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling hip thrust on the Smith machine that trains hip extension and the glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on the Smith machine at a low height and kneel facing away from it.
Place the bar across your hips with a pad for comfort.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Thrust your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A hyperextension on an angled bench with a band adding load for the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set up on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with your hips just over the pad.
Loop a band across your upper back and under your feet or the base.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump squat holding a plate at your chest, building leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate close to your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are near parallel.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat jump while holding a medicine ball, building explosive power in the legs.
instructionsEn: Hold a medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sink into a squat with your chest up.
Jump up as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump squat with a band adding resistance for a more powerful leg drive.
instructionsEn: Stand on a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Jump up explosively against the band.
Land softly through your toes and heels.
Sink immediately into the next squat.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise variation with a slight forward lean that hits the side delts with extra range.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Avoid swinging your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm lateral raise leaning away from a cable stack, giving constant tension on the side delt.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold the handle with the far hand.
Hold the upright support with the other hand and lean away from the machine.
Start with your working arm across your body.
Raise it out to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine crunch that works the full abdominal wall with adjustable resistance.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with the pads in position.
Hold the handles and keep your feet planted.
Exhale and curl your torso forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips on the seat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine crunch to the left side that trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a left side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the left.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine crunch to the right side that trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a right side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the right.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

entries.descriptionEn: A skipping move where the rope passes twice under your feet for each jump, great for conditioning and coordination.
instructionsEn: Hold the rope handles at your hips with your elbows close.
Stand tall and start with a few normal jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope faster with your wrists.
Let the rope pass twice under your feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps small and your body upright.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃组合俯卧撑划船翻举推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell complex push up row clean and press
entries.descriptionEn: A flowing combo of push-up, row, clean and press that works the whole body with a pair of dumbbells.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your ribs and switch sides.
Jump or step your feet toward your hands and stand up, cleaning the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to the floor and return to the push-up position.
Move smoothly and keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump onto and over a box that builds explosive leg power and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Step or hop down on the other side.
Turn around and repeat in the other direction.
Reset your balance between reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-armed dumbbell snatch, pulling the weight from the floor to overhead in one explosive movement. It trains the hips, legs and shoulders.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，正握。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将哑铃向地面放低，使其靠近身体。
爆发性伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝，将哑铃沿直线向上推。
当哑铃到达肩膀高度时，快速旋转你的手并将其击打过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
将哑铃举过头顶，膝盖和臀部稍微弯曲。
以受控的方式将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up with the legs in a frog position that works the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Place your hands behind your head or reach forward.
Curl up and sit all the way up.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A hanging leg raise where the knees travel up to the elbows, working the abs and hip flexors hard.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A tough hanging core move that brings the toes all the way up to the bar.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
Engage your lats and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid excessive swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A box jump that builds explosive power in the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a plyo box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright at the top.
Step down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hard-effort ride on an air bike that gets your heart rate up and trains the legs and arms.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat height and sit on the bike.
Grip the handles and push and pull with your arms.
Pedal at a steady, strong pace.
Increase the effort for intervals.
Keep your breathing controlled.
Ride for a set time or distance.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees almost straight.
Hinge at the hips and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand, keeping your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated row with a band that works the mid back and lats.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a band that strengthens the mid back and lats.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带单腿后踢(屈体姿势)
entries.nameEn: resistance band one leg kickback (bent position)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing glute kickback with a band while leaning forward, isolating one hip at a time.
instructionsEn: Loop a resistance band around your ankle and anchor the other end low in front of you.
Hold a support and lean forward slightly.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Kick your leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A pike push-up with the hands on two benches so you can lower deeper, building the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on two benches shoulder-width apart and your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips into a pike shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your hips high throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple warm-up that loosens the shoulder joints by moving the arms in circles.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles forward.
Gradually make the circles larger.
Do 10 to 15 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe normally.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push-up combined with a row that works the chest and back together.
instructionsEn: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands on the floor, or on light dumbbells.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up.
Pull one elbow toward your ribs.
Return that hand to the floor and alternate sides.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend and twist that loosens the hips and trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and one arm overhead.
Turn your feet slightly outward.
Hinge at the hips and rotate your torso toward the floor.
Reach your free hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up wearing a weighted vest for extra load on the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Put on a weighted vest and start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Repeat for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell fly with a low path that emphasizes the lower chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench or stand and hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Move the dumbbells in a wide arc.
Bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 龙门架俯身单臂侧平举
entries.nameEn: cable bent over one arm lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over one-arm cable raise that hits the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a low pulley and bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Grab the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side with a soft elbow.
Lift to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm raise in front of you that trains the front delts.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A row with wide elbows on the cable machine that targets the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height with a handle or rope.
Hold it with your arms extended.
Step back and lean slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A harder pike push-up with the feet raised, hands on benches, loading the shoulders strongly.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on two benches and your feet on a higher surface behind you.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Control the descent.

entries.nameEn: handstand shoulder press with wall (between benches)
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported handstand press between two benches for strong shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on two benches and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head between the benches by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.
Come down carefully when done.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor press with a reverse grip, which shifts more work to the triceps and upper chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with a barbell above your chest, hands in an underhand grip.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.nameZh: 单腿地雷杆罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg Romanian deadlift holding a landmine bar, challenging balance and the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the other leg behind you.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand.
Switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge holding a landmine bar at the chest, working the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps pushdown performed while sitting or lying on the floor with the cable set low.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at a low or mid position and sit on the floor facing it.
Hold the handle with elbows tucked at your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling landmine press with the hands squeezed together, working the chest and core.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the bar end close to your chest with both hands pressed together.
Brace your core.
Press the bar forward and up.
Squeeze your hands together as you press.
Lower it slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up variation where one hand slides on a towel, shifting load to one side of the chest.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a towel on the floor.
Slide that hand out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the other hand.
Push back up.
Slide the towel hand back in.
Switch sides.

entries.nameEn: landmine floor one arm chest fly
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm fly on the floor with a landmine bar, training the chest and stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor holding the landmine bar end with one hand.
Extend the arm above your chest.
Lower the bar out to the side in an arc.
Stop when your arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the bar back up.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor fly sliding hands on towels for a bodyweight chest isolation move.
instructionsEn: Kneel or get into a plank with your hands on towels.
Slide your hands out wide to the sides.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Squeeze your chest to slide your hands back together.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿地面单臂集中弯举
entries.nameEn: cable seated floor one arm concentration curl
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm cable curl with your elbow braced against the thigh, isolating the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow side-lying leg circle that works the outer hip and mobilizes the hip joint.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs stacked.
Lift the top leg slightly.
Draw small circles in the air.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your pelvis still.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat performed on your tiptoes that challenges balance, the quads and the calves.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rise onto your toes.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down while staying up on your toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
Keep your chest tall.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinge forward on one leg while the other reaches back. It builds hamstring and glute strength and trains balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift one leg out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and helps with balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, hands on your hips or on a support.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it as high as you can without leaning your torso.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where your feet jump apart and together like a jumping jack. It trains the core and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and your abs tight throughout.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up from your knees with the lower body elevated, shifting the work to the upper chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your knees on a bench or step and hands on the floor.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight and your elbows at about 45 degrees.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: Press a band overhead from behind your head to straighten the elbows. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low or stand on it and hold the other end behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your upper arms still and your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit up done with your legs supported on a chair, which keeps the movement strict. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and rest your lower legs on a chair or bench, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿胸部支撑后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: cable seated rear delt fly with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse fly on a chest-supported seat using cables. It targets the rear delts with little help from momentum.
instructionsEn: Sit facing the stack with your chest against the pad and hold the handles.
Start with your arms forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to shoulder height.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated crunch where you bring one knee and the opposite elbow together, then switch sides. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating your torso toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
Keep your chest open and move with control.

entries.nameEn: smith single arm bent over row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row against the Smith bar for a stable path. It builds the lats and upper back, one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at a low height and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar with one hand and brace the other on your thigh.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿直背交替挤压推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated upright alternate squeeze press
entries.descriptionEn: Press two dumbbells held together, one arm at a time, while seated upright. It trains the chest with a strong inner squeeze.
instructionsEn: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together in front of your chest.
Keep the two dumbbells touching.
Press one dumbbell forward until the arm is straight.
Bring it back and press with the other arm.
Keep squeezing the weights together.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up where you lift your hands at the bottom, removing momentum and building chest strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your whole body to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor briefly.
Place them back and press up.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A basic bodyweight squat that builds leg strength and mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: Move from a crawl position into a crab position to work the whole body.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your knees slightly into a low crawl.
Rotate your body and sit back into a crab position, face up.
Lift your hips.
Rotate back into the crawl and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up with a twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and twist toward one knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: Step into a lunge and drive the knee high to raise the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Push off and drive the back knee up high.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
Keep your pace steady for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotate from a front plank into a side plank to train the core.
instructionsEn: Start in a front plank on your forearms or hands.
Rotate your body to one side, lifting one arm up.
Hold briefly in a side plank.
Return to the front plank.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Step into a lunge with a twist to open the hips and loosen the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Return to centre and step back.
Alternate sides for 8-10 reps each.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk your hands and feet sideways in a front plank to train the core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand and foot out to the side.
Bring the other hand and foot to meet them.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat in one direction, then reverse.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk forward in a front plank, stepping hands and feet to challenge the core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand forward, then the other.
Follow with your feet.
Keep your hips level.
Walk forward a few steps, then back.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing bodyweight move that goes from a pike with hips high to a cobra with chest lifted. It warms up the shoulders, spine and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and toes with your hips high in an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and glide your chest forward and down between your hands.
Sweep forward and up, straightening your arms and lifting your chest into a cobra.
Keep your legs active and look slightly forward.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up into the pike, and repeat smoothly.

entries.nameZh: 前弓步转侧弓步转后弓步
entries.nameEn: forward to side to rear lunge
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge sequence that steps forward, to the side and then back with the same leg. It trains the legs and hips from three directions and challenges your balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Small alternating leg kicks while seated and leaning back. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit with your hands behind you and lean back slightly.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in short alternating moves.
Keep your core tight and your back from rounding.
Continue for time.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃胸部支撑单臂蜘蛛弯举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell single spider curl with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm curl done lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swinging.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging, dumbbell in hand.
Keep your upper arm vertical.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower fully.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up with a rotation at the top. It trains the chest and arms and adds core work.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and rotate one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A bear crawl moving sideways on hands and toes. It builds shoulder stability, core control and leg endurance.
instructionsEn: Get on hands and toes with knees just off the floor.
Keep your back flat.
Step the hand and foot on one side out, then bring the other pair along.
Move several steps one way, then return.
Stay low and keep your hips steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge held in place that ends with a kick from the back leg. It works the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Lower down until both knees are bent.
Drive up through the front foot.
Swing the back leg forward in a kick.
Return to the lunge and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Swing dumbbells in a wide arc over your head while lying on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie back on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue down to your hips.
Reverse the arc to return.

entries.descriptionEn: Sweep dumbbells from your hips to overhead in a wide arc on a flat bench. It works the shoulders and chest through a long range.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out and back in a wide arc.
Take them down toward your hips.
Reverse the arc with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated or reclined, you pull knees and chest together and then extend out again. It works the abs and hip flexors, especially the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 开合跳波比跳加俯卧撑
entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that adds a jumping jack finish and a push-up on the floor. It spikes your heart rate while working the chest, arms and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode up into a jumping jack, landing softly, then flow into the next rep.

entries.nameEn: band bent over rear lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A band raise to the sides while bent forward. It targets the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends with arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

entries.descriptionEn: Press dumbbells overhead one arm at a time. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell single leg calf raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the ball of the opposite foot, ideally on a step.
Rest your free hand on a wall or rail for balance.
Lift your heel as high as you can, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the step level, then repeat and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up followed by a hand reaching to the opposite toe. It adds core and mobility work to the chest drill.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest and push back up.
Lift your hips and reach one hand to the opposite foot.
Return to plank.
Alternate hands each rep.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿左右抬腿卷腹(地面)
entries.nameEn: seated side to side leg raise crunch on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Seated crunch with the legs swinging to one side and then the other. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit and lean back on your hands, legs lifted.
Swing both knees to one side while crunching in.
Return through the middle.
Swing to the other side.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up where one hand crosses over toward the other side. It adds an uneven challenge for the chest and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Push up and cross one hand over toward the other side.
Place it down and repeat.
Alternate the crossing hand.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃胸部支撑上斜前平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline front raise with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A front raise done chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts without momentum.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest against the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up supported on your fingertips. It challenges the hands and forearms as well as the chest.
instructionsEn: Get into a high plank on your fingertips.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up.
Reduce the range if your fingers tire.

entries.nameZh: 抬腿触胸正面平板支撑
entries.nameEn: leg lift to chest front plank
entries.descriptionEn: From a front plank, drive one knee to the chest and alternate. It trains the core and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Draw one knee toward your chest.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate legs.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: A front plank held with one arm lifted. It tests anti-rotation core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with feet wide.
Lift one hand off the floor.
Hold your hips steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up followed by a pike with a reach to the toes. It trains the chest, shoulders and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Do a push up.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Reach one hand to the opposite toe.
Return to plank and alternate.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up where your hands shift one at a time to walk in and out. It adds shoulder stability to the chest drill.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Step one hand wider, then the other.
Do another push up.
Step your hands back in.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise an EZ bar forward while rotating it. It trains the front delts with a twist.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar at thigh height.
Raise it forward to chest height.
Rotate your wrists as you lift.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃胸部支撑上斜腕弯举
entries.nameEn: barbell incline wrist curl with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A wrist curl performed chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with the barbell in hands, palms up.
Let your wrists extend gently.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃胸部支撑上斜反握蜘蛛弯举
entries.nameEn: barbell incline reverse grip spider curl with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse grip curl done chest down on an incline bench. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell overhand.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Curl the bar up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower fully with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with an EZ bar on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts.
instructionsEn: Sit on an incline bench with the EZ bar at thighs.
Keep arms straight with a slight bend.
Raise the bar to eye level.
Lower under control.
Keep your back on the pad.

entries.nameZh: EZ杠铃坐姿窄握肩部推举
entries.nameEn: ez bar seated close grip shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press with a narrow grip on the EZ bar. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding the EZ bar with a close grip at your chest.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to chest height.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃俯身宽握交替划船加强版
entries.nameEn: barbell bent over wide alternate row plus
entries.descriptionEn: A wide grip bent over row done with alternating pulls. It builds the upper back and lats.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward holding the barbell with a wide grip.
Keep your back flat.
Pull one side toward your ribs.
Lower and pull the other side.
Keep your hips still.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃俯身宽握划船加强版
entries.nameEn: barbell bent over wide row plus
entries.descriptionEn: A wide grip bent over row aimed at the upper back. It builds the lats and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a wide overhand grip.
Keep a flat back.
Row the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up on dumbbells followed by a front raise. It trains the chest, arms and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells.
Do a push up.
Lift one dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Gentle circles of the head to loosen the neck. It eases stiffness in the neck muscles.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to one side.
Continue in a smooth circle.
Do 5 circles, then reverse.

entries.descriptionEn: Swing your arms across your body, wrapping them around the trunk. It loosens the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms wide.
Wrap them around your body so the hands slap your upper back.
Open them wide again.
Keep it loose and rhythmic.

entries.descriptionEn: Draw circles with straight arms to warm up the shoulders. It loosens the shoulder joints.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles forward.
Increase to larger circles.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: Bend sideways with one arm overhead and bent. It stretches the side of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Bend one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cycling crunch bringing the elbow to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with hands behind your head.
Lift one knee while rotating your torso.
Touch your elbow to the knee.
Switch sides in a pedaling rhythm.
Stay upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge held in one place with no stepping. It builds the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Step one foot forward and stay in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Push through the front heel.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: alternate leg raise with head up
entries.descriptionEn: Raise one leg at a time while lying with your head lifted. It works the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your head slightly lifted.
Raise one leg to vertical.
Lower it without touching the floor.
Raise the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

entries.descriptionEn: A V up where you crunch your arms and legs together twice. It hits the whole abdominal wall.
instructionsEn: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Crunch in again.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A V up finishing with a clap above the legs. It trains the core and coordination.
instructionsEn: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Clap above your shins.
Lower with control.
Repeat smoothly.

entries.descriptionEn: Jogging on the spot as a warm-up or light cardio. It raises your heart rate without equipment.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Jog in place, lifting your knees.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace.
Continue for 1-5 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: Arch back to stretch the front of the trunk. It lengthens the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press your chest up.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie with legs raised and reach toward your heels. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie with your legs up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your shoulders.
Reach one hand toward the heel.
Switch sides.
Keep your legs still.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit up with straight legs. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower with control.
Do not pull on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with the arms extended overhead, which lengthens the lever and makes it harder. It focuses on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms straight overhead.
Bend your knees.
Crunch up reaching forward.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms by your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead cable press from a kneeling position. It builds the shoulders and demands core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a low cable and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your abs.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower under control.
Keep your hips tall.

entries.nameEn: cable bent over row with bar
entries.descriptionEn: A bent over row with a cable and straight bar. It builds the lats and mid-back.
instructionsEn: Face the low pulley and hinge forward holding the bar.
Keep a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your waist.
Squeeze your back.
Extend your arms slowly.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜交叉后三角肌飞鸟
entries.descriptionEn: A rear fly using crossed cables on an incline bench. It targets the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cables, holding opposite handles.
Keep elbows slightly bent.
Pull your arms out and back.
Pause.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral raise performed lying down using a crossing cable. It isolates the side delts.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a cable running across your body.
Hold the handle with the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable front raise. It targets the front delts with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a low pulley.
Hold the handle with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arm to eye level.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜窄握推举变式
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline close grip press variation
entries.descriptionEn: A close grip dumbbell press on an incline. It targets the triceps and upper chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells together over your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Lower to your chest.
Press up.
Keep the dumbbells touching.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug with a barbell while seated. It builds the upper traps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding the barbell at thigh level.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders to your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿单臂蜘蛛弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A standing one-arm spider curl bent forward. It isolates the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand and hinge forward, bracing against a support.
Let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl up.
Squeeze.
Lower and switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 地面仰卧抬髋抬腿 v. 2
entries.nameEn: lying leg hip raise on floor v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Lift your hips off the floor with your legs raised. It focuses on the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs raised.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Curl the knees and hips up toward the chest. It works the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your legs.
Curl hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying leg raises with legs crossing over each other. It targets the lower abs and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight and raised.
Lower them slightly.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch the cross.
Keep your lower back down.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated crunch where the legs trace a figure eight in the air. It works the lower abs and hip flexors while you balance on your seat.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and support yourself with your hands behind you.
Lift both feet off the floor and brace your core.
Draw a figure eight in the air with your legs, slow and controlled.
Keep your chest lifted and your lower back from collapsing.
Lower your feet and rest, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm or high plank where you reach a foot out to tap the floor. It trains core stability and hip control.
instructionsEn: Start in a front plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot and tap the toes out to the side without twisting your hips.
Bring the foot back to the start.
Repeat on the other leg and keep alternating.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing overhead warming up
entries.descriptionEn: A light band warm-up that presses the arms overhead to wake up the shoulders before training.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band with both hands at chest height.
Keep a slight tension in the band.
Raise your arms overhead in a smooth arc.
Lower back to chest height slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without shrugging.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing down warming up
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle band warm-up that pulls the arms down from overhead to prepare the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold the band overhead with both hands, a little wider than shoulder width.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Pull your hands down in front of you toward your chest.
Return slowly overhead keeping tension.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing front warming up
entries.descriptionEn: A band warm-up with the arms moving in front of the body, loosening the shoulders and chest before a workout.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band in front of you at shoulder height.
