Keep your arms mostly straight.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band across your chest.
Bring your hands back together slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing back warming up
entries.descriptionEn: A band warm-up that pulls the arms behind the body to activate the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the band apart and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly then return slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without arching your lower back.

entries.nameEn: resistance band squatting front warming up
entries.descriptionEn: A warm-up from a low squat position, moving a band in front of you to loosen the shoulders and hips together.
instructionsEn: Hold the band in front of you and sink into a comfortable deep squat.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band at shoulder height.
Bring your hands back together under control.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps, then stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing leg movement against a band that squeezes the thigh inward. It strengthens the inner thigh.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Pull the working leg across in front of the other leg.
Pause for a moment and return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Wide stance squat holding one dumbbell by its bar between the legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell vertically by its bar with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down while keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing leg raise to the side against a band. It targets the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle farthest from the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side without leaning.
Pause, then lower slowly against the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing leg curl using a band around the ankle. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall facing the anchor and hold a support.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your thighs together and hips still.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing kick-back against a band that works the glutes and the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor, holding a support and keeping your torso upright.
Press the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent over kick-back against a band. The hinged torso gives the glutes and hamstrings a deeper stretch and squeeze.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, hands on a support.
Extend the working leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Leg curl with a tube band around the ankle, building the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop the handle around one ankle.
Face the anchor and hold a support for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees close and your hips steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: landmine one arm bent over row
entries.descriptionEn: One arm row with the end of a landmine bar. It builds the lats and mid back with a smooth arc.
instructionsEn: Load the landmine bar and stand over it with a hip hinge, knees soft.
Grip the bar end with one hand and keep your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管单臂凳上俯身划船
entries.nameEn: landmine one arm bent over bench row
entries.descriptionEn: A supported one arm landmine row with your free hand and knee on a bench. It keeps the lower back relaxed while you pull.
instructionsEn: Set the landmine bar next to a bench and place one hand and knee on the bench.
Grip the bar end with your free hand and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管后撤弓步蹲 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Reverse lunge holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The bar adds load and encourages an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar end against your chest with both hands.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front heel down and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俄罗斯转体(稳定球)
entries.descriptionEn: Rotating a dumbbell side to side while balanced on a stability ball. It challenges the obliques and balance.
instructionsEn: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated trunk rotation pulling a cable across the body. It works the obliques and deep core.
instructionsEn: Sit next to a cable machine set at chest height and grab the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms extended in front of you.
Rotate your torso away from the stack, pulling the handle across your body.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your hips still, finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging from parallel bars, you shrug your shoulder blades up and down. It builds the traps and shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
Repeat for controlled reps.

entries.nameEn: single leg glute bridge with knee to chest
entries.descriptionEn: One leg glute bridge where the free knee is hugged toward the chest. It strengthens the glutes and challenges hip stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Side lunge holding a kettlebell at the chest. It trains the thighs, glutes and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructionsEn: Hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands and stand tall.
Take a big step to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Deadlift from a wide stance with a kettlebell between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and toes angled out, the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the kettlebell under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Dead bug with a kettlebell held above the chest. The weight adds challenge to the core while the limbs move.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Slowly extend one leg while pressing your lower back into the floor.
Bring the leg back and switch.
Keep the kettlebell steady and breathe.

entries.descriptionEn: Split squat with the dumbbell held on the same side as the working front leg. It tests balance and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step into a split stance, the dumbbell on the same side as your front leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging inverted, you move your shoulder blades to lift the body slightly. It builds the traps and scapular control.
instructionsEn: Set up under a bar or rings and hang with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to rise a little.
Hold briefly, then lower to a full hang.
Repeat for controlled reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Hip thrust with a band across the hips for resistance. It is a direct glute builder.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band across your hips, anchored to each side.
Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head supported.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Lift the top leg up with the toes pointing forward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rope waves from a half kneeling stance. It raises the heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a rope end in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Make fast alternating waves with your arms.
Keep the rhythm steady for a set time.
Switch the front leg for the next set.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿吉特尔森耸肩
entries.descriptionEn: Seated shrug variation with a dumbbell in each hand that builds the upper traps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without rolling your shoulders.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂三头肌伸展(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm triceps extension on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: Overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell while seated on a stability ball. The ball adds a core challenge.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arm back up.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿侧平举(稳定球)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated lateral raise on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: Seated side raise performed on a stability ball. It trains the side delts and trunk balance.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Dead bug holding a stability ball between hands and knees. It builds deep core control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and hold the ball above your chest with your knees raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg away, holding the ball with the rest.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides slowly.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell turkish get up to hand
entries.descriptionEn: The first part of a Turkish get up, rising from the floor to a seated position on your hand while holding a kettlebell overhead.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same-side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Hold the seated position with your arm vertical.
Reverse the steps to lie back down, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Advanced core move where the body stays straight while you raise and lower the legs from a bench. It strongly trains the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.

entries.descriptionEn: Split squat holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and take a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up combined with extending an opposite arm and leg. It builds the chest while testing core balance.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up with elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg and hold briefly.
Return and alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat to a bench with bands adding tension. It teaches depth control and builds the glutes and thighs.
instructionsEn: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back with bands attached.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees pushing out.
Drive through your heels to stand.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆仰卧弹力带T杠划船
entries.nameEn: lever lying banded t bar row
entries.descriptionEn: Chest-supported T bar row on a lever machine with bands for extra resistance as you pull.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on the support and grip the handles.
Keep your head neutral.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing curl using a band under your feet. It builds the biceps with rising tension.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Back squat with chains hanging from the bar, so the load grows as you stand. It builds leg strength through the whole range.
instructionsEn: Set chains on the bar and unrack it onto your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your core braced throughout.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿交替阿诺德推举
entries.descriptionEn: Rotating press with dumbbells, done one arm at a time while standing. It works all parts of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Brace your core.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower while rotating back.
Alternate arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿俯身交替后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated bent over alternate rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: Seated bent over fly done one arm at a time to hit the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Sit at the edge of a bench and lean forward with dumbbells hanging below your knees.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly bent.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated Arnold press alternating arms. The twist works the front and side delts.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower it while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching.

entries.descriptionEn: Bench press with three boards on the chest limiting the range. It overloads the lockout phase.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with three boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

entries.descriptionEn: Bench press with two boards on the chest, giving a slightly longer range than the three board press.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with two boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

entries.descriptionEn: Bench press with a single board, shortening the range just a little. It builds pressing power near lockout.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a single board on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the board.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃胸部支撑上斜单臂前平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline one arm front raise with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: Front raise with your chest supported on an incline bench to reduce swinging. It isolates the front delts.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: One leg squat with your back against a wall for balance. It builds single leg strength.
instructionsEn: Lean your back on a wall and lift one foot off the floor.
Place your standing foot forward.
Slide down into a squat as far as you can control.
Press through your heel to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Chest fly with the band anchored low, so you sweep your arms up and together. It focuses on the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Sweep your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing a band upward from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at chest level.
Step forward into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing band fly bringing the hands together in front of the chest. It trains the pecs.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带交叉单臂胸部推举
entries.nameEn: band cross body one arm chest press
entries.descriptionEn: Single arm band press that travels across the body, working the chest and core.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you and hold the end in one hand.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press your hand forward and across your body.
Return slowly while resisting rotation.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带低位交替胸部推举
entries.descriptionEn: Alternating band presses from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand up and forward.
Return, then press the other hand.
Keep your core braced.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带低位交替胸部飞鸟
entries.descriptionEn: Alternating single arm chest fly from a low anchor.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Sweep one arm up and across in front of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿交替胸部推举
entries.descriptionEn: Standing band press, one arm at a time, hitting the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand straight forward.
Return and press the other hand.
Keep your torso steady.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling crunch against a band anchored overhead. It trains the abs with steady resistance.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, focusing on the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and lift your feet.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing side bend with a band stretched overhead, training the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends overhead.
Keep your core braced.
Bend sideways at your waist.
Return to upright.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Crunch lifting just the upper torso against a band for resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band anchored overhead, ends in hand.
Hold the band near your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A band curl done with the band pulling horizontally, which keeps constant tension on your biceps through the whole range.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and face away from the anchor, holding the ends.
Step out until the band is taut and raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your arms again.
Keep your elbows level with your shoulders the whole time.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带跪姿牧师凳弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A curl performed kneeling with your upper arms braced on a bench or pad, so the biceps do the work without momentum.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and kneel facing it with your upper arms resting on a bench or pad.
Hold the band ends with palms up and arms extended.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms pressed down on the pad.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic standing curl with a band underfoot. It builds the biceps with smooth, rising resistance.
instructionsEn: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and grip the ends.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists neutral throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A band curl with your arms angled about 45 degrees behind your body, which stretches the biceps and works the long head.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends, then set your arms about 45 degrees behind your torso.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Curl your hands up while your upper arms stay in that angled position.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.
Avoid leaning back to finish the rep.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带胸前交叉二头弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A hammer-style curl that crosses the band toward the opposite shoulder, hitting the biceps and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Curl one hand across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower under control, then repeat on the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide stance squat holding a kettlebell between your legs, working your glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide stance squat holding the end of a landmine barbell at your chest, which trains glutes and legs with an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the landmine anchor with a wide stance and hold the bar end against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in.
Sit down between your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor exercise where you lift your limbs off the ground and add a rotation, training the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension with added weight that isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench and hold the weight overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Keep your back straight and core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: An ab wheel rollout where a wall stops the wheel, making it a safer way to train your abs and core.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Grip the handles and tuck your pelvis under.
Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull the wheel back by contracting your abs.
Keep your back flat and avoid sagging at the hips.

entries.nameZh: 悬吊带弓步蹲加后侧飞鸟
entries.nameEn: suspender forward lunge with rear fly
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge combined with a rear delt fly on suspension straps, working legs, shoulders and upper back together.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps with both hands, leaning back slightly with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
As you lower, pull your arms out wide in a rear fly.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and bring your hands together.
Switch legs on the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch paired with a leg raise to train both the upper and lower abdominals.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended.
Crunch your shoulders off the floor.
At the same time lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying core move with your feet pressed against a wall, tapping each heel alternately to challenge your lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on a wall.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while the other foot stays on the wall.
Return and tap with the other heel.
Move slowly without arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse crunch that flows into a dead bug, training lower abs and control of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis off the floor in a reverse crunch.
Lower your hips and extend one leg and the opposite arm.
Return to the start, then repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral lunge holding a kettlebell, working glutes, quads and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Take a big step to the side.
Sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: medicine ball half kneeling chest push
entries.descriptionEn: A half kneeling chest pass motion with a medicine ball that trains pushing power and core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Push the ball forward explosively or against a wall.
Catch it or bring it back to your chest.
Switch the kneeling leg after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A hack squat on a sled with a wide foot position, stressing the quads, glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Set your back on the pad and place your feet wide and slightly turned out on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking out.
Keep your hips and back against the pad.

entries.nameEn: weighted straight leg toe touch crunch
entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with straight legs raised, reaching toward your toes while holding a weight for extra resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight up and a weight held in both hands.
Reach the weight toward your toes.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your legs vertical and your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A chin up with added load, building pulling strength in your lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Attach the weight with a belt and grip the bar with palms facing you.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower under control to full extension.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug done holding a trap bar at your sides, loading the traps with a neutral grip.
instructionsEn: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it, holding the handles at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and do not roll your shoulders.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent over row using a trap bar, working your back and arms with a neutral grip.
instructionsEn: Stand in the trap bar and hinge forward with a flat back, gripping the handles.
Brace your core.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A trap bar deadlift while standing on a raised platform, increasing range of motion for legs and back.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low platform inside the trap bar.
Squat down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Brace and push the floor away.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar with control to the start.

entries.nameZh: 绳索分腿站姿水平帕洛夫推举
entries.nameEn: cable split stance horizontal pallof press
entries.descriptionEn: An anti-rotation press from a split stance that teaches your core to resist twisting.
instructionsEn: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return the handle to your chest, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A sumo deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, shortening the pull and loading hips, legs and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with a wide stance and toes out in front of a bar on blocks.
Grip the bar inside your knees and set a flat back.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

entries.descriptionEn: The rotating shoulder press popularized by Arnold, hitting all heads of the delts.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms overhead.
Lower while rotating back to palms facing you.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with a band pulling you outward, adding inner thigh work.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band to the side and loop it around the working leg.
Step into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press back up while resisting the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated curl that turns your palms down on the way back, training biceps and forearms.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly in that reverse grip.
Rotate your palms back up at the bottom.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated shrug using a horizontal cable pull, keeping steady tension on the traps.
instructionsEn: Sit facing a low cable with a handle in each hand.
Start with arms straight and shoulders forward.
Pull your shoulders back and up.
Squeeze your traps at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated battle rope waves that raise your heart rate while working the arms and core.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor or a bench holding the ends of the ropes.
Brace your core.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating waves.
Keep a steady fast rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
Rest, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge using a landmine barbell, training hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand holding the end of the bar close to your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back.
Feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带俯身后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: resistance band bent over rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: A bent over fly with a band that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 绳索过头三头肌伸展(直杆)
entries.nameEn: cable overhead tricep extension straight bar
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead cable extension with a straight bar, stretching and loading the triceps.
instructionsEn: Set a straight bar on a low pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar overhead with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Lower the bar back behind your head slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide stance deadlift variation using a very wide grip, training hips and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with a wide stance and hold the bar with a wide grip.
Set a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to lift.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push up that moves only the shoulder blades, strengthening the muscles that stabilize them.
instructionsEn: Kneel in a plank position with straight arms.
Keep your elbows locked.
Let your chest sink by pinching your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread them apart.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump squat with hands behind your head for an explosive leg workout.
instructionsEn: Stand with your hands behind your head and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly on bent knees.
Go straight into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension done on a sled machine, giving steady load through the whole motion.
instructionsEn: Set up on the sled and grip the handles or bar.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend your arms to straighten them.
Squeeze your triceps at the end.
Return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿单臂阿诺德推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated one arm arnold press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one arm Arnold press for shoulders with rotation through the movement.
instructionsEn: Sit upright with a dumbbell in one hand at chest height, palm facing you.
Press up while rotating your palm forward.
Fully extend overhead.
Lower while rotating back.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: single arm push up on medicine ball
entries.descriptionEn: A hard push up with one hand on a medicine ball, challenging balance and chest strength.
instructionsEn: Place one hand on the ball and the other on the floor in a plank.
Spread your feet for balance.
Lower your chest toward the ball.
Press back up.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A single arm reverse fly on a cable to isolate the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a cable at shoulder height and grab the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Pull your arm across and back in an arc.
Squeeze your rear delt.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat holding one kettlebell on one side, challenging legs and core stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug holding a medicine ball overhead to add trunk control demand.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a medicine ball above your chest, knees bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the ball overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell face down lying shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A face down press on an incline bench that works the rear shoulder.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells at ear height.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the bench.

entries.descriptionEn: A row starting from the rack pins, resetting every rep for strict pulling.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on pins at knee height.
Hinge forward and grip the bar.
Row it to your lower ribs.
Lower it back to the pins and pause.
Reset your back before the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug with added weight to increase core work.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a weight above your chest.
Raise your knees over your hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides, keeping your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a weight out in front as a counterweight, helping you stay upright.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight at chest height and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward as you descend.
Squat until thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand back up through your heels.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg skater squat with a counterweight held in front for balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight out in front and stand on one leg.
Bend your standing knee while reaching your rear leg back.
Lower until your rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A skullcrusher that mixes a pullover motion, loading the triceps from a long position.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding an ez bar above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead.
Let it travel back past your head slightly.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.nameZh: 战绳交替波浪加跪姿起身
entries.nameEn: battling ropes alternating waves with kneeling get up
entries.descriptionEn: Alternating rope waves mixed with standing up from kneeling for a full body conditioning move.
instructionsEn: Kneel holding the rope ends.
Make alternating waves with your arms.
Rise to a standing position while continuing.
Wave for a few more seconds.
Return to kneeling and repeat.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell sumo deadlift with high pull
entries.descriptionEn: A sumo deadlift flowing into a high pull, working legs, hips and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand wide over a kettlebell and grip it with both hands.
Drive up through your legs.
Pull it to chin height with elbows high.
Lower it under control.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-sided deadlift holding the kettlebell at your side like a suitcase, training the core as well.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a kettlebell and hinge to grip it.
Keep your back flat.
Stand up without leaning sideways.
Lower it back to the floor.
Switch hands after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A step up holding a kettlebell, training each leg separately.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with a band adding resistance for the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band in a split stance and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical.
Push back up.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip abduction with a band that crosses the body, working the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop it around your outer ankle.
Stand tall and hold support if needed.
Move that leg across then out to the side.
Control the return.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat paired with a band twist for core and legs.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways, holding the end.
Squat down.
Rise and rotate your arms away from the anchor.
Return to the center.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A band curl with a narrow hand position to emphasize the outer biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and grip it close to your feet with a narrow hold.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Squeeze the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头三头肌伸展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second version of the band overhead extension for the triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows behind your head.
Extend your arms upward.
Keep your elbows close to your ears.
Lower under control.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头单臂三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: band overhead single arm triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A one arm overhead band extension to isolate each triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the other end overhead with one hand.
Bend your elbow behind your head.
Extend your arm upward.
Keep your upper arm still.
Switch arms after your set.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头单臂三头肌伸展 v. 2
entries.nameEn: band overhead single arm triceps extension v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second version of the one arm overhead band extension.
instructionsEn: Anchor or stand on the band and hold it overhead in one hand.
Bend your elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Extend your arm fully.
Keep your core tight.
Switch arms after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying pressdown with an underhand grip, targeting the triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and grip it palms up.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Press your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A kickback with a band for the back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the other end.
Pin your upper arm to your side.
Extend your elbow straight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinge forward and pull a band down toward your hips, like a lat pulldown from a bent over position. It trains the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull the band down toward your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom for a moment.
Let the band rise slowly until your arms are straight again.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: A row with the hands close together against band tension. It works the mid back and lats with extra focus on the elbows staying tight to the body.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and hold both ends with hands close together.
Step back until the band is taut and stand tall with soft knees.
Row your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows brushing your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂转体划船
entries.nameEn: band standing single arm twist row
entries.descriptionEn: A one arm band row where you rotate the torso as you pull. It trains the lats and back while the trunk resists and controls the twist.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand sideways to the anchor with feet shoulder width apart.
Row the handle toward your ribs while turning your torso gently toward the pulling side.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, untwisting as your arm extends.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A high row with a narrow grip against a band. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders as you pull toward the face.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at or above head height and grip it with hands close together.
Step back until there is tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows high and out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带窄握高位划船 v. 2
entries.nameEn: band narrow grip high row v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second variation of the narrow grip high row using a band. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and grip it with hands close together.
Step back to create tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest fly performed lying on the floor, which limits the range at the bottom to protect the shoulders. It isolates the pecs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Soften your elbows slightly and keep that bend.
Open your arms wide until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly without resting your weight.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above you.
Move slowly and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

entries.descriptionEn: A single arm fly that sweeps the dumbbell from low up to the chest. It works the upper pecs and front shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet staggered and hold a dumbbell at your side with a slight elbow bend.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sweep the dumbbell out and up in an arc to chest height in front of you.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly along the same arc.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension lying on the floor, bending only at the elbows. The floor limits the range and keeps tension on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and avoid flaring them.

entries.descriptionEn: A biceps curl with the dumbbells held close together. This emphasises the outer biceps through a controlled curl.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding dumbbells with palms forward and hands close together.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid swinging your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up where one arm does most of the work while the other extends out to the side. It builds unilateral chest and arm strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a wide push up position with hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one arm and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up and shift to the centre.
Alternate or complete reps on one side, then switch.

entries.nameZh: 负重坐姿中立握腕弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A seated wrist curl with palms facing each other. It strengthens the forearms and wrists.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand hanging past the knee.
Hold the weight with a neutral grip, thumb up.
Curl your wrist up toward your forearm.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your wrist is extended.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated calf raise with weight resting on your thighs. The bent knee focuses the work on the soleus beneath the calf.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with feet flat and the weight resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised edge if possible.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly below the edge for a stretch.
Hold the weight steady throughout.

entries.nameEn: lying leg hip side raise on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A side lying raise where you lift both legs together toward the ceiling. It works the obliques and the sides of your trunk.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with legs stacked and straight.
Rest your head on your lower arm and brace your core.
Lift both legs together a short way off the floor.
Pause at the top, squeezing your side.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
Complete reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿前后泰特推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated front and back tate press
entries.descriptionEn: A seated triceps move where the dumbbells go from the chest outward in front and back. It hits the triceps from a unique angle.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms close to your torso.
Lower the weights with elbows flared until they touch your chest.
Extend your elbows to push the weights up and slightly forward.
Return to the start in a controlled path.
Keep your back straight and avoid arching.

entries.descriptionEn: A side crunch holding a weight to load the obliques. It builds strength along the sides of the waist.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with knees bent and hold a weight against your chest.
Support your head lightly.
Crunch your top ribs toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Lower slowly without losing tension.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up followed by a quick kick of one leg through underneath your body. It builds chest strength with coordination.
instructionsEn: Start in a push up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest and press back up.
Lift one hand and rotate, sweeping the opposite leg through underneath you.
Return the leg and hand to the starting position.
Repeat the push up and kick on the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a squat while lifting and lowering your heels. It combines quad endurance with calf work.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and lower into a half squat.
Hold that depth with your chest up.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat while holding the squat position.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: Step back into a lunge and raise the dumbbells in front. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you lower, raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Lower the dumbbells as you return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up where you pull a knee toward your elbow after each rep. It adds a core challenge to a standard push up.
instructionsEn: Start in a push up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Bring one knee toward the same side elbow.
Return the foot and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A wrist curl using cable resistance on one arm. It strengthens the forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit by a low pulley with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Hold the handle with your palm facing up.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A full body move: burpee onto dumbbells, then swing them overhead. It builds power and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and place the dumbbells on the floor, then step or jump your feet back.
Do a push up if you like.
Jump your feet forward and stand up, swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control.
Keep your back flat and move with rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive jump squat holding a trap bar. It develops lower body power.
instructionsEn: Stand inside a trap bar with feet shoulder width apart.
Grip the handles and stand tall.
Squat down quickly with your chest up.
Jump up explosively off the floor.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset before the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell swing with a band adding tension at the hips. It builds hip drive and posterior chain power.
instructionsEn: Set up with the band around your hips and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward powerfully.
Let the kettlebell rise to chest height.
Guide it back between your legs as you hinge.
Keep your back flat and arms relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg squat to a box followed by a jump. It builds balance and explosive leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a box on one leg, other leg forward.
Squat down on one leg to touch the box.
Drive through your heel and jump upward.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control your balance and reset.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single leg squat with an explosive jump at the top. It trains leg power and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Lower into a single leg squat.
Explode upward off the standing leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Sink back into the next squat.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor. It challenges the core and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A partial deadlift from knee height on a Smith machine. It overloads the back and hips.
instructionsEn: Set the bar at knee height in the Smith machine.
Grip the bar and set your back flat.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the bar to the start with control.
Keep the bar close to your legs.

entries.nameZh: 徒手俯身后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: bodyweight bent over rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: A bent over fly using only your arms as resistance. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back and arms hanging down.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃弹力带罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift with a band adding resistance as you stand. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with it attached to the barbell and hold the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees.
Lower the bar along your legs to mid shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆反向肩部推举(挂片式)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate loaded press with a reverse grip on a lever machine. It targets the front shoulders.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with a reverse grip.
Press the handles up until your arms are extended.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead press with weight in hand. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, weight at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the weight straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower slowly to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug performed supported on parallel bars. It lifts and lowers the shoulders to train the traps.
instructionsEn: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Let your shoulders sink down.
Push up to elevate your shoulders toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your elbows locked.

entries.descriptionEn: A hang from a bar where you pull your shoulder blades down and up. It strengthens the upper back and improves shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull up bar with straight arms.
Relax your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down, lifting your body slightly.
Pause briefly.
Relax back to the hang.
Keep your elbows straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell squat with heels on a plate for extra knee travel. It emphasises the quads.
instructionsEn: Place your heels on small plates under the bar.
Set the bar on your upper back.
Brace your core and squat down.
Keep your torso upright.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep Smith machine squat with a band adding resistance. It builds quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach the band to the Smith machine and set the bar on your back.
Place feet slightly forward of the bar.
Squat as deep as you can with control.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Stand tall without locking hard.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated pullover using a cable. It isolates the lats with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Sit at a high pulley holding the rope or bar with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward.
Pull the handle down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with arms straight.
Avoid bending your elbows.

entries.nameZh: 负重悬垂反握引体向上
entries.descriptionEn: A chin up from a dead hang with added weight. It builds lats and biceps strength.
instructionsEn: Attach weight and hang from the bar with palms facing you.
Start from straight arms.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower fully with control.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide rowing motion with a resistance band. It strengthens the rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles.
Step back for tension.
Pull your hands out to the sides with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated move combining an upright row, rotation and press. It strengthens shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your thighs.
Row them up to chest height with elbows high.
Rotate your forearms upward.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse the path slowly.
Use light weights.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell bench press with a band adding tension at lockout. It builds chest strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with a band across your upper back and hands.
Hold dumbbells at chest level.
Press up against the band.
Lock out at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A step up combined with an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold weight at your shoulders and stand facing a bench.
Step up with one foot.
As you stand, press the weight overhead.
Lower the weight as you step down.
Alternate legs.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a band held overhead. It improves mobility and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold it overhead with wide grip.
Brace your core.
Squat down keeping arms overhead.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your arms in line with your ears.

entries.nameEn: ez bar legs side pull in sit up
entries.descriptionEn: A sit up with legs pulled to the side while holding an EZ bar. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar over your chest.
Bend your knees.
Sit up while pulling your knees to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep the bar stable.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse crunch holding an EZ bar behind your head. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar overhead.
Lift your legs with knees bent.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms steady.

entries.descriptionEn: Roll the EZ bar forward from a kneeling position and back. It strongly challenges the core.
instructionsEn: Kneel holding the EZ bar on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll forward with a flat back.
Stop before your back sags.
Pull the bar back to the start.
Keep your hips in line.

entries.descriptionEn: Move the EZ bar in an arc with a twist. It trains the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand holding the EZ bar in front of you.
Raise it overhead.
Lower it diagonally across your body, twisting.
Return overhead.
Alternate sides.
Move with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Short range lateral raises that keep tension on the side delts.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides.
Stay within the mid range, between hip and shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid shrugging.

entries.descriptionEn: A push up on your knuckles to keep wrists straight. It builds chest and arm strength.
instructionsEn: Make fists and place them under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest.
Press up.
Keep wrists neutral.
Brace your core.

entries.nameZh: 绳索半跪姿帕洛夫推举
entries.descriptionEn: Press a cable away from your chest while kneeling on one knee. It trains anti rotation.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee side on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out.
Resist the twist.
Bring it back.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A rotator cuff exercise in a half kneeling stance.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee beside a cable at elbow height.
Hold the handle with elbow at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band half kneeling face pull
entries.descriptionEn: A face pull in a half kneeling stance with a band.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at face height.
Kneel on one knee.
Pull the handles toward your face.
Flare your elbows.
Return slowly.
Keep your chest up.

entries.nameZh: 绳索半跪姿内收肌帕洛夫推举
entries.nameEn: cable half kneeling adductor pallof press
entries.descriptionEn: A pallof press with the inner thigh engaged.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the cable at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Press it forward.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索帕洛夫推举加臀桥
entries.nameEn: cable pallof press with glute bridge
entries.descriptionEn: Combine a pallof press with a glute bridge.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a cable beside you.
Hold the handle at your chest.
Bridge your hips up.
Press the handle forward.
Return and lower.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Drop off a box and hop over a hurdle.
instructionsEn: Stand on a box.
Step off.
Land softly.
Jump over the hurdle immediately.
Land softly.
Reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with chains adding load toward lockout.
instructionsEn: Set chains on the bar.
Grip the bar.
Brace.
Drive your feet through the floor.
Stand tall.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest fly with chains adding load.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with chains.
Hold weights above your chest.
Open arms.
Stretch your chest.
Bring weights together.
Keep elbows soft.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with chains adding load.
instructionsEn: Lie on bench.
Unrack the bar.
Lower to chest.
Press up.
Lock out.
Keep feet planted.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管弹力带单臂肩部推举
entries.nameEn: landmine resistance band one arm shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: One arm landmine press with a band.
instructionsEn: Hold the landmine end at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press up and forward.
Lock out.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide stance deadlift with band resistance.
instructionsEn: Set the band over the bar.
Stand wide.
Grip inside your legs.
Drive up.
Squeeze glutes.
Lower with control.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助北欧腿弯举
entries.nameEn: resistance band assisted nordic hamstring curl
entries.descriptionEn: A nordic curl using a band for assistance.
instructionsEn: Kneel with ankles secured.
Hold the band.
Lower your body forward.
Use the band to help.
Pull back up.
Keep hips extended.

entries.descriptionEn: Dips with a band looped around the bars to take some of your weight. It builds triceps and chest strength while you work toward unassisted dips.
instructionsEn: Loop a band around the dip bars and set your knees or feet in it.
Grip the bars and straighten your arms with your chest up.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows close and your shoulders down.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助反握引体向上(从膝盖)
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up with a band under one knee to lighten the load. It builds lats and biceps on the way to full chin-ups.
instructionsEn: Attach a band to a pull-up bar and place one knee in the loop.
Grab the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Hang with your arms straight and your core tight.
Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Switch knees halfway through your sets.

entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up variation where you pull your body around the bar rather than straight over it. It challenges lats, biceps and grip.
instructionsEn: Grab the bar with an underhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your core and pull your elbows down.
Pull your chest toward the bar, sweeping your head around one side.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control back to a full hang.
Alternate the side you pass on each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Jump up onto a box with both feet and step or drop down with one. It builds explosive leg power and single-leg control.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step down with one leg first, then the other.
Reset and repeat, alternating the leading leg.
Land quietly with bent knees.

entries.descriptionEn: Push off with one leg to land on a box with both feet. It trains explosive single-leg power and a stable landing.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box on one leg.
Drive your arms up and push off explosively from that leg.
Land softly on the box with both feet at once.
Stand fully upright before stepping down.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A snatch where you drop into a split stance as the kettlebell goes overhead. It trains hip power, shoulder stability and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand over a kettlebell in a hip hinge with a flat back.
Swing it back, then drive your hips forward.
As the bell rises, step into a split stance and punch it overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bell resting behind your wrist.
Stand up, bring your feet together and lower the bell to a swing.
Switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder series that moves the dumbbells through four raise positions in one set. It hits all heads of the delts with light weight.
instructionsEn: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand and a slight knee bend.
Raise both arms out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower, then raise them to the front to shoulder height.
Lower, then hinge forward slightly and raise them out to the rear.
Return and finish with a raise to the sides again.
Keep the weights light and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Balance on one leg while reaching the other foot toward points of an imaginary star. It builds stability, control and ankle strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach your free foot forward and tap lightly, then return.
Tap out to the side, then return.
Tap behind you, then return.
Keep your hips level and chest tall.
Switch legs after a set of taps.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine chest press with bands adding extra resistance at the top. It builds the chest and triceps with a stable path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad.
Grip the handles and press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Feel the band tension build as you lock out.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded machine row pulling from low to your torso. It builds the mid back and lats with a guided path.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet planted.
Grab both handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment at the end.
Let the arms extend slowly under control.
Do not lean back to move the weight.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆单臂低位划船(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever one arm low row (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm version of the plate-loaded low row. Working one side at a time helps fix strength differences in your back.
instructionsEn: Sit with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended and shoulder relaxed forward.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Swing from bar to bar along a horizontal ladder. It builds grip, shoulders and back with a playful challenge.
instructionsEn: Grab the first bar with both hands and hang.
Swing your body slightly and reach for the next bar with one hand.
Release the back hand and reach for the following bar.
Keep a steady rhythm using your hips for momentum.
Continue to the end of the ladder.
Drop down softly and rest before the next pass.

entries.descriptionEn: A lat pulldown with a wide handle that keeps your palms facing each other. It builds back width with less wrist strain.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station and lock your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral-grip handles with straight arms.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause, then let the bar rise slowly.
Do not swing your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a safety squat bar held in front using its handles. It loads the quads and keeps your torso upright.
instructionsEn: Set the safety bar on a rack and step under the pad.
Hold the handles, rest the pad on your shoulders and unrack.
Step back and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest tall and elbows up.
Go as deep as you can with good form.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A safety bar squat with your heels raised on a small platform. The elevation lets your knees travel forward to target the quads.
instructionsEn: Place plates or a wedge under your heels in front of the rack.
Unrack the safety bar and step onto the platform.
Keep your chest upright and brace your core.
Squat down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Press up and rack the bar when done.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling a handheld foam roller along your forearm to ease tight muscles. It is a quick self-massage for grip and wrists.
instructionsEn: Rest your forearm on a table, palm up.
Hold the tiger tail roller in your other hand.
Roll slowly from wrist to elbow with moderate pressure.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Turn your palm down and repeat.
Switch arms and roll for 30-60 seconds each.

entries.descriptionEn: Using a handheld roller on the back of your thigh to loosen tight hamstrings. It works well before or after leg training.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg extended.
Hold the roller by both handles on the back of your thigh.
Roll from the knee toward your hip with steady pressure.
Slow down on tight spots.
Keep breathing and keep the leg relaxed.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Gently rolling a handheld roller along the back and sides of the neck. It helps loosen stiff neck and upper trap muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Hold the roller by both handles behind your neck.
Roll gently up and down along one side with light pressure.
Avoid pressing on the spine itself.
Repeat on the other side.
Roll for 30-60 seconds and stop if it hurts.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling the outer side of your lower leg with a handheld roller. It eases tension in the muscles along the outside of the calf.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg bent or extended and the outer shin facing up.
Hold the roller by the handles on the outside of your lower leg.
Roll from the ankle to just below the knee.
Use gentle pressure and avoid the bone.
Pause on any tight areas.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pallof press done lying on your back that resists rotation. It strengthens the deep core and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back beside a low cable pulley with a handle in both hands.
Hold the handle at your chest, arms bent.
Brace your core to stay flat.
Press your arms straight up while resisting the cable pull.
Hold a second, then bring the handle back to your chest.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An upright row done lying on your back with a low cable. The lying position takes your lower back out of the movement.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley.
Hold a bar or handle with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Pull the handle up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Keep the handle close to your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug performed lying down with a cable pulling from your feet. It trains the upper traps with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a low pulley near your feet.
Hold the handle with straight arms down by your sides.
Shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise lying on your back using a low cable. It isolates the front delts without any body swing.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your head toward a low pulley.
Hold the handle with straight arms by your hips.
Raise your arms in an arc until they point straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back toward your thighs.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: From a half kneeling stance you press one handle forward and pull another back at the same time. It challenges core stability and coordination.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee between two cable stations, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep your torso tall and your core braced.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other toward your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Do not let your torso twist.
Switch your kneeling leg after a set.

entries.descriptionEn: A run on a self-powered curved treadmill where your effort sets the speed. It is a hard cardio workout for the legs and lungs.
instructionsEn: Step onto the curved treadmill and hold the handles.
Lean slightly forward and begin to run.
Drive your knees and push the belt back with each stride.
Keep a steady rhythm, or alternate sprints and rest.
Land on the balls of your feet.
Slow down gradually to finish.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃倒握土耳其起身至膝
entries.nameEn: kettlebell bottoms up to knee turkish get up
entries.descriptionEn: A Turkish get-up holding the bell upside down, moving only up to a kneeling position. It builds shoulder stability and core control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell upside down in one hand, arm straight up.
Bend the same-side knee and plant the foot.
Roll onto your elbow, then your hand.
Lift your hips and sweep the straight leg back to kneel.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie down.
Keep your eyes on the bell and switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated forearm rotation holding a weight to turn your palm upward. It builds forearm strength and wrist control.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand over the knee.
Hold a weighted handle or dumbbell end in your hand.
Start with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm slowly until your palm faces up.
Return slowly to the start.
Switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Wrist curls with palms down while seated, using a weight. They build the muscles on top of the forearm.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms facing down.
Let your hands hang over your knees holding weights.
Lower your wrists to stretch the forearms.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on your thighs.

entries.nameEn: weighted seated one arm wrist curl
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm wrist curl, palm up, seated with a weight. It builds the forearm flexors and grip.
instructionsEn: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up.
Let the weight roll toward your fingertips.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 负重坐姿单臂反握腕弯举
entries.nameEn: weighted seated one arm reverse wrist curl
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm reverse wrist curl, palm down, seated with a weight. It strengthens the top of the forearm.
instructionsEn: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm down.
Let your hand hang over your knee with the weight.
Lower your wrist for a stretch.
Lift your hand up as high as you can.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿俯身后三角肌划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated bent over rear delt row
entries.descriptionEn: A seated bent-over row with elbows flared wide to hit the rear delts. Sitting keeps your legs from helping.
instructionsEn: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward with a flat back, arms hanging.
Pull the weights toward your sides with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest close to your thighs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃胸部支撑上斜双臂前平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline two front raise with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with both arms while lying chest down on an incline bench. The support stops you from cheating with your back.
instructionsEn: Set a bench to an incline and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height or just above.
Pause for a second.
Lower under control.
Keep your head neutral and your movement smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press with the dumbbells held close together, palms facing in. It works the front delts and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Hold them close together with palms facing each other.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and ribs down.
Lower slowly back to your shoulders.
Do not arch your lower back.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿侧平举转前平举
