Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A balance-focused hip hinge on one leg with a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping sideways into a squat while holding a kettlebell at your chest. It works the thighs and hips.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip-driven swing with one hand on a kettlebell. It builds explosive posterior chain power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking while carrying a heavy kettlebell in each hand. It builds grip, posture and core stability.
instructionsEn: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell single arm clean and press
entries.descriptionEn: A clean followed by an overhead press with one kettlebell. It links hip power with shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward lunge combined with an overhead press of a kettlebell. It trains legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

entries.descriptionEn: Passing a kettlebell around your body in circles while standing. It works the shoulders, core and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with elbows flared to hit the rear shoulders. It builds upper back and posture muscles.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃屈臂屈膝仰卧上拉
entries.nameEn: kettlebell bent arm pullover with knees bent
entries.descriptionEn: A floor pullover with a kettlebell and bent knees. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat into an overhead press with a single dumbbell, training the legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell version of the classic lift: swing it to the shoulder, then drive it overhead with a leg push.
instructionsEn: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up and guide it into the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip slightly with your knees, then explode up.
Punch the kettlebell overhead and lock out your arm.
Lower it back to the rack, then to the floor with control. Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful hip-driven pull that brings a kettlebell from the floor to the rack position on one shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grab the handle.
Hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and pull the bell close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the bell so it lands softly in the rack at your shoulder.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Lower the bell back down with control and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: An incline press using a band for resistance, targeting the upper chest and front shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set an incline bench and anchor a band behind it or under the bench.
Sit back with the band handles at chest level.
Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the band pull.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

entries.nameEn: cable bent over single arm kickback
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable kickback that isolates the triceps with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A biceps curl where the bar is dragged up along the body, keeping the load on the biceps and reducing shoulder swing.
instructionsEn: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A combo of a hip hinge and a squat that warms up and strengthens the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee with a squat finish that raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge stepped out at an angle that trains the legs and hips in a different plane, with a quick, springy pace.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge-like drill that opens the upper back and shoulders while rotating the spine.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and one hand behind you.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Reach your free arm up and over, rotating your chest toward the ceiling.
Open your chest as far as feels comfortable.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated figure-four stretch that lengthens the glutes and outer hip.
instructionsEn: Sit on a chair or the floor with your back tall.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back straight and lean your chest forward slowly.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing hip rotation drill that moves the hips through internal and external rotation.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, feet wide.
Lean back a little and support yourself with your hands.
Rotate both knees to one side so they drop toward the floor.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your movements slow and controlled.
Continue for 10-12 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: A quadruped drill that threads one arm under the body to free up the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Slide one arm under your body, palm up, reaching across.
Let your shoulder and head lower toward the floor.
Hold briefly, then pull the arm back.
Reach it up toward the ceiling, following with your eyes.
Repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep kneeling stretch with the back foot raised, aimed at the thighs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing away from a wall or couch with one shin up against it.
Place your other foot flat on the floor in front in a lunge.
Squeeze your glute and tuck your pelvis under.
Lift your torso upright until you feel the stretch in the front of your rear thigh.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A yoga flow that moves from a resting child pose into a gentle backbend, mobilising the spine.
instructionsEn: Start in child pose, knees apart, arms stretched forward.
Shift forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Slide forward and press into your hands to lift your chest into cobra.
Keep your hips down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a few breaths.
Push back into child pose and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling stretch with the arms on a bench that opens the lats and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top of it.
Keep your hands together or hold a light stick.
Sit your hips back and let your chest sink toward the floor.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Come back up carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling lean-back that stretches and strengthens the front of the thighs and the core.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with the heels raised on a small platform, shifting more work to the quads and allowing a deeper knee bend.
instructionsEn: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side squat that trains the legs and loads the inner thighs through a big range of motion.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise done from a held squat position, mixing calf work with leg endurance.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg-burning chain of squat, lunge and jump with dumbbells for strength and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
Rest, then repeat the sequence.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell step up with knee raise
entries.descriptionEn: A loaded step-up that finishes with a knee drive, working the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable kickback with palms facing in, isolating the triceps.
instructionsEn: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Pin your upper arm against your side.
Hold the handle with your palm facing in.
Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索俯身单臂中立握后踢(绳索把手)
entries.nameEn: cable bent over single arm neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm rope kickback that works the triceps with steady cable tension.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple band pull-apart to strengthen the back of the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

entries.nameEn: resistance band one arm bent over row
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm row using a resistance band, working the lats and mid-back.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带俯身中立握划船
entries.nameEn: resistance band bent over neutral grip row
entries.descriptionEn: A two-handed bent-over band row with palms facing in, hitting the lats and mid-back.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a band across your back that adds resistance at the top of the movement.
instructionsEn: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands.
Get into a plank position with your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
Lower slowly for the next rep.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell half kneeling lift and chop
entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal dumbbell pattern from a half kneeling stance that trains rotational core strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A band chop from a half kneeling position, building core stability and rotation.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿二头弯举转肩部推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing biceps curl to shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A compound arm move that links a biceps curl into an overhead press.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing one-arm row with a band to train the lats and mid-back.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended.
Step back until there is tension and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm band pulldown that isolates the lats.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead dumbbell press from a half kneeling stance, adding core and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索俯身中立握后踢(绳索把手)
entries.nameEn: cable bent over neutral grip kickback with rope attachment
entries.descriptionEn: A rope kickback with both arms that targets the triceps through full extension.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A basic step-up onto a box that builds leg and hip strength and single-leg control.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle spinal flow between arching and rounding the back to loosen the spine.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and tailbone into cow.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling into cat.
Tuck your chin and pull your belly in.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 10-12 breaths.

entries.descriptionEn: A defensive boxing guard that covers your head and body from incoming punches.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with feet staggered and knees slightly bent.
Bring your fists up to your cheeks with elbows tucked in.
Keep your chin down.
Raise your forearms to cover your face as if blocking a punch.
Bring your elbows together to cover your ribs.
Reset to your guard and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick straight punch with your lead hand thrown at a heavy bag.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag with your hands up.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down on impact.
Keep your rear hand guarding your chin.
Snap the punch back to your guard right away.
Stay light on your feet and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful straight punch from the rear hand, driven by the hips and thrown at a bag.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the bag.
Rotate your shoulder and keep your chin tucked.
Keep your lead hand up to guard.
Snap back to your stance and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A curved punch thrown from the rear hand, rotating the torso to hit the side of the bag.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance facing the bag.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Rotate your hips and torso to swing the fist in an arc.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Hit the bag and keep your left hand guarding.
Return to your guard and repeat.

entries.nameEn: front groin kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
entries.descriptionEn: A straight front kick thrown low at a bag, training leg power and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up.
Lift your rear knee toward your chest.
Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly to stay balanced.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Return to your stance and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A front push kick aimed at a bag that builds leg power, balance and hip flexibility.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Lift your rear knee up in front of you.
Extend your leg and push your heel or ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly and keep your guard up.
Pull the leg back to bend it.
Plant your foot and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: front snap kick kickboxing (with boxing bag)
entries.descriptionEn: A quick snapping front kick at a bag that trains speed and control in the thigh and hip.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A roundhouse-style kick that swings in an arc into the bag, building hip rotation and power.
instructionsEn: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out to the side.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc.
Hit the bag with the top of your foot or shin.
Keep your hands up and your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight lead-hand punch thrown at a partner holding pads, working speed and accuracy.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw your lead hand straight to the pad.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down.
Retract your hand quickly to your guard.
Keep your feet light and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rising punch with the left hand thrown to a partner's pad, using leg and hip drive.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc.
Hit the pad with the palm facing you.
Reset your guard.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight rear-hand punch with hip rotation, thrown to a partner's pad.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Rotate your rear foot and hips as you throw the right hand.
Drive your fist straight to the pad.
Keep your chin tucked and left hand up.
Snap back to your stance.

entries.descriptionEn: A curved rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, using torso rotation for power.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad out to the side.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your right elbow and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing the fist in an arc into the pad.
Pivot your rear foot as you turn.
Return to your guard.

entries.descriptionEn: A rising rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, driven by the legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips.
Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad.
Keep your left hand guarding.
Reset your stance.

entries.descriptionEn: A front push kick aimed at a partner's pad, training leg power, balance and timing.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad at body height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Raise your rear knee in front of you.
Extend your leg and push the ball of your foot into the pad.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A knee strike driven forward into a partner's pad, working the thighs, hips and core.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad at waist height.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Drive your rear knee up and forward into the pad.
Rise slightly onto the toes of your standing foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the leg and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick snapping front kick into a partner's pad that trains speed and leg control.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A roundhouse-style hook kick delivered to a partner's pad, building hip rotation and power.
instructionsEn: Face your partner, who holds a kick pad to the side.
Stand in a fighting stance with hands up.
Pivot on your standing foot and lift your rear knee out.
Rotate your hips and swing your leg in an arc into the pad.
Keep your torso steady.
Bring the leg back and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A foam roller release for the outer front hip, easing tightness around the tensor fasciae latae.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under the front of your outer hip.
Support yourself with your forearm and opposite foot.
Slowly roll up and down a few inches.
Pause on tender spots for a few seconds.
Breathe slowly and keep the movement gentle.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A roller or ball release for the deep hip flexor area at the front of the pelvis.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone.
Support your weight on your forearms.
Shift your weight gently over the roller.
Roll slowly a small distance up and down.
Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Rolling a small ball under your lower back to release tight spots and loosen the muscles beside the spine.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying rotation that opens the chest and mid back, good for thoracic mobility and tight shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Using a light pipe to practice rotating the shoulders outward, building control and range for overhead lifts.
instructionsEn: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A pipe-assisted stretch for the lats, shoulders and wrists that helps you get into a comfortable front rack position.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the elbows and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge drill with a light pipe on your back, teaching you to bend at the hips with a flat spine.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple hinge pattern drill using a pipe along your spine to check posture while you bend at the hips.
instructionsEn: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a light pipe held overhead that checks your mobility and trains posture through the whole body.
instructionsEn: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging a pipe from the front of your thighs to behind your back to open the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip rotation drill where you switch both knees from one side to the other, loosening the hips.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle lying rotation that sways your bent knees side to side to loosen the lower back and hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.

entries.nameZh: 按摩球滚压三角肌后束
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a ball on the back of the shoulder to ease tension in the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Place a small ball between the back of your shoulder and a wall.
Lean in until you feel moderate pressure.
Roll slowly up, down and sideways over the rear deltoid.
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other shoulder.

entries.nameZh: 徒手站姿环绕(靠墙支撑)
entries.nameEn: bodyweight standing around the world (wall supported)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing arm circle against a wall that mobilises the shoulders while keeping your back from compensating.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.

entries.nameZh: 徒手站姿军事推举(靠墙支撑)
entries.descriptionEn: An unloaded overhead press against a wall to groove a clean path and open the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall, hands at shoulder height with elbows bent.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays on the wall.
Press your hands straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing hip circles that loosen the hip joints and warm up the pelvis.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Slightly bend your knees.
Move your hips in a large smooth circle, as if drawing it with your belt buckle.
Do several circles one way, then switch direction.
Keep your shoulders still and relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing leg swing forward that warms up the hip flexors and hamstrings and challenges your balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An easier one-arm push-up using a wall, building the strength and stability needed for the full floor version.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge using a band under your feet for rising tension, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and grab it with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Lower your hands along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep the band close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A neutral-grip curl against band tension that builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a rotation that adds work for the obliques on top of the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃窄握肩部推举仰卧起坐
entries.nameEn: dumbbell close grip shoulder press sit up
entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up that finishes with an overhead press, joining core and shoulder work in a single rep.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Sit up using your abs.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃正面平板支撑抬臂
entries.descriptionEn: A plank with one arm lifting a dumbbell forward, challenging your core to stay still.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and keep hips level.
Lift the dumbbell forward in line with your torso.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

entries.nameZh: 负重坐姿屈膝卷腹(地面)
entries.nameEn: weighted seated tuck crunch on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated tuck that brings the knees and chest together while holding a weight, targeting the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: A weighted crunch holding a dumbbell at the chest to add resistance for the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Brace your abs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俄罗斯转体窄握肩部推举仰卧起坐
entries.nameEn: dumbbell russian twist close grip shoulder press sit up
entries.descriptionEn: A compound core move that links a sit-up, a Russian twist and an overhead press with a dumbbell.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿屈膝卷腹(地面)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated tuck crunch on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated tuck crunch holding a dumbbell to work the abs and hip flexors under load.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs and lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out under control.
Keep your spine long throughout.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃正面平板支撑抬臂抬腿
entries.nameEn: dumbbell front plank arm leg raise
entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you lift a dumbbell and the opposite leg at once, testing your balance and core control.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift the dumbbell forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Lower both under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿屈膝扭转卷腹(地面)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated tuck twisting crunch on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated tuck with a twist, adding oblique work to the dumbbell-loaded crunch.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in and rotate your torso to one side.
Extend your legs and rotate back to center.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A demanding combo of a plank row and a squat that builds back strength, core stability and leg power.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell to your hip, keeping hips level.
Lower it, then hop or step your feet toward your hands.
Stand up with the dumbbells and squat down.
Return to plank and alternate the rowing arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg across your body and out to the side to loosen the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Shift onto one leg.
Swing the other leg across your body, then out to the side.
Keep your torso upright and the swing controlled.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down rotational stretch that opens the hips, chest and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and swing that foot up and across your body.
Reach toward the opposite hand and keep shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A multi-part warm-up combining a lunge, a rotation and a hamstring stretch.
instructionsEn: Step into a long lunge with both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Drop your hips low.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and raise that arm.
Return the hand to the floor and straighten the front leg.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A running-in-place drill that alternates a high knee with a heel kick to raise your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.

entries.nameZh: 双手放胸前俄罗斯转体
entries.nameEn: russian twist with hands on chest
entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with your hands crossed on your chest. It trains the obliques and core rotation.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Cross your hands over your chest.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

entries.nameZh: 站姿单腿高抬腿转后踢腿(有支撑)
entries.nameEn: standing single leg high knee to butt kick (with support)
entries.descriptionEn: A supported single-leg drill that alternates a high knee and a heel kick, working balance and the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand next to a wall or support and hold it with one hand.
Raise the opposite knee to hip height.
Lower it and kick that heel up toward your glutes.
Repeat smoothly for the reps.
Switch sides and keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling push-up followed by a quick shoulder tap with each hand. It builds the chest and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lifting your arms behind you from a face-down position. It strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Reaching your arms overhead and clapping to warm up the shoulders. It improves shoulder mobility and activation.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides and overhead.
Clap your hands above your head.
Lower your arms back to your sides with control.
Keep your ribs down and move smoothly through your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps extension using your own bodyweight against a stable surface. It targets the back of the arms.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust from a kneeling position. It works the glutes and teaches strong hip extension.
instructionsEn: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees and your arms by your sides.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A moving stretch for the back and sides that warms up the spine and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than hips and arms overhead.
Reach up and over to one side.
Return to center and reach to the other side.
Let your torso rotate slightly as you go.
Move smoothly for the reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Pulling your elbows behind you to open up the chest and front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands behind your head and elbows pointing out.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your chest slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing or kneeling stretch that lengthens the front of the hip while the glutes work.
instructionsEn: Stand or kneel with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Lean slightly forward to feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge stretch with the back foot raised on a bench, targeting the quads and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot forward into a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis and push your hips forward.
Keep your chest tall and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A bouncy side lunge that stretches the inner thighs and trains light explosive movement.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Straighten the other leg and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Push off to hop to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.

entries.descriptionEn: Kicking one leg back from a kneeling position against a band. It isolates the glutes.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours with a band looped around your foot and hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back, squeezing your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip-hinge swing using a resisted band. It builds hip power and glute strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band holding the other end with both hands.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to swing your arms up to chest height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Control the return and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with band resistance. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with your front foot and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Step your other foot back into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Drive up through the front foot, then switch legs after your set.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: A standing triceps pressdown using a band. It isolates the back of the arms.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Press your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Let your hands rise slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing one leg at a time against a band while lying down. It builds leg strength with light equipment.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop the band around the soles of your feet, holding the ends.
Bend both knees toward your chest.
Press one foot out straight against the band.
Bring it back and press the other leg.
Alternate smoothly with control.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带俯身后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: band bent over rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over fly with a band. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slight elbow bends.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with band resistance. It builds the thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down.
Go to at least parallel without letting your knees cave in.
Drive up through your heels and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling upward press using a band. It targets the upper chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low behind you and kneel facing away from it.
Hold the ends at chest height.
Press your hands up and forward at an incline.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side bend with a band for oblique resistance. It strengthens the sides of the waist.
instructionsEn: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end at your side.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist away from the band.
Squeeze your obliques and return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿颈后军事推举
entries.nameEn: band standing behind head military press
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with the band starting behind the head. It trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head at shoulder level.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press your hands straight overhead.
Lock out your arms without shrugging.
Lower slowly back behind your head and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl with palms facing each other against tube resistance, training the biceps and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the handles with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly under tension.

entries.descriptionEn: A pushdown against a band anchored overhead that isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band high and hold the handles with elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with band resistance, building the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand in a split stance with the band under your front foot and handles at your shoulders.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg style glute bridge with one ankle resting on the opposite knee.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Press through the grounded foot.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling side kick that works the glutes and outer hips while challenging balance.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side, bent.
Extend it into a kick out to the side.
Bend it back in and lower.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

entries.nameEn: bent knee back to side kick
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling leg movement combining a rear lift with a side kick to work the glutes and hips.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Lift one bent knee back and up.
Swing the leg out to the side into a kick.
Return the knee under control.
Switch legs after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling leg arc that works the glutes and outer hip through a half circle.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out straight behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return the same way.
Keep your hips square and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头三头肌伸展 v. 4
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead triceps extension with a band. It isolates the back of the arms.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂直立划船
entries.nameEn: band standing single arm upright row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm upright row with a band. It works the shoulders and traps.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the other end in one hand at your thigh.
Keep your elbow leading the movement.
Pull your hand up toward your chest, elbow higher than the wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal twisting movement with a band from low to high. It trains the obliques and core.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and stand sideways to it, holding the end with both hands.
Start with your hands near the low hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body as you rotate your torso.
Pivot your back foot and keep your arms long.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging the arms down against a band like a skier. It works the shoulders, lats and core.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull your arms down and back past your hips.
Squeeze your lats and keep your core braced.
Return slowly overhead and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the upper back and lats.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the ends, hinging forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A pedaling motion on your back with band resistance. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band looped around your feet and hold the ends.
Raise your legs and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Pedal one leg in while extending the other.
Twist your torso to bring the opposite elbow to the knee.
Keep a steady rhythm and keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: Combining a side bend and an overhead press with a band. It trains the shoulders and obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the end in one hand at your shoulder.
Press the band overhead as you bend gently to the opposite side.
Keep your hips steady and your chest open.
Return to upright as you lower your hand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg lift from a face-down position against a band. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with a band looped around one foot and anchored under you.
Rest your arms under your head.
Lift one leg up, keeping it straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down lift of opposite arm and leg to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg together.
Hold for a second.
Lower and switch to the other side.
Keep your neck neutral and move with control.

entries.nameZh: 徒手全蹲加过头推举(版本2)
entries.nameEn: bodyweight full squat with overhead press (version 2)
entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat paired with an overhead reach or press, working the legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat deep, keeping chest up.
Drive up out of the squat.
Press your arms overhead as you stand.
Lower your hands and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping combination with a step in the middle to raise your heart rate and train leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Jump up and land softly with bent knees.
Step to the side or forward.
Jump again and land softly.
Keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump with a shooting arm motion that trains explosive legs and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand in an athletic stance with hands at chest height.
Dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and extend one arm like shooting a basketball.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A jumping jack variation where the arms and legs cross over each other.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while the arms swing overhead.
Jump and cross one foot in front and the arms across your chest.
Alternate which side crosses.
Keep a quick but controlled pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A basic bodyweight squat that trains the legs and hips and builds a solid movement pattern.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: Lifting opposite arm and leg while face down to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Raise your right arm and left leg.
Hold briefly and lower.
Raise your left arm and right leg.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly.

entries.nameZh: 辅助反握引体向上(低杆位置)
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up from a low bar with your feet helping, a stepping stone toward full chin-ups.
instructionsEn: Set a bar at about chest height and sit or lie beneath it.
Grip the bar with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar using your arms and back.
Use your legs only as much as needed.
Lower with control.

entries.nameZh: 辅助突击队员引体向上
entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with a neutral staggered grip and some help, building back and arm strength.
instructionsEn: Grip a bar with one hand in front of the other.
Use a band or feet for assistance.
Pull until your head passes the bar to one side.
Lower with control.
Switch the head side on the next rep.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助反握引体向上
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up with a band under your feet or knees to reduce the load. It helps you build toward unassisted reps.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and the band looped under your feet.
Engage your lats and keep your core tight.
Pull your chin over the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带辅助臂屈伸(版本2)
entries.descriptionEn: A dip with a band under your knees to help with the load while building triceps and chest strength.
instructionsEn: Loop a band across dip bars and place your knees in it.
Support yourself with straight arms.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling crunch against band resistance. It strengthens the abs through a loaded crunch.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Round your spine and tighten your abs.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standard bar curl for building the biceps with a steady, controlled lift.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling lean-back that isolates the quads with a deep stretch at the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and a support nearby.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Lean back slowly as far as you can.
Pull back up with your quads.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing squat where your knees travel forward as you lean back, strongly working the quads.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a support, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward and lean back.
Lower as far as you can control.
Press back up.

entries.nameZh: 反握引体向上(下蹲姿势)
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up from a low bar while sitting in a squat, using your legs to share the work.
instructionsEn: Set a low bar and grip it with palms facing you.
Sit into a deep squat beneath it.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower back down.
Use your legs as little as possible.

entries.nameZh: 反握引体向上(等长与离心)
entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up variation focused on holding at the top and lowering slowly to build strength.
instructionsEn: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position for a few seconds.
Lower yourself slowly over several seconds.
Reset on the floor.
Repeat for the reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with a staggered, side-on grip that you pull to alternating sides of the bar. It builds lats, arms and grip.
instructionsEn: Grab the bar with one hand in front of the other, palms facing each other, and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your body up, moving your head to one side of the bar.
Get your chin or shoulder level with the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
Switch which side your head passes on each rep, or each set.

entries.descriptionEn: A basic crunch with your arms crossed over your chest. It trains the abs without pulling on the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench dip with a dumbbell resting on your lap for extra load. It hits the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench edge, hands beside your hips, and slide your hips off the front.
Rest a dumbbell on your thighs, holding it steady with your hips and legs.
Bend your elbows to lower until they reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell bench dip with legs elevated
entries.descriptionEn: A weighted bench dip with your feet raised on a second bench, which makes the triceps work harder.
instructionsEn: Place two benches facing each other, hands on one and heels on the other.
Set a dumbbell on your lap and keep your legs straight.
Lower your hips by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Keep your chest up and your elbows pointing back.
Press up until your arms are straight again.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俯身单臂划船 v. 2
entries.nameEn: dumbbell bent over single arm row v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row from a hinged position, pulling a dumbbell toward your hip. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees slightly bent.
Let the weight hang with your arm straight below your shoulder.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell bench press performed with your hips lifted in a glute bridge. It trains the chest while your glutes and core hold you stable.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor or a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Plant your feet and drive your hips up into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them to chest level under control.
Keep your hips high for the whole set.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep side-to-side squat holding a dumbbell at the chest. It works the thighs and glutes and opens up the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down on that leg.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Drive through the bent leg to stand and shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and your heel down.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg curl lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell gripped between your feet. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a decline bench with the dumbbell held between your feet.
Let your legs hang straight with your hips pressed to the bench.
Curl your heels up toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly to full extension.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃下斜过头仰卧起坐
entries.descriptionEn: A decline sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Hook your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead behind you.
Curl your torso up, keeping the dumbbell over your head.
Reach the top with your arms above your knees.
Lower back slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A decline sit-up with a dumbbell held on your chest to add resistance for the abs.
instructionsEn: Secure your feet on a decline bench and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lie back until your torso is just above the bench.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on your head.
Lower slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃深俯卧撑加反向划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell deep push up and renegade row
entries.descriptionEn: A combo of a deep push-up on dumbbells and a renegade row. It trains chest, back and core together.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with hands on two dumbbells, feet wide.
Lower your chest between the dumbbells in a deep push-up.
Press back up to a plank.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs while bracing to stay level.
Lower it, row the other side, and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with a dumbbell held overhead, you swing your legs side to side like a wiper. It challenges the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back to the middle.
Repeat to the other side, keeping your shoulders flat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲加二头弯举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell goblet squat and biceps curl
entries.descriptionEn: A goblet squat followed by a biceps curl in the bottom position. It combines leg and arm work in one rep.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell by one end at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
At the bottom, lower the dumbbell and curl it back up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive pull that takes dumbbells from the hang position to your shoulders. It builds power in the hips and back.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells and hinge until they hang just above your knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward and shrug as you pull the weights up.
Drop under them and catch at your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower to the hang and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃悬垂力量翻加挺举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell hang power clean and jerk
entries.descriptionEn: A hang power clean followed by an overhead jerk. It is a full-body power move for hips, legs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells hanging just above your knees with a flat back.
Explode up and pull the weights to your shoulders, catching in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then dip slightly with your knees.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the hang, and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A row with your forehead resting on a bench pad so your lower back stays relaxed. It focuses on the upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a bench at a slight incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your forehead on the top and let your arms hang.
Row both dumbbells toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It is a direct way to build the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart, knees bent.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜二头弯举 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A biceps curl sitting back on an incline bench. The stretch position works the biceps hard.
instructionsEn: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Keep your elbows back and your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜头部支撑划船
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row on an incline bench with your head resting on the pad. It targets the upper back without loading the spine.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your head on the top of the bench and let your arms hang.
Pull your elbows back and the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: An Arnold press done from a kneeling position, which takes the legs out and challenges your core. It trains all three heads of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Kneel tall holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A windmill with a dumbbell held low, bending sideways and down the leg. It trains the obliques and loosens the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Turn your back foot out and push your hips toward the dumbbell side.
Slide the dumbbell down your leg as you bend sideways and hinge.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Return to standing and finish the set, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A woodchop done lying on your back, moving a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Sweep the dumbbell diagonally up and across to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso with the movement.
Return under control and switch sides after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up holding a dumbbell above your head, which lengthens the lever and makes your abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Curl up to a seated position, keeping the dumbbell above you.
Keep your arms by your ears.
Lower back down slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉加俯身划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell rdl and bent over row
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift combined with a bent-over row. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and back in one rep.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back, until the dumbbells are below your knees.
Keep your back flat and row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俄罗斯转体(双脚离地)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell russian twist with legs floor off
entries.descriptionEn: A Russian twist with a dumbbell and your feet lifted off the floor. It strongly challenges the obliques and balance.
instructionsEn: Sit down and lean back slightly with a dumbbell held in both hands.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Rotate your torso to bring the dumbbell beside one hip.
Twist to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your chest up and your back long.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips and hold it in place.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side squat where you sit back toward a bench while holding a dumbbell. It works the thighs and glutes one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a bench holding a dumbbell at your chest, feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell side lunge with shoulder press
entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge paired with an overhead press. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back into a side lunge.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push back to the middle and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders and lunge to the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide side squat with a dumbbell, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs and inner legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Lower until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell on your hips. It builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back on a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up holding a dumbbell against your chest for extra resistance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower back down slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃前后站姿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift with one foot slightly behind the other. It loads the hamstrings and glutes and improves balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot a half step ahead and hold dumbbells in front of you.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstring, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch feet.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃后撤弓步蹲加划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell step back lunge and row
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge followed by a row. It trains the legs and the back in one flowing movement.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Hinge your torso slightly forward with a flat back.
Row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, push through the front foot to stand, and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise from a raised platform so your heels drop below the toes. The extra range works the calves hard.
instructionsEn: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or block, heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise up as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

entries.nameEn: elevated standing single leg calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg calf raise on a step with a full stretch at the bottom. It builds calf strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step, other foot lifted.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip extension on a glute ham developer. You hinge at the hips with a straight body to work the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Set up on the GHD with your feet planted and hips just past the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to raise back to a straight line.
Do not arch past neutral at the top.

entries.nameZh: 罗马椅仰卧起坐加俄罗斯转体
entries.nameEn: glute ham developer sit up and russian twist
entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up on the glute ham developer ending with a twist. It trains the abs and the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lock your feet in the GHD and lie back with arms crossed or hands clasped.
Sit up in a controlled way.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the middle and lower back down.
Alternate the twist side each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A hyperextension on the glute ham bench with a twist at the top. It works the lower back, glutes and obliques.
instructionsEn: Position yourself on the bench with hips on the pad and feet locked in.
Cross your arms on your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise up to a straight line and rotate your torso to one side.
Untwist, lower, and alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hyperextension on the glute ham bench. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings and the lower back.
instructionsEn: Set up on the bench with one foot planted and the other lifted behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise to a straight line, squeezing your glute.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging from a bar, you alternate small, fast kicks with straight legs. It trains the lower abs and grip.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Tighten your core and lift your legs slightly in front of you.
Kick your legs up and down in alternating small movements.
Keep your swing minimal.
Continue for the set time or reps.
