entries.descriptionEn: Row a cable handle with one arm from a kneeling position. Builds the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单臂锤式弯举(用绳)
entries.nameEn: cable standing one arm hammer curl (with rope)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm hammer curl on a cable using a rope. Hits the biceps and forearm muscles with a neutral grip.
instructionsEn: Attach the rope to a low pulley and hold it with one hand, thumb up.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Curl the rope toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the top for a second.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: roll neck rotation lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the neck. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently turn your head slowly from side to side.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameEn: roll neck decompress lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the neck. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently nod your chin and let your head relax into the roller.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴前臂放松(站姿靠墙)
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the forearm. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall with the roller held against it.
Place the roller under the forearm and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean in and roll your forearm up and down the roller.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴二头肌放松(仰卧)
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the biceps. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with the roller under one upper arm.
Place the roller under the biceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴三头肌放松(侧卧)
entries.nameEn: roll triceps side lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the triceps. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under the back of your upper arm.
Place the roller under the triceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the armpit.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameEn: roll chest opener lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie lengthwise on the roller along your spine with knees bent.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Open your arms out to the sides and let your chest relax.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with the roller under one side of your chest.
Place the roller under the chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly side to side across the muscle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴前肩与胸部放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll front shoulder and chest lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the front shoulder and chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with the roller under your front shoulder.
Place the roller under the front shoulder and chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll small amounts toward the chest and back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴肩后侧放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll posterior shoulder lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the back of the shoulder. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your rear shoulder.
Place the roller under the back of the shoulder and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly along the back of the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴肩部后旋放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll shoulder back rotation lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shoulder and upper back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the shoulder and upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Rotate your top arm back and forth to open the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the rhomboids. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Sit with the roller behind your upper back and cross your arms.
Place the roller under the rhomboids and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll up and down between your shoulder blades.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴中背部放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll middle back lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the middle back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under your mid back, hands behind your head.
Place the roller under the middle back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴下背部(侧)放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll lower back (side) lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the side of the lower back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the side of the lower back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down in a small range.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameEn: roll thoracic spine lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the thoracic spine. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back, arms crossed.
Place the roller under the thoracic spine and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll up and down the upper back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴肩胛伸展放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll shoulder blade reach lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shoulder blade. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your shoulder blade.
Place the roller under the shoulder blade and let your body weight settle onto it.
Reach your top arm forward and back as you roll.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameEn: roll around the world lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the upper back and shoulders. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the upper back and shoulders and let your body weight settle onto it.
Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, like a snow angel.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴竖脊肌放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll erector spinae lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the lower back muscles. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the lower back muscles and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly with small movements and keep your core engaged.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴跪姿上背部旋转
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the upper back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Kneel beside the roller and place one hand on it.
Place the roller under the upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Slide the roller forward as you rotate your chest open.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes and hip. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Sit on the roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Place the roller under the glutes and hip and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean toward the crossed leg and roll gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Sit on the roller with your hands behind you.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly back and forth under your glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴臀部扭转放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll glute twist lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the roller under one glute.
Place the roller under the glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Let the knees drop to one side and twist gently.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴腘绳肌与臀部放松(坐地)
entries.nameEn: roll hamstrings and glute sitting on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the hamstrings and glutes. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Sit with the roller under your thighs and hands behind you.
Place the roller under the hamstrings and glutes and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll from the knee toward the glutes.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴股四头肌(股外侧肌)放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll quadriceps (vastus lateralis) lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer thigh. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
Place the roller under the outer thigh and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll from the hip down to above the knee.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours with the roller under your shins.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴胫骨前肌(单腿)放松(仰卧)
entries.nameEn: roll tibialis anterior (single leg) lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Rest one shin on the roller, supporting yourself on your hands.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴腓骨肌侧放松(侧卧)
entries.nameEn: roll peroneal side lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under your outer lower leg.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 泡沫轴腓骨肌(单腿)侧放松(侧卧)
entries.nameEn: roll peroneal (single leg) side lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer lower leg, other foot behind for support.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.descriptionEn: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the sole of the foot. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit with the roller under one foot.
Place the roller under the sole of the foot and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll the sole from heel to toes, then switch feet.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

entries.nameZh: 棍棒辅助核心等长收缩
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a stick overhead or in front while you brace your midsection. Builds trunk stability and teaches you to keep the ribs down.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch that uses a stick to pull the arm overhead and open up the side of your back. Good for tight lats and overhead mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Stretches the front of your shoulders and chest using a stick for leverage. Helps with posture and overhead reach.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 棍棒弓步蹲过头上举拉伸
entries.nameEn: stick lunge with overhead raise stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge combined with a stick held overhead. Opens the hip flexors of the back leg and the shoulders at the same time.
instructionsEn: Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle standing rotation with a stick across your shoulders. Loosens the mid back and trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.

entries.descriptionEn: Swinging a stick from front to back in a wide arc to open up the shoulders. A classic warm-up for shoulder mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend with a stick raised overhead. Lengthens the side of your trunk and the lats.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your chest open.
Bend slowly to one side without leaning forward.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and bend to the other side.

entries.nameZh: 棍棒侧向到前向弯曲拉伸
entries.nameEn: stick side to front bend stretch
entries.descriptionEn: Combines a side bend with a forward fold while holding a stick overhead. Stretches the side body, lower back and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.nameZh: 棍棒过头完整相扑深蹲拉伸
entries.nameEn: stick overhead full sumo squat stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A deep wide-stance squat while holding a stick overhead. Opens the inner thighs and hips and challenges shoulder mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds.
Press up through your feet to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a trunk twist while holding a stick. Stretches the hip flexors and loosens the spine.
instructionsEn: Hold the stick across your chest or in front with both hands and step into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Twist your torso over the front leg.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, breathing evenly.
Untwist, step back and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Drawing your belly in as far as you can while standing. Trains the deep abdominal muscles that keep your trunk tight.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆正握坐姿划船(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever pronated grip seated row (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded seated row with an overhand grip. Targets the upper back and lats.
instructionsEn: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly until your arms extend.
Keep your torso steady.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆正握坐姿肩胛后缩耸肩(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever pronated grip seated scapular retraction shrug (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A short seated row focusing on pulling your shoulder blades together. Isolates the mid back.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles overhand with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows much.
Hold for a second.
Let your shoulder blades spread slowly.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿拖曳弯举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Curl the dumbbells while dragging them up along your body, with elbows moving back. Keeps tension on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping them close to your torso.
Let your elbows travel slightly back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps. Gives your biceps a burn.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with a barbell across your hips and a knees-forward setup. Keeps tension on the glutes through the whole rep.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿单臂交叉平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing single arm cross raise
entries.descriptionEn: Raise one dumbbell diagonally across your body. Works the chest and front shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up pushed fast enough for your hands to leave the floor. Builds upper-body power.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.nameZh: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(动作检查)
entries.nameEn: front plank with arm and leg lift (form check)
entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you lift an arm and the opposite leg. Challenges your core stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps using dumbbells.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing cable kickback angled out to the side that targets the upper glutes (gluteus medius) and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hip-extension variation on a back extension bench where you keep a relaxed, rounded upper back to bias the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Floor ab exercise where you lift bent knees toward your chest, working the lower abs with less lever length than straight legs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
Repeat for the target reps.

entries.nameEn: shoulder width neutral grip pull up
entries.descriptionEn: Pull-up with palms facing each other at shoulder width, a joint-friendly grip that builds the lats and arms.
instructionsEn: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging or kicking.

entries.descriptionEn: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.
instructionsEn: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with one foot set slightly ahead of the other. Shifts more load to one side and challenges hip stability.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.

entries.nameEn: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Hanging-style leg raise performed supported on parallel bars, taking the legs high to challenge the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the target reps.

entries.nameEn: high knee lunge on bosu ball
entries.descriptionEn: Explosive lunge-and-drive-knee movement off a bosu ball that trains leg power and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull-up using a narrow overhand grip to emphasise the lower lats and arms.
instructionsEn: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch where you pull the foot toward you with a band. Lengthens the calf and the back of the leg.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop the band around the ball of that foot.
Hold the band ends with both hands and sit tall.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your knee straight.
Release and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Gentle seated mobility drill sliding the foot along the floor to warm up the ankle and calf.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
Repeat, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Low-impact hopping on one leg to build ankle stiffness, balance and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated calf raise with weight on your thighs that targets the soleus muscle under the calf.
instructionsEn: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

entries.nameZh: 负重坐姿单腿提踵 v. 2
entries.nameEn: weighted seated single calf raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: One-leg seated calf raise with weight on the knee, working the soleus with extra focus on each side.
instructionsEn: Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Pause, then lower under control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Goblet squat with your heels raised on a plate or wedge so the knees travel forward and the quads work harder.
instructionsEn: Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Plank variation where you pass a dumbbell under your body from hand to hand, challenging core stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
Repeat, alternating sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Marching in place while holding a plate overhead, building leg strength, balance and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: Bench dip with your feet on a stability ball for extra instability, hammering the triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.

entries.descriptionEn: Crunch with legs raised and a rotation at the top that hits the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: Sit-up on a decline bench that increases the range and load on the abs.
instructionsEn: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Lower back slowly without dropping.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded hack squat machine that lets you load the quads and glutes with back support.
instructionsEn: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Do not lock your knees hard at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row hanging under a bar with an underhand grip. Builds the back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿前倾单臂划船
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling leaning forward one arm row
entries.descriptionEn: One-arm cable row from a kneeling position, leaning forward to give a long pull for the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish reps and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull-up on gymnastic rings, which move freely and demand extra stability from the back and arms.
instructionsEn: Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

entries.nameEn: cable standing one arm face pull
entries.descriptionEn: One-arm face pull on a cable that trains the rear delts and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Hooping around your waist with a hula hoop for light cardio and core engagement.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆坐姿俯身后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: lever seated bent over rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: Machine rear-delt fly where you lean forward and sweep your arms back.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause, then return slowly.
Do not shrug.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿交叉过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable standing crossover overhead tricep extension
entries.descriptionEn: Overhead triceps extension on crossed cables for a strong stretch and squeeze.
instructionsEn: Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

entries.nameEn: weighted full squat with overhead press
entries.descriptionEn: Full-depth squat followed by an overhead press, a thruster-style move that works legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated cable row set up to emphasise the lats with a pull toward the hips.
instructionsEn: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
Keep your chest up.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with a dumbbell on your hips and the knees kept slightly forward. Keeps tension on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Hip-hinge pattern with no load that warms up the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your spine neutral.

entries.descriptionEn: Push-up focusing on the slow lowering phase to build strength for full reps.
instructionsEn: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Doorway stretch for the chest and front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆单臂上斜推胸(挂片式)
entries.nameEn: lever one arm incline chest press (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded machine press on an incline, one arm at a time, for upper chest.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handle up and forward until the arm is nearly straight.
Lower slowly with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor to build strength out of the bottom.
instructionsEn: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated wrist curl with an EZ bar to build the forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Keep your forearms still.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿单侧高位下拉
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling one-arm lat pulldown for a stretch and strong contraction on each side.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunge stepping backward from a raised surface, which increases the range of motion.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
Complete reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine crunch on a curved track that lets you curl your trunk and knees together. Builds the abs under load.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

entries.descriptionEn: Combo of an inchworm walk-out followed by mountain climbers for a full-body workout.
instructionsEn: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
Stand up and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俯卧后三角肌摆动
entries.descriptionEn: Prone swing with dumbbells to target the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

entries.descriptionEn: Face pull using a band to train the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing chest press against a band anchored behind you.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: Cable face pull to build the rear delts and strengthen the upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat with a landmine bar held at your chest, mimicking a hack squat.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep the bar close.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet close together.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Press up to stand.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing bent arm lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: Lateral raise with elbows bent to isolate the side delts.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Upright row with a shoulder-width grip.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bar close.

entries.descriptionEn: Back squat with a narrow stance for more quad focus.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: Narrow stance squat holding dumbbells to build the quads.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to stand.
Keep your heels down.

entries.descriptionEn: Bent-arm lateral raise that shifts load onto the side delts.
instructionsEn: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管跪姿单臂肩部推举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling one-arm landmine press for shoulder strength with an angled path.
instructionsEn: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Push-up with hands elevated on a bench, an easier version of the push-up.
instructionsEn: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

entries.descriptionEn: Face pull with a rope attachment to hit the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grab it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Side bend using a cable for the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Keep your hips still.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return to upright.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated rope face pull for the rear delts.
instructionsEn: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your face.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat starting from the bottom position, pausing each rep to build strength.
instructionsEn: Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Get under it and brace.
Drive up from a dead stop.
Lower back to the pins.
Reset on every rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Bench press from pins in the rack, starting from a dead stop at the chest.
instructionsEn: Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Press the bar up.
Lower to the pins and pause.
Repeat.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃胸部支撑俯身划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell bent over row with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: Chest-supported dumbbell row to reduce lower back stress.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Explosive shrug with a barbell, using a hip drive to build the traps.
instructionsEn: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh.
Dip your knees slightly.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your arms straight.

entries.descriptionEn: Deadlift with the bar held behind you, a quad-friendly lift.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated leg extension using a cable for the quads.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Hold the bench.
Extend your leg until straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinge forward and pull two dumbbells toward your face with elbows high. It works the rear delts and upper back and helps shoulder posture.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive pull that drives dumbbells up to chest height using the legs and hips. It builds the shoulders and traps and trains power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press done on the floor with legs straight out. With no back support, it trains the shoulders and demands a strong core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and sit tall without leaning back.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃站姿肩部限位架推举
entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead press starting from a dead stop on safety pins. Without the stretch reflex, it builds pressing strength out of the bottom position.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A barbell curl done with no body swing, so the biceps do all of the work. It is a simple way to build the front of the upper arm.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with the bar cradled in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the glutes, legs and back and trains an upright torso.
instructionsEn: Place the bar on a low rack or the floor and stand over it.
Squat down and hook the bar in the crooks of your elbows.
Lift your chest and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the bar back down under control, keeping your back flat.

entries.nameEn: bodyweight single leg kas glute bridge
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg glute bridge with the knee kept forward. Works each glute on its own and tests hip balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 徒手b式站姿早安式体前屈
entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with one foot staggered slightly behind. It biases one leg to train the hamstrings and glutes and builds balance.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A mountain climber where the knees drive toward the elbows on the side. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques and hips.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing front kick with your arms crossed over your chest. Warms up the hips and legs while challenging balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward-leaning stretch that opens the hips and the back of the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A heavier biceps curl that uses a small hip swing to get the bar past the sticking point. It lets you overload the biceps on the way up.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row done lying face down on an incline bench or rack. With the body supported, it focuses the work on the upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk forward while rising high onto your toes with each step, holding dumbbells. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.

entries.descriptionEn: A side bend done on a 45 degree bench that trains the obliques through a long range of motion.
instructionsEn: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk forward staying high on your toes with every step. It builds calf endurance and ankle control without any equipment.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that starts each rep from a dead stop on safety pins. It removes the bounce and builds strength out of the bottom.
instructionsEn: Set the safety pins at the depth you want and place the bar on them.
Duck under the bar and lift it onto your upper back.
Squat down until the bar rests on the pins.
Pause briefly while staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift performed while standing on a low platform. The longer range of motion trains the start of the pull and the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low plate or platform with the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and brace your core.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Lower the bar back under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable curl done leaning back on an incline bench. The arms hang behind the body, which stretches the biceps at the start.
instructionsEn: Set a low cable and lie back on an incline bench facing away from the stack.
Hold the handles with your arms hanging behind you.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows back and still.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive lift from the hang position that brings the bar to the shoulders. It trains power through the hips, legs and traps.
instructionsEn: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip and a flat back.
Hinge slightly so the bar sits just above your knees.
Jump and shrug explosively, extending hips and knees.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the hang.

entries.descriptionEn: A powerful pull from the floor that sends the bar to chest height. It develops explosive hips, traps and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and a flat back.
Lift the bar to your knees with your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height with elbows high and outside.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with the bar between your legs and a split stance. It loads the legs and hips and trains the back to stay braced.
instructionsEn: Stand straddling the bar with one foot forward and one back.
Squat down and grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Stand up by driving through both legs.
Lower the bar with control and switch your stance on the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight chest fly using suspension straps. You open your arms wide while leaning forward to stretch and load the chest.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean forward with your body in a straight line.
Start with your arms out in front of you, slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest between the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring your arms back together.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up style press on suspension straps. The unstable handles make your chest, arms and core work together.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your hands by your chest and elbows bent.
Press yourself away until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips in line.
Lower back slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable crunch that curls the spine toward the hips. It loads the abs against steady resistance.
instructionsEn: Kneel below a high cable with the rope held beside your head.
Keep your hips still and your back slightly rounded.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat followed by an explosive jump. Builds power and conditioning in the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with a dumbbell resting on your hips. Strong glute builder for the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Hip thrusts done on one leg with your upper back on a support. Builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆反向垂直哈克深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A machine squat facing the pad with a vertical lever path. Hits the thighs and glutes with back-friendly support.
instructionsEn: Set the machine and stand with your chest against the pad, feet on the platform.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie face down and raise your arms into a Y shape. It strengthens the lower traps and shoulder stabilizers.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A muscle up where a band under your feet or knees takes some of your weight. It lets you learn the pull and transition on the bar.
instructionsEn: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang from the bar with a false or overhand grip.
Pull explosively, bringing your chest to the bar.
Lean over the bar and press yourself up to straight arms.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie face down over a bench and lift your legs behind you. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with feet set wide and small pulses at the top. Burns the glutes with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout.
Lower fully after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling glute kick back with the knee bent. It targets the glutes with a controlled squeeze.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
entries.descriptionEn: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with arms crossed at the chest. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable press with the handles starting low and moving upward. It works the upper chest and front shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.nameEn: lever one arm side chest press
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm press on a chest press machine. Training one side at a time helps balance strength between arms.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip one handle at chest level.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your set.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂侧卧凳上推举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell one arm side lying bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm press done lying on your side on a bench. It targets the chest while the core resists rolling.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell side lying external rotation (on a bench)
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle shoulder rotation lying on your side with a light dumbbell. It strengthens the rotator cuff for joint stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow still.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise light weights in front at a diagonal with thumbs up. It trains the shoulder muscles that lift the arm.
instructionsEn: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise light dumbbells with thumbs pointing down, as if emptying a can. It targets the front and side shoulder.
instructionsEn: Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing down.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to shoulder height.
Hold briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, raise light dumbbells out in a Y with thumbs up. It strengthens the rear shoulder and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly under control.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿肩外旋推举(外展90度)
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling shoulder 90 degrees external rotation press
entries.descriptionEn: From a kneeling position, rotate your forearm up and then press overhead on a cable. It trains shoulder rotation and stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel next to a cable with your elbow at shoulder height and bent 90 degrees.
Hold the handle and brace your core.
Rotate your forearm upward until it points to the ceiling.
Press the handle overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie face down and lift your arms overhead in a Y. It builds the lower traps and the muscles that support the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Lunge forward step by step with a barbell on your back. It builds the legs and glutes and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through your front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Continue alternating legs for the set distance.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯机后撤弓步蹲 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge using the Smith machine for a fixed bar path. It works the glutes and quads with extra stability.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge where you pull a band through your legs. Teaches the hinge and strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine fly with an incline angle that emphasizes the upper chest. The handles move in a fixed arc.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

entries.nameZh: 单臂侧向直臂高位下拉
entries.nameEn: single arm side straight arm lat pulldown
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm cable pulldown from the side, one arm at a time. It isolates the lats without bending the elbow much.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Hold briefly.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing crunch that brings your elbow across to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃上斜后三角肌划船
entries.descriptionEn: A row lying chest-down on an incline bench with elbows flared. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise holding a kettlebell for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and press it overhead. It combines a hip drive with a shoulder press for full-body power.
instructionsEn: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps with a strict path.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standard curl holding a kettlebell, which pulls the weight slightly forward of the hand. It builds the biceps and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on the floor and open your arms out with kettlebells, stopping when your elbows touch down. It trains the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Lift a kettlebell straight in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a kettlebell behind your head and straighten your arms overhead. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Repeat without flaring your elbows.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃仰卧三头肌伸展(颅骨粉碎者)
entries.nameEn: kettlebell lying triceps extension skull crusher
entries.descriptionEn: Lie back and lower a kettlebell toward your forehead, then extend. It builds the triceps with elbows fixed.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Curl a kettlebell with only your wrists while your forearm rests on your thigh. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lower it behind your head. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge swing with your arms moving like a kettlebell swing, but with no weight. It teaches the hip drive and warms up the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 宽站距跳跃深蹲转窄站距跳跃深蹲
entries.nameEn: wide stance jump squat to narrow stance jump squat
entries.descriptionEn: Jump squats that alternate between a wide and a narrow stance. It builds explosive leg power and gets your heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A diamond push-up with your feet raised. It shifts the load toward the triceps and upper chest.
instructionsEn: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃俯身交替扭转划船
entries.nameEn: kettlebell bent over alternate twist row
entries.descriptionEn: A bent over kettlebell row with a rotation as you pull. It trains the back and challenges the core.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on a bench and lower an EZ bar toward your forehead, then press back up. It builds the triceps with minimal wrist strain.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

entries.nameZh: 绳索高位滑轮直杆过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable high pulley straight bar overhead triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: Face away from a high pulley and extend your arms overhead holding a straight bar. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lean into suspension straps and straighten your arms from a bent position. It trains the triceps using your body weight.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
Lower back slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank holding a kettlebell above you. It builds core and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: kettlebell calf raise and front squat
entries.descriptionEn: A combo move that pairs a goblet-style front squat with a calf raise at the top, working the legs from hips to ankles.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Walk on hands and feet with your belly facing up, a playful drill that fires up the glutes, triceps and core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with a diagonal chopping arm motion that trains the legs and teaches the trunk to rotate with control.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A three-part arm combo: curl, press overhead, then lower behind the head for a triceps extension. It works the whole arm in one set.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.

entries.descriptionEn: Curl, press and overhead extension chained into one rep with dumbbells, giving the biceps, shoulders and triceps a full workout.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Exhale slowly and fully.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with a rotation toward the floor, training the glutes and hamstrings while the trunk learns to twist under load.
