instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Lower and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A low plank where the elbows are bent back by your ribs. Builds strength in the arms, chest and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic resting pose at the end of practice. Lets the body relax fully.
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Breathe slowly for 2-5 minutes.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated pose with one shin stacked on the other. Opens the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge with the back heel lifted and arms overhead. Strengthens the legs and stretches the hips.
instructionsEn: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Step forward and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A low lunge with both hands inside the front foot. Opens the hips and groin.
instructionsEn: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated stillness with a tall spine. Calms the mind and trains upright posture.
instructionsEn: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
Stay for 3-10 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated practice of following your breath. Lowers tension and trains focus.
instructionsEn: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
Continue for 3-10 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: The basic standing pose with a tall, balanced posture. A base for most other poses.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.

entries.descriptionEn: A half child's pose with arms reaching forward and hips high. Opens the shoulders and the back.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward fold with one leg back. Deeply stretches the back of the front leg.
instructionsEn: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise slowly and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A chair squat with a twist. Strengthens the legs while rotating the spine.
instructionsEn: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge with a twist and the arms stretched wide. Builds leg strength and opens the spine.
instructionsEn: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward bend with a twist. Stretches the back of the legs and rotates the spine.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Come up and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg balance with the ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Stretches the outer hip.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A halfway forward fold with a flat back. Lengthens the back of the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Roll up slowly to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle twist from hands and knees. Loosens the upper back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Return and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: From hands and knees, you extend one leg back and curl the knee toward your nose. Works the abs and mobilizes the spine.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a twist toward the front leg. Opens the hips and spine.
instructionsEn: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg balance with the torso and back leg parallel to the floor. Builds balance and strength.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
Lower and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated side bend and twist over one extended leg. Stretches the side body and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A sumo deadlift with chains hung on the bar, so the load gets heavier as you stand up. It builds the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructionsEn: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃负重锁链相扑硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: Sumo deadlift with chains added to the bar for extra resistance near lockout, hitting the glutes, thighs and back.
instructionsEn: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.
instructionsEn: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Keep your hips level.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable seated high pulley overhead tricep extension
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.
instructionsEn: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Release your feet and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A preacher curl with a neutral hammer grip that targets the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂中立握前平举
entries.nameEn: cable single arm neutral grip front raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable front raise with a palm-in grip, giving steady tension to the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂中立握前平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell single arm neutral grip front raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm dumbbell front raise using a hammer grip, targeting the front deltoid with less wrist strain.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.
instructionsEn: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.

entries.descriptionEn: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

entries.descriptionEn: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.
instructionsEn: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.
instructionsEn: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.

entries.descriptionEn: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.
instructionsEn: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.

entries.descriptionEn: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.
instructionsEn: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.

entries.descriptionEn: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.
instructionsEn: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Brace your core.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
instructionsEn: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.
instructionsEn: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Lower it and step forward.
Kick the other leg up.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.

entries.descriptionEn: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.
instructionsEn: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Press to downward dog.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.

entries.descriptionEn: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.
instructionsEn: Start in plank pose.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.
instructionsEn: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.
instructionsEn: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.
instructionsEn: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.

entries.descriptionEn: A light deadlift holding a bottle in each hand. A good way to learn the hip hinge.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.
instructionsEn: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.

entries.nameEn: high hurdle jump to sprint and cut
entries.descriptionEn: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

entries.descriptionEn: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.
instructionsEn: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
instructionsEn: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: single leg bridge with outstretched leg (left)
entries.descriptionEn: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

entries.nameEn: single straight leg glute bridge hold (left)
entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructionsEn: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.
instructionsEn: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
instructionsEn: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 绳索低位坐姿划船(V形把手)
entries.nameEn: cable low seated row with v bar
entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable row with a V handle and a neutral grip. It builds the mid back and lats.
instructionsEn: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated or lying tuck that draws knees and chest together to train the abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
Extend again under control.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

entries.nameZh: 绳索后三角肌划船(平行杆)
entries.descriptionEn: A cable row with a parallel bar that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm pulldown variation that isolates the lats by keeping the elbows nearly straight.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A kick-back using the Smith machine bar under the foot, to target the glutes.
instructionsEn: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge holding a weighted bottle in each hand. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with light load.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.

entries.nameZh: 负重瓶单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.nameEn: bottle weighted single leg romanian deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged hip hinge holding weighted bottles. It works the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding weighted bottles at shoulder height. It works the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance squat holding a weighted bottle between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A stationary lunge holding bottles at your sides. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking-style lunge stepping forward with bottles in your hands. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge stepping backward while holding bottles. It is easy on the knees and trains the glutes and quads.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip bridge with a weighted bottle resting on your hips. It isolates the glutes with light load.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat from a kneeling position holding a bottle. It trains the glutes and hips without loading your feet.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with a bottle held overhead. The extra lever length makes your abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch that draws knees and chest together while holding a bottle. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing side bend with a bottle in one hand. It strengthens the obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotation holding a bottle. It works the obliques and deep core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor or bench press with a bottle in each hand. It builds the chest and triceps with light load.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
Repeat for your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing press with a bottle squeezed between your palms. It keeps constant tension on the chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Squeeze inward the whole time.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Pause with your arms extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row with a bottle in each hand. It trains the mid back and lats.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying pullover with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.

entries.nameEn: bottle weighted bent over reverse fly
entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over fly with bottles that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: bottle weighted reverse grip concentration curl
entries.descriptionEn: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm triceps kickback holding a bottle. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
Straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze your triceps.
Bend slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A triceps kickback done with both arms together using two bottles.
instructionsEn: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 负重瓶过头三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead extension with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and strengthens the triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating curls with a bottle in each hand. It builds the biceps and keeps the pace easy.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating curls with palms facing in. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your elbows pinned.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl with an overhand grip holding bottles. It trains the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A vertical pull with bottles toward your chest. It works the shoulders and traps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A high row pulling bottles up toward your armpits. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise with bottles for the front of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A side raise with bottles that builds the shoulder caps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Alternating front raises with a bottle in each hand. It works the front delts.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
Keep your torso still.
Breathe steadily.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with a bottle in each hand. It builds shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Do not arch your lower back.

entries.descriptionEn: A circular movement of a bottle around your head. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

entries.nameEn: front leg lift under knee tap
entries.descriptionEn: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A Pilates move where you lift your legs and trunk together to fold at the hips. It challenges the abs and balance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.
instructionsEn: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and extend your legs.

entries.descriptionEn: The half spinal twist, a seated yoga pose. It stretches the spine and outer hip and improves rotation.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place that foot outside the opposite thigh.
Hug the bent knee with the opposite arm.
Place your other hand behind you and twist toward it.
Lengthen the spine and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm shrug-style movement that trains the muscles that lift and control the shoulder blade. It helps shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over movement where you pull the shoulder blades together with straight arms. It builds the mid-back muscles that stabilize the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending the elbows.
Hold for a moment.
Release the blades and let the weights drop slightly.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill where you squeeze your shoulder blades together with no weight. It wakes up the mid back and helps posture.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squatting pose with the palms pressed together in front of the chest. It opens the hips and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat.
Press your palms together at the chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep squat paired with a trunk rotation. It opens the hips and upper back and improves rotation.
instructionsEn: Lower into a deep squat with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the floor or inside your knee.
Rotate your chest and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return to the center and switch sides.
Keep your heels on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotator cuff exercise using a light dumbbell. It strengthens the small muscles that stabilize the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing dumbbell press that uses a drive from the legs and trunk. It builds shoulder strength and power.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower the weight to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿反向阿诺德推举
entries.descriptionEn: The Arnold press performed in reverse, rotating the palms inward on the way down. It works all three heads of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding dumbbells overhead with your palms forward.
Lower the weights while rotating your palms toward you.
Stop with the dumbbells in front of your chest.
Rotate your palms back outward as you press up.
Lock out the arms overhead.
Keep your back against the pad.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated single arm front raise
entries.descriptionEn: A seated front raise done one arm at a time. It targets the front of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid leaning back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with your arms straight overhead holding a dumbbell. The load increases the demand on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench-supported reverse hyper with a dumbbell held between your feet. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell bent over row against wall
entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell row where you lean on a wall for support. It trains the back while sparing the lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交替严格锤式弯举
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating hammer curl done with strict form, keeping your body still. It builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your torso still.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿交替过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated alternate overhead triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension done one arm after the other. It isolates the triceps through a deep stretch.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl where the elbows move back and the dumbbells drag up along your torso. It hits the biceps with less shoulder help.
instructionsEn: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿双臂集中弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A concentration curl done with both arms at once, elbows braced on your thighs. It isolates the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up variation performed with the hands on dumbbells in a reverse hand position. It focuses on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm snatch that takes a dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion. This version uses the left arm.
instructionsEn: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿单臂过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell. It isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿单臂过头三头肌伸展(左)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension (left)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell. This version uses the left arm.
instructionsEn: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch to the right arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with the soles of your feet together and knees out, holding a dumbbell on your hips. It focuses on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive your hips up by pressing through your feet.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg curl lying on your front while holding a dumbbell between your feet. It targets the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench.
Grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips on the bench.

entries.descriptionEn: A fly on an incline bench with the dumbbells traveling low. It stretches and works the chest.
instructionsEn: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back.
Hold dumbbells above your chest with a soft elbow bend.
Open your arms out and down in an arc.
Stop at a comfortable chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together.
Keep the elbow bend constant.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side squat holding a kettlebell. It builds hip mobility and leg strength.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand wide.
Shift your weight to one side.
Squat down with the other leg straight.
Keep the bent knee over your toes.
Push back to the center.
Alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A shrug holding kettlebells at your sides. It builds the upper traps and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand holding kettlebells at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest tall and neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a band. It strengthens the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand on a band holding the ends with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a leg raise on the left side. It works the obliques and outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg slowly.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Repeat for your set.
Switch sides for the right-side version.

entries.nameZh: 侧平板支撑抬腿 v. 2(左)
entries.nameEn: side plank with raised leg v. 2 (left)
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank on the left side with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling kickback with a straight leg on the left side. It targets the glutes.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips level.

entries.nameEn: elbow to knee side plank crunch (left)
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank on the left with a crunch that brings elbow and knee together. It challenges the obliques.
instructionsEn: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg slightly.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying scissor kick where the legs cross over each other. It trains the inner thighs and lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A rollout using dumbbells in place of a wheel. It challenges the abs.
instructionsEn: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll the dumbbells forward.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Avoid sagging at the hips.

entries.descriptionEn: An incline press where you rotate the dumbbells during the press. It works the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Palms face you.
Press up, rotating your palms forward.
Lock out at the top.
Lower, rotating back.
Keep your shoulders down.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing fly on a cable, one arm at a time. It builds the chest.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Step forward for balance.
Pull the handle across your body.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight row on suspension straps. It builds the back and biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing overhead extension with a dumbbell held in both hands. It targets the triceps.
instructionsEn: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core braced.
Avoid arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat jump holding suspension straps for balance. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps with your arms extended.
Lower into a squat.
Jump up explosively.
Land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A knee push-up followed by a pullback of the hips. It trains the chest and adds a mobility element.
instructionsEn: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
Keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight biceps curl on suspension straps. It builds the biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows high.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight curl using gymnastic rings. It builds the biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows up.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm curl on a ring. It builds the biceps with a lot of control.
instructionsEn: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Keep your elbow up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A face pull on rings. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Pull the rings toward your face.
Flare your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 吊环单臂后三角肌划船
entries.nameEn: ring single arm rear delt row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row on a ring that focuses on the rear delt. It builds shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Squeeze the rear delt.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing wrist curl holding a barbell behind or in front of you. It builds the forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Curl your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing wrist curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearm extensors.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Extend your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃俯卧交替锤式弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A hammer curl lying face down on an incline bench, alternating arms. It builds the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your elbows still.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿交替反握弯举
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating standing curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿过头弯举(曲杆)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated cable curl with an SZ bar, with the cable set up overhead. It targets the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit facing the cable machine.
Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows high.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing rotation of the forearms holding dumbbells. It builds forearm strength.
instructionsEn: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees.
Rotate your palms up.
Rotate your palms down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

entries.nameZh: 曲杆杠铃站姿单臂中立握腕弯举
entries.nameEn: ez barbell standing single arm neutral wrist curl
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm wrist curl with a neutral grip on an EZ barbell. It targets the forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.
Keep your arm at your side.
Curl your wrist up.
Squeeze the forearm.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing wrist roll with a cable handle. It builds forearm strength.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the cable machine.
Hold the handle with straight arms.
Roll your wrists up.
Roll them back down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your arms still.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with your feet raised off the floor. It trains the chest with less leg drive.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar.
Lower it to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A larsen press with a close grip: you bench with your feet off the floor, which removes leg drive and puts the work on chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with a close, shoulder-width grip.
Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Dumbbell bench press done with your legs held out in the air, so your chest and triceps do all the work without help from the lower body.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lie back.
Press the dumbbells up and lift your feet off the floor, legs extended.
Lower the weights to the sides of your chest with control.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.

entries.descriptionEn: A yoga inverted V on your forearms. It stretches the shoulders and hamstrings and builds shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A low push-up hold from plank. It builds triceps, chest and core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Shift forward slightly.
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90 degrees.
Keep your body in one line, elbows close to your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide lunge with arms extended to the sides. It strengthens the legs and opens the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Gaze over your front hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep hip opener on all fours with knees wide. It stretches the inner thighs and groin.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Push your hips back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced arm balance with your torso held horizontally on your elbows. It builds core and wrist strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.

entries.descriptionEn: A prone backbend with one foot pulled toward your hip. It stretches the quads and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated forward fold with a twist and a bent knee. It stretches the back, hips and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: bird of paradise pose svarga dvijasana
entries.descriptionEn: A standing bind pose that straightens one leg upward. It demands balance and flexibility in the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Slowly straighten the lifted leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep backbend pressing up from the floor. It opens the chest and shoulders and strengthens the back and legs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.

entries.nameEn: one legged upward bow pose eka pada urdhva dhanurasana
entries.descriptionEn: A wheel pose with one leg lifted into the air. It adds balance and strength demand to the backbend.
instructionsEn: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Shift weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated wide-leg arm balance with legs extended out to the sides. It needs hip flexibility and core strength.
instructionsEn: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

entries.descriptionEn: A V-shaped balance on your sit bones. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms forward.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A balancing pose with legs and arms wrapped. It stretches the hips and shoulders and trains balance.
instructionsEn: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

entries.nameEn: two legged inverted staff pose dwi pada viparita dandasana
entries.descriptionEn: A supported deep backbend resting on your forearms. It stretches the chest and spine.
instructionsEn: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Keep your forearms firm.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling backbend with hands on your heels. It opens the chest and stretches the thighs and hips.
instructionsEn: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then rise.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing balance with a back-held leg and a forward reach. It stretches the quads and opens the chest.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Reach your free arm forward.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

entries.descriptionEn: A quadruped kick that goes up behind you, then crosses over. It hits the glutes from two angles.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge stepping one leg back and across behind you. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with a deep, low range that challenges your front thigh and glutes while building balance and hip mobility.
instructionsEn: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep split squat holding dumbbells at your sides, great for loading the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A deep split squat with a barbell on your upper back that builds strong quads and glutes and tests your balance.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor move where you sweep one leg under your body from a side-facing support, working your obliques, shoulders and coordination.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that goes down slowly and then jumps up fast, training control, leg strength and power together.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with a forward fold and clasped hands behind you. It stretches the hips, hamstrings and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A static squat hold that builds endurance in your thighs and glutes and teaches a solid bottom position.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated leg press on an outdoor lever machine, pushing the pads away with your legs to train thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated chest press on an outdoor lever machine that works your chest, front shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式户外坐姿高位下拉
entries.descriptionEn: Pulling the handles down from overhead on an outdoor lever machine to build your lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Wrist curls with an EZ bar held in front of you, targeting the muscles on the underside of your forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing wrist curl with dumbbells that builds forearm strength and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Wrist curls using a low cable for steady tension through the whole range, working the inside of your forearms.
instructionsEn: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 曲杆杠铃站姿反握腕弯举
entries.nameEn: ez barbell standing wrist reverse curl
