entries.descriptionEn: Reverse wrist curls with an EZ bar, an overhand movement that trains the top of your forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing reverse wrist curls with dumbbells to strengthen the extensor muscles on top of your forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhand wrist curl on a low cable that works the top of your forearms with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 曲杆杠铃坐姿反握腕弯举
entries.nameEn: ez barbell seated wrist reverse curl
entries.descriptionEn: Seated reverse wrist curl with your forearms supported on your thighs, isolating the top of your forearms.
instructionsEn: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 曲杆杠铃站姿背后腕弯举
entries.nameEn: ez barbell standing back wrist curl
entries.descriptionEn: A wrist curl with the EZ bar held behind your back, training your forearms and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding dumbbells behind your body, you curl your wrists to train your forearms and grip.
instructionsEn: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿背后腕弯举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: cable standing back wrist curl v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A standing wrist curl with a low cable behind you, giving steady tension on your forearm flexors.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 绳索磁力握把高位下拉
entries.nameEn: cable lateral pulldown with mag grip
entries.descriptionEn: A lat pulldown using a magnetic grip handle that builds the wide muscles of your back.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Curling an EZ bar over a preacher pad, which keeps your upper arms still so your biceps do the work.
instructionsEn: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, curling your hips up to hit the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.

entries.descriptionEn: A variation of the band reverse crunch that uses a different setup to challenge your lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 徒手平板支撑位三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: bodyweight triceps extension from plank position
entries.descriptionEn: From a plank, you bend and straighten your elbows to hinge forward and press back, a tough bodyweight move for the triceps.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge holding a dumbbell at your chest, training hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃早安式体前屈 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a kettlebell at your chest, you hinge at the hips to train hamstrings, glutes and your lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with your knees bent, you reach side to side to tap your heels, working your obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge with heels pushed into the floor and toes lifted. It biases the glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A band pulldown pulling the arm from out to your side down to your body. It trains the lats and shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle pendulum swing for the shoulder joint. It loosens the shoulder and warms it up without any load.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂肩屈曲
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing single arm shoulder flexion
entries.descriptionEn: Raising one arm forward against band tension. It trains the front of the shoulder with smooth control.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂肩侧向伸展
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing single arm lateral shoulder extension
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm band move that pulls the arm out and back to the side. It works the shoulder and the muscles behind it.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Rotating the forearm outward against a band, elbow at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Return slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: From a hovering bear plank position, you kick one leg back to fire up your glutes while your core stays steady.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated leg circles that loosen up your hips and gently work the muscles around them.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
Switch directions, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Sitting back on your heels in a kneeling pose that stretches your thighs, shins and ankles while keeping your spine tall.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees open, which shifts the focus onto your glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A loaded hip thrust on a Smith machine with the soles of your feet together, strongly targeting the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a bent top leg that you lift, challenging your obliques and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding a weight plate in each hand, you raise your arms out to the sides to build the middle shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带俯身后三角肌侧平举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Bent over with a band, you raise your arms out wide to work the back of your shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row from a high cable, pulling toward your torso to train the upper back and lats.
instructionsEn: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Brace your core and stand or kneel tall.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂高位肩胛划船
entries.nameEn: cable single arm high scapular row
entries.descriptionEn: A high cable row focused on moving your shoulder blade, building control in your upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a cable high and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your shoulder blade back and down, bending the elbow slightly.
Squeeze at the end.
Release slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂低位肩胛划船
entries.nameEn: cable single arm low scapular row
entries.descriptionEn: A low cable row that emphasises the shoulder blade, training the muscles between and around it.
instructionsEn: Set a cable low and hold the handle with one hand.
Hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Pull your shoulder blade back toward your spine.
Squeeze for a second.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式俯身划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: lever bent over row (with chest support)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported lever row that lets you pull heavy while your lower back stays out of the way.
instructionsEn: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式俯身中立握划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: lever bent over neutral grip row (with chest support)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row with palms facing each other, building your mid-back and lats.
instructionsEn: Lean your chest on the pad and take a neutral grip on the handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式俯身单臂中立握划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: lever bent over single arm neutral grip row (with chest support)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm chest-supported row with a neutral grip, letting you focus on each side of your back.
instructionsEn: Lean your chest against the pad and grip one handle, palm in.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式俯身宽握划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: lever bent over wide grip row (with chest support)
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported row with a wide grip that shifts more work to the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式俯身单臂宽握划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: lever bent over single arm wide grip row (with chest support)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm chest-supported row on a wide handle, hitting the upper back and rear shoulder on one side.
instructionsEn: Lean your chest on the pad and grip one wide handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back with your elbow flaring out.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A hack squat on a linear lever machine that loads your thighs and glutes along a fixed path.
instructionsEn: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your feet to stand.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up combined with a pulling motion, adding upper-back work to a classic chest exercise.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling stretch that opens up your shoulders and lats as you sink your chest toward the floor.
instructionsEn: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿高位到低位飞鸟
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling high to low fly
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable fly pulling from high to low across your body, working the lower chest.
instructionsEn: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A front raise using a rope on a low cable. The cable keeps tension on the front shoulder through the whole lift.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a low cable at your chest. The front load helps you stay upright and drives the thighs and glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it against your chest.
Step back until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Keep your elbows pointing down throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported handstand held in place, building shoulder strength, balance and body control.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip thrust with a landmine bar across the hips. It hits each glute separately and challenges balance.
instructionsEn: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hold hanging from a bar with the body in a slight hollow curve. It builds deep abdominal tension and grip.
instructionsEn: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.

entries.descriptionEn: Knee raises on a decline bench. The slope adds difficulty and focuses on the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

entries.nameEn: weighted plate standing around the world
entries.descriptionEn: Passing a plate in a circle around the body while standing. It works the shoulders and trunk through many angles.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a weight plate with both hands at your waist.
Brace your core and keep your feet planted.
Raise the plate up and over to one side in a wide circle, then around your head.
Bring it back down on the other side.
Keep your hips still as the plate travels.
Do half the reps in each direction.

entries.nameEn: incline push up on a smith bar
entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands on a Smith bar, making it easier than a floor push-up while still training your chest.
instructionsEn: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

entries.nameZh: 徒手后撤弓步蹲过头伸展
entries.nameEn: bodyweight reverse lunge with overhead reach
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach that works your legs and stretches your torso.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge using a low cable. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It builds hamstring and glute strength along with balance.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up on a glute ham bench. The extra range of motion works the abs and hip flexors hard.
instructionsEn: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.

entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up on a shaped ab mat that supports the lower back and allows a fuller range of motion.
instructionsEn: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: A wall sit with a band around the knees and a dumbbell held in your lap, adding glute work to the hold.
instructionsEn: Put a band around your thighs and stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of you.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: Lifting your toes up against the weight of a plate to strengthen the muscle on the front of your shin.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A rotating ab machine movement where you swing your legs and trunk to work the abs.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge held high while stepping the feet out and back. It adds a dynamic challenge for glutes and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with your feet flat on the bench or surface instead of the floor, limiting leg drive and focusing on the chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A low bear crawl with your hips kept down, which challenges your shoulders, legs and core.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat where you hold on to a support to stay balanced, ideal for learning depth and form.
instructionsEn: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute press on a lever machine that targets your glutes by pushing your hips and legs back against resistance.
instructionsEn: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Brace your core.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A curtsey lunge on the smith machine that steps one leg behind and across the other. It hits the glutes and outer hips with a stable bar path.
instructionsEn: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Side stepping with a loop band around the legs. It fires up the hip abductors and glutes.
instructionsEn: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.

entries.nameZh: 低位弓步瑜伽体式(安嘉内亚一式)
entries.nameEn: low lunge yoga pose anjaneyasana i
entries.descriptionEn: A yoga low lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead. It opens the hips and stretches the front of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Step back and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated reach across the body toward the opposite foot. It loosens the trunk and works the obliques gently.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Return to upright with control.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.

entries.nameEn: cable high pull with rope attachment
entries.descriptionEn: A rope pull toward the face from a high pulley. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic barbell deadlift shown from the side to check form. It trains the whole posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling crunch to the side against a high cable. It targets the obliques with steady resistance.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing curl holding a single plate. The plate grip also challenges your hands and forearms.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式哈克深蹲机早安式体前屈
entries.nameEn: lever good morning on the hack squat machine
entries.descriptionEn: A good morning done on a hack squat machine. The machine supports your back while you hinge at the hips.
instructionsEn: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg press on an angled sled. It loads each leg separately for strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips and a band around the thighs. The band keeps the glutes working to hold the knees out.
instructionsEn: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带侧平板臀部上抬
entries.nameEn: resistance band side plank glute raise
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a band around the legs while raising the top leg. It works the outer hip and the side of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Pause briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带稳定球平凳反向挺身
entries.nameEn: resistance band reverse hyper with stability ball on flat bench
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse hyper with your torso on a stability ball and a band adding resistance. It trains glutes and hamstrings while sparing the spine.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable move that lifts the leg out to the side. It targets the outer hip muscles.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带凳上跪姿腿部半圆
entries.nameEn: resistance band kneeling leg half circle on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling band move on a bench, sweeping the leg in a half circle. It works the glutes from several angles.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A donkey kickback on a cable that sends the leg back and slightly out. It focuses on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat position with side steps against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and thighs.
instructionsEn: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle move turning the foot outward against a cable. It strengthens the outer ankle and lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle move turning the foot inward against a cable. It strengthens the inner ankle and lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hamstring curl done from a kneeling position, one leg at a time. It works the back of the thigh.
instructionsEn: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg balance with controlled hip rotation. It works hip mobility and stability together.
instructionsEn: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: side lying diagonal backward leg raise
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg lift that goes back on a diagonal. It focuses on the glutes and outer hip.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A small, focused crunch from lying down. It helps you feel the front abdominal muscle working.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle lying exercise that wakes up the scalene muscles at the side of the neck. It supports neck control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
Return to the middle slowly.
Alternate sides for several reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying rotation that turns the forearm upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff without weights.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm outward. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm inward. It builds rotator cuff strength and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿单臂二头弯举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing single arm biceps curl
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm standing curl. It builds the biceps and lets you focus on each arm separately.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A forearm rotation holding a dumbbell with the arm over the end of a bench. It trains the muscles that turn the palm up.
instructionsEn: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated press with the front of the foot to train the shin muscle. It helps balance the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling trunk rotation on a cable. It trains the obliques while the base stays stable.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor stretch with one shin folded in front. It opens the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing diagonal bend held for a stretch through the back and side of the body.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to standing and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch for the muscles of the forearm. It eases tight wrists after typing or gripping.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing forward fold that lengthens the back and the backs of the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Roll up slowly to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A neck stretch where your hand adds gentle pressure. It eases the side and back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Release slowly and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 侧卧地板滚球后胫骨肌(单腿)
entries.nameEn: roll ball posterior tibialis (single leg) side lying on floor
entries.descriptionEn: Rolling a ball under the inner lower leg while lying on your side. It releases the deep calf muscle that supports the arch.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a small ball under the inside of your lower leg.
Support yourself with your hands and the other leg.
Slowly roll the leg along the ball from calf toward ankle.
Pause on tender spots with light pressure.
Breathe and relax the leg.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side with a ball at the neck to ease the scalene muscles. Use light pressure.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head with a pillow or your hand.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently press or nod to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 侧卧滚球斜角肌激活(侧视)
entries.nameEn: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation (side pov)
entries.descriptionEn: The same side-lying scalene release as seen from the side. A ball at the neck eases the muscles with light pressure.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head so your neck stays neutral.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently move your head to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧滚球头半棘肌激活
entries.nameEn: roll ball lying semispinalis capitis muscle activation
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with a ball under the base of the skull. It releases the deep muscles at the back of the neck.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small ball under the base of your skull.
Relax your head onto the ball.
Make small nods or turns to roll over the muscle.
Keep the pressure gentle.
Breathe slowly.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling stretch for the long strap muscle across the front of the thigh and hip.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling lunge stretch for the deep hip flexor. It helps loosen the front of the hip.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch for the muscles on the outside of the lower leg. It helps ankle mobility.
instructionsEn: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch for the muscle at the front of the shin. Useful after running or lots of walking.
instructionsEn: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch that opens the space between the shoulder blades. It relieves tightness in the upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill that wakes up the small muscles of the feet. It builds foot control and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单侧三角肌划船
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable row with a high elbow. It focuses on the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带坐姿髋外展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A seated move pushing the knees outward against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle hip check where the ankle rests on the opposite knee and the knee drops out. It shows how mobile the hip is.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple check of how far the hip turns outward. You do it gently to see your range.
instructionsEn: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple check of how far the hip turns inward. You do it gently to see your range.
instructionsEn: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying check comparing the length of both legs. It is done gently and with a relaxed body.
instructionsEn: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Relax your hips and arms.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
Check again for any difference.
Stay relaxed throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple check of how far the shoulder turns outward. Move slowly and stay in a pain-free range.
instructionsEn: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Rotate your forearm outward slowly.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple check of how far your shoulder turns inward, handy for spotting tightness before you train.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick posture check to see whether one shoulder sits higher than the other.
instructionsEn: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.
instructionsEn: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

entries.descriptionEn: The frontal-view version of the Thomas test, checking for tight hip flexors and inner thighs while you lie on a bench.
instructionsEn: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance squat on the smith machine down to a chair. The seat gives a consistent depth.
instructionsEn: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways step up onto a bench with a barbell on the back. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿平衡臀部后踢
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing balance glute kickback
entries.descriptionEn: A standing band kickback that builds the glutes while challenging your balance on one leg.
instructionsEn: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying V-up to the side while holding a dumbbell. It works the abs and obliques hard.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃军事推举俄罗斯转体(双腿离地)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off
entries.descriptionEn: A seated combo that pairs an overhead press with a Russian twist, feet off the floor. It challenges the trunk and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them, then twist your torso to one side.
Twist to the other side and repeat the sequence.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿军事推举地面收放腿
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated military press in out leg raise on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press combined with in and out leg movements. It works the shoulders and the lower abs together.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿军事推举保持交替地面抬腿
entries.nameEn: dumbbell seated military hold alternate leg raise on floor
entries.descriptionEn: You hold dumbbells overhead while raising the legs alternately. It trains the lower abs and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor leaning back a little and press the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your arms locked and steady.
Raise one leg off the floor.
Lower it and raise the other leg.
Keep alternating, then lower the weights.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated in and out leg drill that goes to the side and then to the front. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.

entries.nameZh: 平板支撑交替反重力引体
entries.nameEn: plank alternate anti gravity pull up
entries.descriptionEn: From a plank you alternately pull one arm up toward your chest as if climbing. It builds core stability and shoulder control.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.

entries.descriptionEn: A V-up where one arm and the opposite leg meet, holding a dumbbell. It trains the abs through a big range.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms overhead.
Lift your torso and one leg at the same time.
Reach the weights toward your raised foot.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Alternate legs each rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃军事推举俄罗斯转体(双腿离地) v. 2
entries.nameEn: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃过头仰卧起坐(双腿放凳上)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell overhead sit up with legs on bench
entries.descriptionEn: A sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead with the legs resting on a bench. The extra reach makes the abs work harder.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying knee raise against band resistance. It builds the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle release for the muscle under the shoulder blade using a stick for leverage. It helps the shoulder feel looser.
instructionsEn: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated move using a ball to wake up the inner upper thigh. It works the pectineus and the nearby adductors.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with a ball between your knees.
Place your feet flat and keep your back straight.
Squeeze the ball gently with your thighs.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat several times.

entries.descriptionEn: The barbell bench press seen from the side to check bar path and form. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Touch lightly and press back up over your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A fly on an incline bench using kettlebells. It stretches and works the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated side raise using kettlebells. It isolates the side delts without leg drive.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: An inversion where your forearms and head share the load, building shoulder strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Kneel and place your forearms on the mat with your fingers interlaced.
Set the crown of your head lightly on the floor against your hands.
Lift your knees and walk your feet toward your face.
Lift your legs slowly, using your core, until they point to the ceiling.
Keep most of the weight in your forearms and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower with control and rest in child's pose.

entries.nameEn: forearms stand yoga pose pincha mayurasana
entries.descriptionEn: A forearm balance that builds strong shoulders and core, also known as feathered peacock pose.
instructionsEn: Start on your forearms and knees with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the floor and tuck your toes.
Lift your hips high and walk your feet toward your elbows.
Swing or float one leg up, then bring the other to meet it.
Keep your ribs in and your gaze between your hands.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A machine pulldown where the arms cross the body path. It builds the lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across toward your torso.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated floor press that alternates arms, which adds anti-lean trunk work. It trains the shoulders and the core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle spinal extension from all fours that wakes up the back and often pairs with cat pose.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 3-5 breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated pose that stretches the shoulders, triceps and hips together.
instructionsEn: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameEn: deep push up on parallel bars
entries.descriptionEn: A push-up between parallel bars that lets you sink deeper than the floor allows. It gives the chest a greater stretch.
instructionsEn: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated drill squeezing the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles that support good posture.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A variation of the seated shoulder blade squeeze with the arms held out. It strengthens the upper back and posture muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A side-to-side jump over a low hurdle. It builds explosive power and quick landings.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a band supporting the body to make the rep easier. It helps you build toward full push-ups.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with the hands at different heights or one hand doing more work. It gently trains one-arm pulling strength.
instructionsEn: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A full push-up focusing on wrist position and control. It builds the chest while preparing the wrists for load.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.

entries.nameEn: downward dog push up against wall
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-assisted version of a downward dog push-up with a push off at the top. It trains the shoulders in a bent-hip position.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling rollout with the forearms on a stability ball. It builds deep core strength.
instructionsEn: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing twisting move holding a dumbbell that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing twisting move holding a plate that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a plate at its sides in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate the plate left and right using your wrists and forearms.
Move slowly and under control.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿反握弯举旋转
entries.descriptionEn: A standing reverse curl that ends with a forearm rotation. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式坐姿单腿腿举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: lever seated single leg press v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A machine press done with one leg at a time. It helps fix strength imbalances between legs.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式坐姿腿伸展 v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A machine leg extension that isolates the front of the thigh. It builds quad size and strength.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.

entries.nameZh: 曲杆杠铃站姿直立划船
entries.descriptionEn: A vertical pull with an EZ bar that builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor hamstring curl using your own weight, alternating legs to keep it easy on the joints.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A lateral shuffle where each step brings the knee high. It raises your heart rate and builds agility.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated shrug with the cable pulling from behind the body. It trains the traps and the upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: Gliding on inline skates for steady cardio that also works the legs and balance.
instructionsEn: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式坐姿小腿推举 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine calf press that pushes through the balls of the feet. It builds the calf muscles.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式坐姿单腿小腿推举
entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine press working one calf at a time to build lower leg strength.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with a band around the knees, pressing out to light up the side glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带仰卧屈膝髋外展
entries.nameEn: resistance band lying bent knee hip abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A lying hip abduction with bent knees that targets the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band seated bent knee abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A seated band move pressing the knees apart to work the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring the knees back slowly.
Keep your back straight throughout.

entries.nameEn: resistance band lying leg raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A leg raise with band tension that challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A side lunge with band tension that works the legs and hips from a different angle.
instructionsEn: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that steps sideways against a band, firing up the glutes and hips.
instructionsEn: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿平衡臀部后踢 v. 2
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing balance glute kickback v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A second take on the band glute kickback, balancing on one leg while the other presses back.
instructionsEn: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat jump with a band around the thighs to keep the knees driving outward.
instructionsEn: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameEn: resistance band lateral step and squat
entries.descriptionEn: A sideways step into a squat with band tension to train the glutes and legs.
instructionsEn: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated and a band adding resistance.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling donkey-kick style move with band resistance for the glutes.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band kneeling leg half circle
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling leg sweep against a band that works the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with jumping feet and a band around the legs, working your core while the hips resist.
instructionsEn: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Repeat at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down hip extension combined with outward leg movement against a band.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带空中自行车 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: An air bike crunch with band tension for extra work on the abs and hips.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.
Keep a steady rhythm.

entries.descriptionEn: A light rotation exercise lying on your side that turns the arm inward. It strengthens the rotator cuff gently.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 靠墙对侧手臂与腿抬起
entries.nameEn: opposite arm and leg raise against wall
entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported raise of the opposite arm and leg. It trains balance and lower back stability.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A face-down raise with the arms out to form a T. It strengthens the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.
