entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up on rings with a wide grip. The unstable rings make the lats and stabilizers work harder.
instructionsEn: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank you slide a kettlebell under your body from one hand to the other. It works the core and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance row between two kettlebells, alternating arms. It trains the lats and the core.
instructionsEn: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell incline single arm y raise
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported raise on an incline bench to a Y position with one arm. It builds the lower traps and rear delts.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill that moves the shoulder blades in circles. It improves shoulder mobility and control.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, then down.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing shoulder blade rotation that warms up the upper back and improves control of the scapulae.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿肩胛外旋(正视)
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing scapular external rotation (front pov)
entries.descriptionEn: A light dumbbell rotation that trains the rear shoulder and rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Deadlift using a hook grip, where the thumb is trapped under the fingers, for a secure hold on heavy pulls.
instructionsEn: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging straight-body raise toward a front lever position that challenges your abs and lats.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿蛙式半起到全起仰卧起坐
entries.nameEn: seated frog half to full sit up
entries.descriptionEn: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated punching move that fires the abs and shoulders with quick uppercut punches.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

entries.descriptionEn: Plank with feet in suspension straps, piking the hips up to work the abs and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂训练带前平板支撑
entries.descriptionEn: Front plank with feet in straps, making the hold wobbly and demanding for the whole core.
instructionsEn: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

entries.descriptionEn: Gorilla row using a weighted bottle in each hand, a handy way to train the back at home.
instructionsEn: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band hip thrusts on knees
entries.descriptionEn: Kneeling hip thrust against a band that targets the glutes without any bench.
instructionsEn: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
Pause at full hip extension.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂训练带背阔肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: Hanging stretch using straps that opens the sides of your back and your shoulders.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to standing.

entries.nameZh: 悬挂训练带深蹲爆发拉
entries.descriptionEn: Squat paired with an explosive pull on the straps, linking legs and back in one move.
instructionsEn: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing band kickback that isolates the glutes.
instructionsEn: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking with a band around the legs to fire up the outer hips and glutes.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.

entries.descriptionEn: Overhead press using a trap bar, giving a neutral grip that can be easier on the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A small floor movement that teaches you to control the tilt of your pelvis and relax the lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Release back to neutral.
Repeat slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle side stretch for the neck and upper traps, useful after desk work.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 椅子辅助坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
entries.descriptionEn: A seated stretch using a chair to lengthen the back of the thigh without a deep fold.
instructionsEn: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Reverse lunge with the front foot raised for a deeper range, hitting the glutes and quads.
instructionsEn: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式腿伸展(脚尖内扣)
entries.descriptionEn: Leg extension with toes angled in to shift the emphasis on the quads.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Turn your toes slightly inward.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower the weight slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Hyperextension with a dumbbell held to your chest to load the lower back and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: Side to side hopping that swings your legs like a pendulum, training balance and leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: Wide-stance plank with alternating side taps that challenge core stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.

entries.descriptionEn: Wide-stance deadlift on the smith machine that trains glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

entries.descriptionEn: Plate-loaded machine hip thrust for heavy glute work.
instructionsEn: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: Slow lowering phase of a pull-up that builds strength for full pull-ups.
instructionsEn: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing plank against a wall, an easy way to learn core bracing.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.

entries.descriptionEn: Deep weighted squat with heels raised to increase depth and quad work.
instructionsEn: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Squat as deep as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.

entries.nameZh: 后撤弓步高抬膝接前弓步
entries.nameEn: reverse lunge high knee forward lunge
entries.descriptionEn: Combo lunge: step back, drive the knee up, then step forward into a lunge.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, driving both hips up to train the glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A crunch with your legs against a wall that keeps your hips steady and works the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Dip with a leaning body angle that loads the shoulders and triceps hard.
instructionsEn: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing cable fly with palms facing each other to squeeze the chest.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

entries.nameZh: 过头仰卧起坐(双腿放凳上)
entries.nameEn: overhead sit up with legs on bench
entries.descriptionEn: Sit-up with arms overhead and calves on a bench for a longer lever on the abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A glute bridge with one foot placed forward to shift more load to one side.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge with straight legs that shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃站姿前平举与侧平举
entries.nameEn: dumbbell standing front and lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: Combined raise that hits the front and side delts in one rep.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: One-legged sideways hop that builds power and ankle stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Mountain climber where each knee drives toward the same-side elbow, adding side work for the core.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲加提踵
entries.nameEn: dumbbell goblet squat with calf raise
entries.descriptionEn: Goblet squat finished with a calf raise as you stand.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.

entries.nameZh: 双平板开合跳接四次登山者
entries.nameEn: double plank jack to 4 mountain climber
entries.descriptionEn: Conditioning combo of two plank jacks followed by four mountain climbers.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull-up on rings where you pull toward one hand with the other arm extended.
instructionsEn: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: Advanced single-arm pull on a ring that demands serious back and arm strength.
instructionsEn: Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Floor slide that improves shoulder mobility and activates the upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.

entries.descriptionEn: A light hop forward and back that builds ankle spring and coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.

entries.descriptionEn: Wide-stance goblet squat that targets the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃摆动接高脚杯深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: Kettlebell swing flowing into a goblet squat for hips, legs and grip.
instructionsEn: Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃高脚杯保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.descriptionEn: Rear-foot elevated split squat with a dumbbell held at the chest.
instructionsEn: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃垫高保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: dumbbell bulgarian split squat from deficit
entries.descriptionEn: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the front foot raised for greater depth.
instructionsEn: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 徒手脚跟垫高保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: bodyweight heel elevated bulgarian split squat
entries.descriptionEn: Split squat with the front heel raised, loading the quads more directly.
instructionsEn: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃泽奇保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.descriptionEn: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the barbell in your elbow crooks.
instructionsEn: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Doorway stretch that opens up the chest and the fronts of your shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.

entries.nameEn: parallel bars bent knee inverted row
entries.descriptionEn: Easier bodyweight row under parallel bars with knees bent.
instructionsEn: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Jumping jack paired with a high knee for a lively cardio drill.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Jumping jack variation that stays in a squat for a leg-burning cardio move.
instructionsEn: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

entries.descriptionEn: Wall sit with feet close together to focus on the quads.
instructionsEn: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Wall sit with heels raised for a tougher quad hold.
instructionsEn: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

entries.descriptionEn: Wall sit holding a dumbbell at the chest for extra load.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat on one leg, building strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

entries.nameEn: bodyweight single leg squat with support
entries.descriptionEn: Supported single leg squat that helps you progress toward the full version.
instructionsEn: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿股四头肌拉伸 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Seated stretch for the front of your thigh.
instructionsEn: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃摆动高翻握法前蹲
entries.nameEn: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat
entries.descriptionEn: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.nameZh: 绳索分腿站姿单臂划船
entries.nameEn: cable split stance single arm row
entries.descriptionEn: Single-arm cable row in a split stance for stable pulling.
instructionsEn: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pullover with slightly bent arms using a barbell for lats and chest.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: Hack squat with dumbbells held behind the legs.
instructionsEn: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.

entries.descriptionEn: Squat with heels raised to emphasize the quads.
instructionsEn: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

entries.nameEn: cable front squat with v bar
entries.descriptionEn: Front squat holding a V bar on a low cable.
instructionsEn: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.

entries.descriptionEn: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell in the opposite hand to the working leg.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the working leg.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Pull a neutral-grip handle down to your upper chest on a cable stack. It builds the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.

entries.nameZh: 绳索跪姿高低位抗旋转劈砍
entries.nameEn: cable kneeling high low anti rotation chop
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable chop that moves from high to low while your torso resists twisting. It trains the deep core and obliques to stay stable.
instructionsEn: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

entries.nameZh: 绳索同侧臀部主导上台阶
entries.nameEn: cable ipsilateral glute dominant step up
entries.descriptionEn: A step-up with a cable held on the same side as the working leg, leaning forward to bias the glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索单臂高位划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable single arm high row with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable row from a high pulley while your chest rests on a pad. The support lets you focus on the upper back without cheating.
instructionsEn: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Hold a weight plate out in front of you at shoulder height. It builds endurance in the front delts.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling cable kickback that isolates the glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃臀部主导保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: dumbbell glute dominant bulgarian split squat
entries.descriptionEn: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A face pull performed lying on your back with a cable. It hits the rear delts and upper back with little help from momentum.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜后三角肌飞鸟(背部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable incline rear delt fly with back support
entries.descriptionEn: A rear delt fly with cables while your chest rests on an incline bench. It isolates the back of the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.

entries.descriptionEn: A sled leg press with a foot position that puts more load on the glutes. It also works the quads and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

entries.nameZh: 绳索高位划船(胸部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable high row with chest support
entries.descriptionEn: A two-handed cable row from a high pulley with your chest braced on a pad. It trains the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃对侧臀部主导保加利亚分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: dumbbell contralateral glute dominant bulgarian split squat
entries.descriptionEn: A Bulgarian split squat with one dumbbell held in the opposite hand to the front leg.
instructionsEn: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that finishes with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with bands attached to the bar, so resistance rises toward lockout. It builds pressing power across the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃固定销卧推常规握法
entries.nameEn: barbell pin bench press conventional grip
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press started from a dead stop on safety pins, using a standard grip. It builds strength off the chest without any bounce.
instructionsEn: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.

entries.nameZh: 靠墙仰卧单腿腘绳肌拉伸
entries.nameEn: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall
entries.descriptionEn: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: single arm lat stretch against wall
entries.descriptionEn: Stretch one side of your back by reaching an arm overhead against a wall. It lengthens the lat and side of the torso.
instructionsEn: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: flying lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana
entries.descriptionEn: A deep lunge-based hip opener with a twist and reach, stretching the hips and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A biceps curl performed while hinged forward at the hips. The position removes swing and keeps tension on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps you stay upright and load the legs.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

entries.nameZh: 地雷管过头后撤弓步蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A reverse lunge while pressing a landmine bar overhead. It trains the legs, glutes and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃同侧单腿直腿硬拉
entries.nameEn: dumbbell ipsilateral single leg stiff leg deadlift
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg deadlift holding the dumbbell on the same side as the standing leg, for hamstrings and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist
entries.descriptionEn: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A face pull from a half-kneeling stance. The stable position keeps the focus on your rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿旋后面拉(绳索)
entries.nameEn: cable standing supinated face pull (with rope)
entries.descriptionEn: A standing face pull using a rope with an underhand grip. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back, and is gentle on the wrists.
instructionsEn: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A face pull using a towel looped around a fixed anchor and an underhand grip. A simple way to train the rear delts without a cable.
instructionsEn: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

entries.descriptionEn: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.
instructionsEn: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells while bending the elbows into a W shape. It works the rear delts and the upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃摆动高翻握法前蹲 v. 2
entries.nameEn: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: A back-lying core drill that moves opposite arms and legs while keeping the lower back flat.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie on your back with your hips raised, pedalling the legs in a backward motion. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

entries.nameZh: 侧平板扭转手臂三角肌上举
entries.nameEn: side plank twist arm delt raise
entries.descriptionEn: A side plank with a twist that ends in an arm raise. It challenges your obliques and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with fast, powerful movements from the hands or feet. It builds core strength and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式过头三头肌伸展
entries.descriptionEn: A machine overhead triceps extension. The lever path keeps the movement smooth and the focus on the triceps.
instructionsEn: Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃上斜三头肌臂后屈伸
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported kickback on an incline bench that isolates the triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃跪姿三头肌臂后屈伸
entries.descriptionEn: A kickback done in a kneeling position, with one hand on a bench for support.
instructionsEn: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: An explosive push of a weight plate out from your chest for upper-body power.
instructionsEn: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with the end of a landmine bar, easier on the back and good for hips and hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with your hands on towels, adding instability for the chest and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿三头肌伸展 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension with a dumbbell that builds the triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.nameZh: 跪姿躯干旋转后飞鸟穿线
entries.nameEn: kneeling rotation torso rear fly to thread through
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling thoracic mobility move combining a rear fly and a thread-the-needle reach.
instructionsEn: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿单侧二头弯举
entries.descriptionEn: A seated biceps curl with a cable, working one arm at a time. It gives constant tension throughout the movement.
instructionsEn: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐姿单臂单侧二头弯举
entries.nameEn: cable seated single arm unilateral bicep curl
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm cable curl that keeps tension on the biceps. Good for fixing strength gaps between arms.
instructionsEn: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A dumbbell chest press done lying in a glute bridge. It works the chest and triceps while the glutes hold your hips up.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out and up into a Y shape. It trains the shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带45度髋伸展(臀部专注)
entries.nameEn: resistance band 45 degree hip extension glute focused
entries.descriptionEn: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a band added for extra glute load. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.
instructionsEn: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带宽站距抗旋转劈砍
entries.nameEn: resistance band wide stance anti rotation chop
entries.descriptionEn: A band chop in a wide stance where you resist twisting. It strengthens the abs and obliques.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A rotational chop holding a kettlebell from high to low across the body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.
instructionsEn: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell single leg hip thrust v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It hits the glutes hard and shows up strength imbalances.
instructionsEn: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a weight plate on your upper back. The added load makes it harder once regular push-ups feel easy.
instructionsEn: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable kickback with a straight leg, driven back and slightly out to the side. It isolates the glutes.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 二头肌腿部集中弯举(离心)
entries.descriptionEn: A seated concentration curl braced against the thigh with a slow lowering phase. It emphasises the biceps through the negative.
instructionsEn: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿平衡髋外展
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing balance hip abduction
entries.descriptionEn: A standing hip abduction with a band that also challenges your balance. It targets the outer hips.
instructionsEn: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing version of child's pose that rocks the body to stretch the back, hips and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing cable fly where your hands cross in front of the chest. It focuses on squeezing the pecs.
instructionsEn: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.

entries.descriptionEn: A leg press performed lying on your back using a band around your feet. It works the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.

entries.nameEn: triceps dip on high parallel bars
entries.descriptionEn: A dip on high parallel bars with an upright torso. It builds the triceps and chest.
instructionsEn: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧盆底放松与深呼吸
entries.nameEn: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing mobility drill that rotates the ankle through its full range. It warms up the ankle joints.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A chin-up with a wider underhand grip. It hits the lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing leg raise to the front against cable resistance. It trains the hip flexors and front thigh.
instructionsEn: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructionsEn: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.

entries.descriptionEn: A cable chop that travels from low to high across your body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
instructionsEn: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: From lying on your back, you draw your knees toward your chest. It works the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

entries.nameEn: sitting side bend on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides. Easy to do at a desk.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated move where your arms alternate in a swimming motion. A gentle shoulder warm-up for any time.
instructionsEn: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated woodchop with the hands clasped. It works the obliques with no equipment.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

entries.nameEn: sitting prayer chest squeeze on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: Seated, you press your palms together in front of your chest. It trains the chest with no equipment.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿交替外展扭转
entries.nameEn: sitting alternate abduction twist on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated move combining a leg out to the side with a twist. It gently works the hips and waist.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.

entries.nameEn: sitting russian twist on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A Russian twist done seated on a chair. It works the obliques with low impact.
instructionsEn: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.

entries.descriptionEn: A full-depth bodyweight squat. It builds leg strength and works the mobility of hips and ankles.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

entries.descriptionEn: In a plank, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It challenges the core and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A renegade row with an underhand grip on the dumbbells. It builds core stability and works the lats and biceps.
instructionsEn: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell renegade row on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: A renegade row with your feet on a stability ball. The unstable base makes the core work harder.
instructionsEn: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A renegade row using a resistance band. It trains the core while the lats and back do the pulling.
instructionsEn: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A renegade row combined with walking forward in plank. It is a demanding move for core and shoulder stability.
instructionsEn: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: Lie under a sturdy table and curl your body up by gripping the edge. A bodyweight biceps exercise.
instructionsEn: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side, you open one arm backward to stretch the chest. It loosens tight pecs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索直臂下拉(绳索把手)
entries.nameEn: cable straight arm pulldown (with rope attachment)
entries.descriptionEn: A straight-arm pulldown using a rope. It isolates the lats with no help from the arms.
instructionsEn: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.

entries.nameZh: 绳索半跪单臂划船 v. 2
entries.nameEn: cable half kneeling single arm row v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable row from a half-kneeling stance. It works the lats and challenges your core stability.
instructionsEn: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: seated upright twists on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated trunk twist done tall on a chair. It loosens the spine and works the obliques gently.
instructionsEn: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Pause briefly.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.

entries.nameEn: seated side bend on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl variation where the elbows travel back as you pull, putting the biceps under steady band tension.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Press your arms up and slightly back while lifting your chest.
Extend through your upper back without flaring your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for smooth, slow reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A bridge with the heels placed farther away so the hamstrings and glutes do more of the lifting.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing shoulder internal rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A light band drill that strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder, handy for joint health.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm across your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing shoulder external rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A band drill that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles on the back of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the elbow tucked at your side, bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带站姿单臂侧平举
entries.nameEn: resistance band standing single arm lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm side raise using band tension to train the middle part of the shoulder.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in the elbow and your torso still.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: resistance band standing 90 degrees shoulder external rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A band rotation with the upper arm raised to shoulder height, building rotator cuff strength for overhead positions.
instructionsEn: Anchor the band at shoulder height and hold the handle with your elbow raised to shoulder level, bent 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm still.
Rotate your hand up and back until the forearm points to the ceiling.
Return slowly to the start.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带过头肩部推举 v. 2
entries.nameEn: resistance band overhead shoulder press v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press with a band, training the shoulders and triceps with tension that rises toward the top.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep ribs down.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.
Repeat without leaning back.

entries.descriptionEn: A band stretch that moves overhead and behind you, opening up the shoulders and chest.
instructionsEn: Hold the band in front of your thighs with a wide grip and straight arms.
Stand tall.
Raise the band overhead and keep going back behind your body.
Reverse the path to return to the front.
Widen your grip if it feels too tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A swing performed to the side of the body that hits the obliques and hips while the legs drive the kettlebell.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and swing it up and across to one side.
Let it fall back through your legs and swing to the other side.
Keep your back flat throughout.

entries.nameEn: seated over head straight arm stretch
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead reach that stretches the chest and shoulders. It helps open up the upper body after desk time.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated twist holding a kettlebell. It builds the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat that steps one leg out to the side before returning. It works the legs and hips with a bit of lateral movement.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded angled press that works the thighs and glutes with a stable seated position.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees out.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you tap a hand to the floor at the side, challenging the obliques and anti-rotation control.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

entries.nameEn: seated lean back on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

entries.nameEn: seated cross body punch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

entries.nameEn: seated overhead stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A simple seated stretch that opens up the sides of your back and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

entries.nameEn: seated forward bend stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.
instructionsEn: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

entries.nameEn: seated forward roll up on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated roll-up that curls the spine forward one segment at a time. It trains the abs and spinal control.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

entries.nameZh: 波速球平衡配重滑冰深蹲
entries.nameEn: bosu ball balance counterbalanced skater squat
entries.descriptionEn: A single-leg squat on a bosu ball with the free leg reaching back for balance, challenging the legs and stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃跪姿对侧肩部推举
entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling one-arm press where the opposite knee is down, adding core and hip stability to the shoulder work.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell kneeling twist down up raise
entries.descriptionEn: A diagonal chopping and lifting pattern from a kneeling position that trains the obliques and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A flowing move from kneeling up into a squat, working the legs, glutes and balance.
instructionsEn: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

entries.descriptionEn: A wall-supported toe raise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the shins.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

entries.nameEn: lying prone y to t to w
entries.descriptionEn: A prone sequence of arm positions that strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
instructionsEn: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple drill that squeezes the elbows back to engage the mid back. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructionsEn: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式坐姿腿弯举(插片式)
entries.descriptionEn: A plate-loaded seated curl that isolates the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance squat with a band adding resistance to the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank variation held with a modified base that challenges core stability.
instructionsEn: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the outside of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the inside of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A preacher curl with a little controlled swing to push past the sticking point.
instructionsEn: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

entries.nameZh: 绳索站姿单臂水平三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: cable standing single arm horizontal triceps extension
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable pushdown in a horizontal path, isolating the triceps.
instructionsEn: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿交替动态胸部拉伸
entries.nameEn: seated alternate dynamic chest stretch on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated dynamic stretch that opens the chest by alternating arms.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿肘部夹胸飞鸟
entries.nameEn: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

entries.nameEn: seated external rotation on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated rotation drill for the back of the shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

entries.nameEn: seated chest press on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated pressing motion done with bodyweight tension to work the chest and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

entries.nameEn: seated arm crossover on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

entries.nameEn: seated decline chest press on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated press angled downward to bias the lower chest.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

entries.nameEn: seated pec dec on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

entries.nameEn: seated incline chest press on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated press angled upward to emphasise the upper chest.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
