Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

entries.nameEn: seated shoulder press on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead press without equipment that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿旋转拳击滚动
entries.nameEn: seated rotating boxing rolls on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated drill of circular arm rolls and trunk rotation that lifts your heart rate.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

entries.nameEn: seated shoulder tap on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated drill where you tap each shoulder with the opposite hand, adding light coordination and shoulder work.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

entries.nameEn: seated open up and under swing on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿过头三头肌伸展
entries.nameEn: seated overhead triceps extension on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated overhead extension that works the triceps using your own arm resistance.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

entries.nameZh: 椅上坐姿反握手臂画圈
entries.nameEn: seated underhand arm circle on a chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated arm circle with palms up to warm up the shoulder joints.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.

entries.descriptionEn: A sideways leg press on a sled that targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructionsEn: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜Y字上举(背部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable incline y raise with back support
entries.descriptionEn: A Y-shaped raise with cables while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜窄握肩部推举(V形把手)
entries.nameEn: cable incline close grip shoulder press with v bar
entries.descriptionEn: A close-grip incline cable press using a V bar that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructionsEn: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜Y字上举腕带(背部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable incline y raise wrist straps with back support
entries.descriptionEn: A cable Y raise using wrist straps to reduce grip demand, supported on an incline bench.
instructionsEn: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃屈膝礼弓步蹲 v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge where one leg crosses behind you, working the glutes and outer hips with added load.
instructionsEn: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking lunge carrying a weighted bag, building the legs, glutes and core.
instructionsEn: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hard push of a torque tank sled across the floor that fires up the legs and the heart.
instructionsEn: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A rope pull that brings the rope toward you, working the back, arms and grip with a conditioning effect.
instructionsEn: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A burpee that finishes with a jump onto a box, great for full-body conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式罗马尼亚硬拉(插片式)
entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge on a plate-loaded machine that trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

entries.nameEn: seated alternate knee extension on chair
entries.descriptionEn: A seated leg extension done by alternating legs, working the thighs without equipment.
instructionsEn: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

entries.descriptionEn: An advanced ring move that sweeps the body over the rings, working the lats and core.
instructionsEn: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with a heel raise added at the top. It works the quads, glutes and calves together.
instructionsEn: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: barbell lying seal row on rack
entries.descriptionEn: A chest-supported barbell row lying on a raised bench or rack, removing the lower back from the lift.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式单腿硬拉(哈克深蹲机)
entries.nameEn: leverage single leg deadlift on hack squat machine
entries.descriptionEn: A single leg deadlift performed on a hack squat machine. It trains the glutes and hamstrings with extra stability.
instructionsEn: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯错位站姿罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance on the smith machine. It focuses on the hamstrings and glutes of the front leg.
instructionsEn: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing machine lateral raise that isolates the side shoulders.
instructionsEn: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Keep your torso upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 负重哑铃仰卧屈膝抬腿
entries.descriptionEn: A lying knee raise holding a dumbbell between your feet or legs, challenging the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick lateral stepping drill with a band around the legs to speed up the feet and fire the glutes.
instructionsEn: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.

entries.nameEn: cable lying single leg hip flexion
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back with a cable strapped to one ankle, you pull the knee toward your chest. It builds hip flexor strength.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧屈髋(反向深蹲)
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you pull both knees toward your chest against cable resistance, like a squat in reverse. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

entries.descriptionEn: Opening your fingers against a band strengthens the small extensor muscles of the hand and forearm. It is a good balance for all the gripping you do.
instructionsEn: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinged forward at about 45 degrees, you pull the cable handles apart in a wide arc. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.

entries.nameEn: cable half kneeling external rotation press
entries.descriptionEn: From a half kneeling stance you rotate the arm outward and press the cable overhead. It trains shoulder stability along with the press.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A quick punch thrown against cable resistance builds fast, explosive pushing power. It also trains the trunk to resist twisting.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: You rotate the forearm so the palm turns down against cable resistance. It strengthens the pronator muscles of the forearm.
instructionsEn: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: You wind a rope with a weight on it by turning a bar with a neutral grip. It builds forearm and grip endurance.
instructionsEn: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.

entries.descriptionEn: Hinging forward with a weighted bag on your back trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. It teaches a strong hip hinge.
instructionsEn: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with a staggered stance holding a kettlebell. It loads one leg more than the other.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch stances after your set.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up with a knee tuck toward the chest at the top. It combines upper body pressing with an ab crunch.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.

entries.descriptionEn: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.
instructionsEn: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.

entries.nameZh: 俯身背部伸展肩胛内收
entries.nameEn: bent over back extension scapular adduction
entries.descriptionEn: From a bent over position you raise your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the whole back chain.
instructionsEn: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising the arms in a Y shape against cable tension works the lower traps and shoulders. It supports healthy overhead movement.
instructionsEn: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

entries.descriptionEn: A second variation of the cable punch, built for quick power in the pushing muscles. Your trunk works to stay stable.
instructionsEn: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
Repeat, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: cable single arm lateral raise v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: Lifting one arm out to the side against a cable keeps constant tension on the side delt. It builds shoulder width.
instructionsEn: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.
instructionsEn: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated on a bench or floor, you lift one straight leg to train the hip flexors and thigh. It is a simple core and leg exercise.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Sliding down a wall into a squat with your heels planted teaches good squat depth and control. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.

entries.descriptionEn: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
instructionsEn: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式侧坐单臂后三角肌飞鸟
entries.nameEn: lever side seated single arm rear delt fly
entries.descriptionEn: Seated sideways on a machine, you pull one arm back in a wide arc. It isolates the rear delt.
instructionsEn: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, you hinge and extend the back. It loads the lower back, glutes and core.
instructionsEn: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid hyperextending at the top.
Use a light weight and control the bar.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank where you extend an opposite arm and leg to challenge balance. It builds trunk stability.
instructionsEn: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying face down over a ball, you lift your legs behind you to work the glutes and lower back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.

entries.nameEn: medicine ball crunch on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: Crunching on a stability ball while holding a medicine ball adds range and load to the abs.
instructionsEn: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause at the top.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.

entries.descriptionEn: Seated on a ball, you chop diagonally across your body. It trains the obliques and trunk control.
instructionsEn: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning into a wall, you drive your knees in a fast running pattern. It practises sprint posture and builds speed.
instructionsEn: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.

entries.nameZh: 史密斯前腿垫高分腿蹲
entries.nameEn: smith front leg elevated split squat
entries.descriptionEn: With the front foot raised on a step and the bar on your back, you sink into a deep split squat. It loads the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with the rear foot raised on a bench, done on a smith machine. It targets the quads and glutes with extra stability.
instructionsEn: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Hanging from a bar, you hold your body horizontal with your knees tucked. It builds lats and core strength.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.

entries.nameZh: 悬垂进阶团身前水平保持
entries.nameEn: hanging advanced tucked front lever hold
entries.descriptionEn: A harder front lever hold with the knees tucked but the hips open. It demands strong lats and core.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: The full front lever: a straight horizontal body hold under a bar. It is an advanced test of back and core strength.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.

entries.nameZh: 稳定球直髋单腿腿弯举
entries.nameEn: straight hip single leg curl on stability ball
entries.descriptionEn: With your heels on a ball and hips lifted, you curl it in with one leg. It hits the hamstrings and glutes hard.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Keep your hips high.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A mountain climber variation where you bring each knee across toward the opposite elbow. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on an incline bench, you lift your hips off the pad by curling the pelvis. It targets the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

entries.descriptionEn: Hopping on one leg forward, back and side to side trains balance, ankle stability and power.
instructionsEn: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: You step off a box and land on both feet to practise soft landings. It builds impact control.
instructionsEn: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Small, quick hops off the balls of both feet. It builds calf and ankle stiffness and bounce.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.

entries.nameZh: 木棒站姿肩部后伸活动度练习
entries.nameEn: stick standing shoulder mobilization in extension
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a stick behind your back, you lift it away to open the front of the shoulders. It improves shoulder extension.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 木棒站姿肩部外旋活动度练习
entries.nameEn: stick standing shoulder mobilization in external rotation
entries.descriptionEn: Using a stick to guide the arm, you rotate the shoulder outward. It improves external rotation range.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 木棒肩部外展活动度练习
entries.descriptionEn: Using a stick, you guide one arm out and up to the side. It opens up shoulder range overhead.
instructionsEn: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.

entries.nameEn: standing alternating shoulder flexion with rope
entries.descriptionEn: A standing drill that lifts one arm at a time in front of you while holding a rope. It warms the shoulders and improves control.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a rope in one hand at your side.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height or above.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms each rep.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

entries.descriptionEn: Raising a stick in front of you with straight arms warms up the shoulders. It is a light, controlled drill.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.

entries.nameEn: dumbbell lying straight arm press on floor
entries.descriptionEn: A floor press with the arms kept straight. It trains the chest and shoulders without a big range of motion.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: In a wide stance you rotate your upper back to loosen the thoracic spine. It helps with trunk twisting.
instructionsEn: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Quick shuffling steps forward and back build footwork and conditioning. It keeps your heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.

entries.descriptionEn: Sitting on the floor, you pull your toes toward your shins to work the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.

entries.nameZh: 绳索中立握宽距下拉 v. 3
entries.nameEn: cable neutral grip wide pulldown v. 3
entries.descriptionEn: A wide, neutral grip pulldown on a cable machine that builds the lats and upper back.
instructionsEn: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise held at the top. It builds calf endurance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.

entries.nameEn: isometric hold wide hand push up
entries.descriptionEn: A wide-grip push-up held halfway down. It builds chest strength under tension.
instructionsEn: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: With your hands on a high bar, you do an easier incline push up. A great stepping stone toward floor push ups.
instructionsEn: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.

entries.nameZh: 吊环等长保持反向腹轮滚动
entries.nameEn: ring isometric hold reverse ab rollout
entries.descriptionEn: Holding a reverse rollout position on rings challenges the abs and shoulders. A tough anti-extension hold.
instructionsEn: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Return slowly.

entries.nameEn: 45 degree hip extension glute focused v. 2
entries.descriptionEn: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench that emphasises the glutes. It strengthens the posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: A split squat with the rear foot on a bench builds leg strength and balance, one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 吊环垫高屈体俯卧撑(深度)
entries.nameEn: ring elevated pike push up from deficit
entries.descriptionEn: A pike push up with feet elevated and hands on rings, so you go deeper. It builds strong overhead pressing.
instructionsEn: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

entries.nameZh: 坐姿等长保持引体向上
entries.descriptionEn: Holding the top of a pull up while seated helps you build pulling strength. It works the lats and arms.
instructionsEn: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on the floor, you lower your straight body slowly for the dragon flag. A tough ab and core strengthener.
instructionsEn: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.

entries.nameEn: lying floor negative half dragon flag
entries.descriptionEn: A gentler dragon flag lowering with your knees bent. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
instructionsEn: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 等长保持窄握反手引体向上
entries.nameEn: isometric hold close grip chin up
entries.descriptionEn: A close grip chin-up held at the top or halfway. It builds pulling strength and grip.
instructionsEn: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: Small alternating kicks while lying down. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

entries.nameZh: 仰卧地面单腿离心龙旗
entries.nameEn: lying floor single leg negative dragon flag
entries.descriptionEn: A dragon flag lowering with one leg extended and one tucked. It's a step between the half and full versions.
instructionsEn: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: An air squat with a wide stance, touching a bench to guide your depth. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

entries.descriptionEn: Standing on one leg, you extend the straight leg behind you. It strengthens the glutes and trains balance.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A push-up held in place at the top or bottom. It builds chest, arm and core strength.
instructionsEn: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-legged bridge with your heel planted that works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hybrid of a close grip bench press and skull crusher done on a smith machine. It loads the triceps.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows slightly in.
Press the bar back up.
Use a light weight and control the path.

entries.descriptionEn: Pressing with one leg on an angled leg press machine focuses the work on the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式站姿蝴蝶机夹胸
entries.descriptionEn: Standing at a machine, you bring your arms together in front of your chest. It isolates the chest.
instructionsEn: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.

entries.descriptionEn: Quick, low hops on the spot that keep your feet barely off the floor. They warm up the calves and ankles and build bouncy reactive strength.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.

entries.nameZh: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝提踵
entries.nameEn: standing bent knee calf raise with a chair support
entries.descriptionEn: A calf raise with the knees slightly bent while holding a chair. It targets the deeper soleus muscle.
instructionsEn: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃站姿屈膝垫高提踵
entries.nameEn: barbell standing bent knee calf raise from deficit
entries.descriptionEn: A standing calf raise with a bent knee and the balls of your feet on a raised edge, which shifts work toward the soleus. The deficit gives a deeper stretch at the bottom.
instructionsEn: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low platform.
Soften your knees into a slight bend and keep that angle throughout.
Lower your heels below the platform until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.

entries.nameZh: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝交替提踵
entries.nameEn: standing bent knee alternating calf raise with a chair support
entries.descriptionEn: An alternating calf raise with the knees bent, using a chair for balance. It works the soleus one side at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.

entries.descriptionEn: A floor hold where you lie on your back with your legs and shoulders lifted about six inches. It trains deep abdominal tension and endurance.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.
instructionsEn: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift flowing straight into a squat while holding a kettlebell. It trains the hips and thighs with a nice rhythm.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A gymnastics-style hollow position on your back with arms and legs reaching away. It builds strong, braced abs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

entries.descriptionEn: From a seated position with hands behind you, you lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A folded stance with hips high and head down, shifting weight over your hands. It opens the hamstrings and loads the shoulders.
instructionsEn: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

entries.descriptionEn: While hanging from a bar, you lean your body to each side to work the obliques and grip.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A simple step onto a box that trains the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameEn: cable side lying single arm lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: Lying on your side, you raise a cable handle out and up to isolate the side delts with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧直立划船(曲杆)
entries.descriptionEn: An upright row done lying on your back with a cambered bar on a low cable. It hits the delts and traps with steady tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grip the SZ bar.
Start with arms extended over your thighs.
Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: A wide-stance squat on a belt squat machine where the load hangs from your hips, sparing your spine. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Attach the belt around your hips and stand with a wide stance, toes out.
Keep your chest tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit down between your legs.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式腰带罗马尼亚硬拉
entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge using a belt machine so the weight hangs from your hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes without loading the back.
instructionsEn: Wear the belt and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat with smooth control.

entries.descriptionEn: A suspension-strap row with wide elbows that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated machine raise where your knees stay bent, which emphasises the soleus under the calf.
instructionsEn: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up where a partner supports your legs or hips. It lets you build pulling strength while you work toward full reps.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.

entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with your feet on a box for light assistance. It helps you build up to full pull-ups.
instructionsEn: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

entries.nameZh: 箱子单腿辅助引体向上
entries.nameEn: box single leg assisted pull up
entries.descriptionEn: A pull-up with only one foot on a box for assistance. It is a step closer to a full pull-up.
instructionsEn: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.

entries.descriptionEn: A vertical jump with a quick dip and an arm swing that adds momentum. It builds explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃坐姿早安式体前屈
entries.descriptionEn: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃垫高脚跟高翻握法深蹲
entries.nameEn: barbell elevated heel clean grip squat
entries.descriptionEn: A squat with your heels raised and a clean-width grip, which keeps the torso upright and loads the quads.
instructionsEn: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug done while holding a kettlebell overhead, adding load to the core challenge.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A dead bug combined with a kettlebell pullover, where arms and legs extend in opposite directions.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
Switch sides and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-down drill that builds knee and hip control. It strengthens the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-down from a box that strengthens the quads and teaches knee control.
instructionsEn: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A controlled step-up and down drill often used for knee strength. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A box step-down drill that builds knee strength and control in the quads and glutes.
instructionsEn: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A step-down drill with a slow, controlled lowering. It builds quad strength and knee stability.
instructionsEn: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A plyometric where you step off a box, land, and jump up immediately. It trains reactive strength in the legs.
instructionsEn: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A max-effort pull against a fixed bar at mid-thigh height. It builds force production through the hips and back.
instructionsEn: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.

entries.descriptionEn: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.
instructionsEn: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.

entries.descriptionEn: A hip hinge lifting a kettlebell from the floor. It teaches solid deadlift mechanics and builds the posterior chain.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward lunge holding a plate overhead. It trains the legs while challenging shoulder stability and the core.
instructionsEn: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward lunge with your arms stretched overhead, adding a core and shoulder challenge to the leg work.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

entries.descriptionEn: Stepping across a box with dumbbells in your hands. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.

entries.descriptionEn: A dynamic standing twist where your arms swing with the rotation. It loosens up the spine and obliques.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: The classic lying leg curl on a machine, isolating the hamstrings.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

entries.descriptionEn: From a plank, you hop your feet side to side. It challenges the core and gets your heart rate up.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A hopping drill where you drive a knee up and tap it with your hand. It raises the heart rate and builds coordination.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Keep your chest upright.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.

entries.descriptionEn: A front squat with a dumbbell and raised heels, which keeps your torso upright and puts the work on the quads.
instructionsEn: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up to stand.

entries.descriptionEn: A bodyweight squat with your heels raised. It shifts the work to the quads and allows a deeper position.
instructionsEn: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃交替单臂推举深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A squat into a press with kettlebells, alternating arms. It is a full-body conditioning move.
instructionsEn: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Press the other arm on the next rep.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃交替单臂推举深蹲
entries.descriptionEn: A squat into an overhead press, alternating arms with dumbbells. It works legs and shoulders together.
instructionsEn: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Alternate arms each rep.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press from a half-kneeling stance, which demands core and hip stability.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm landmine press from a half-kneeling position, easy on the shoulder and tough on the core.
instructionsEn: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A deadlift with a wide, toes-out stance. It shortens the range and loads the glutes and inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar with control.

entries.nameZh: 壶铃倒握单臂过头负重行走
entries.nameEn: kettlebell bottoms up single arm overhead carry
entries.descriptionEn: Carrying a kettlebell upside down overhead with one arm. It builds shoulder stability and a strong grip.
instructionsEn: Clean a kettlebell so it is upside down with the bell above your fist.
Press it overhead with a firm wrist.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk slowly in a straight line.
Lower it safely and switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A two-arm dumbbell row with your chest on an incline bench. It isolates the back without strain on the lower spine.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

entries.nameZh: 哑铃单臂胸部支撑划船
entries.nameEn: dumbbell single arm chest supported row
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A walking lunge with a deep, low position that opens the hips and works the glutes and thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

entries.nameZh: 长距离弓步蹲(低位弓步)
entries.descriptionEn: A lunge with an extra-long stride into a low position. It stretches the hips while working the glutes and thighs.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat held low with small pulses, with your hands clasped at your chest as if holding a weight. It builds thigh endurance.
instructionsEn: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.

entries.descriptionEn: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. It removes leg drive and challenges the core.
instructionsEn: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: A headstand variation using suspension straps for support. It builds balance and shoulder strength.
instructionsEn: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

entries.descriptionEn: Lying on the floor, you lift a cable handle up in front of you to isolate the front delts.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

entries.descriptionEn: Leaning against a wall, you lift your toes toward your shins to train the muscle at the front of your lower leg.
instructionsEn: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.
instructionsEn: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with a leg lift into a mountain climber. It trains the core and raises the heart rate.
instructionsEn: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing hip thrust on a lever machine. It targets the glutes with a smooth, guided path.
instructionsEn: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down.

entries.descriptionEn: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆式单臂牧师凳弯举(插片式)
entries.nameEn: lever single arm preacher curl (plate loaded)
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm curl on a plate-loaded preacher machine, isolating the biceps.
instructionsEn: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 绳索侧卧地面单腿后踢
entries.nameEn: cable side lying floor single leg kickback
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg kickback with a cable. It isolates the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

entries.descriptionEn: A belt-machine deadlift using a V handle, so the load hangs from your hips.
instructionsEn: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

entries.descriptionEn: A belt-machine deadlift using a straight bar, so the load hangs from your hips.
instructionsEn: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

entries.nameEn: cable 45 degrees reverse grip reverse fly
entries.descriptionEn: A cable reverse fly with a palms-up grip, angled at 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructionsEn: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

entries.nameEn: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse fly
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable reverse fly, hinged at 45 degrees to target the rear delt.
instructionsEn: Stand at a cable station and take one handle.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索45度单臂反握反向飞鸟
entries.nameEn: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse grip reverse fly
entries.descriptionEn: A one-arm cable reverse fly with a palm-up grip, hinged at 45 degrees.
instructionsEn: Stand at a cable station and take one handle with your palm up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(背部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable incline single arm y raise with back support
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm Y raise while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with a cable handle in one hand.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause with your thumb up.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(腕带,背部支撑)
entries.nameEn: cable incline single arm y raise wrist straps with back support
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm cable Y raise using wrist straps, so your grip does not limit the shoulder work.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

entries.nameEn: cable lying bench cross lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A lying lateral raise where each hand grips the opposite cable handle and the arms sweep up and across. It hits the side delts with constant tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 绳索卧凳单臂交叉侧平举
entries.nameEn: cable lying bench single arm cross lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A one-armed lying lateral raise across the body with a low cable. It isolates a single side delt and lets you fix imbalances.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧单臂交叉侧平举
entries.nameEn: cable lying single arm cross lateral raise
entries.descriptionEn: A single-arm lateral raise done lying on your side or back on the floor with a low cable crossing the body. It trains the side delt under steady tension.
instructionsEn: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索坐凳单臂转体划船
entries.nameEn: cable sitting bench single arm twisting row
entries.descriptionEn: A seated one-arm cable row where you rotate the torso and wrist as you pull. It works the lats and mid back through a longer range.
instructionsEn: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(直杆)
entries.descriptionEn: A Romanian deadlift on a belt-loaded lever machine using a straight bar. It builds the hamstrings and glutes while sparing the grip and spine from heavy free weight.
instructionsEn: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.

entries.nameZh: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(V型杆)
entries.descriptionEn: A belt-loaded lever machine Romanian deadlift using a V bar for a neutral grip. It targets the hamstrings and glutes with a comfortable hand position.
instructionsEn: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

entries.descriptionEn: A squat holding a low cable in the crook of your elbows in front of you. The front load keeps you upright and works the quads, glutes and core.
instructionsEn: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest.
Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked and the load close to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle standing move where you tilt and lift the pelvis by squeezing the glutes and abs. It teaches pelvic control and activates the hips.
instructionsEn: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

entries.nameEn: cable lying incline side leg raise
entries.descriptionEn: A side-lying leg raise with a cable on an incline. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 绳索仰卧上斜单腿后踢
entries.nameEn: cable lying incline single leg kickback
entries.descriptionEn: A single leg kickback lying on an incline with a cable. It focuses on the glutes.
instructionsEn: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.nameZh: 哈克深蹲机单腿深蹲(杠杆)
entries.nameEn: leverage single leg squat on hack squat machine
entries.descriptionEn: A single leg squat on a hack squat machine. It adds stability while loading one leg at a time.
instructionsEn: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A hybrid of a skull crusher and a bench press where the bar lowers toward the forehead then presses up and back over the chest. It hits the chest and triceps together.
instructionsEn: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.

entries.descriptionEn: A curl performed chest-down on an incline bench so the arms hang straight. It removes swing and puts the stress on the biceps.
instructionsEn: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

entries.nameZh: 杠铃弹力带负重杠铃片卧推
entries.nameEn: barbell banded weighted plate bench press
entries.descriptionEn: A bench press with resistance bands and plates added to the bar so the load gets heavier as you lock out. It builds chest and triceps strength through the top range.
instructionsEn: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.

entries.descriptionEn: A seated lateral raise lifting one dumbbell at a time. Sitting reduces body swing so the side delts do the work.
instructionsEn: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A drag-style move where you pull a loaded sled toward you with a rope or strap, walking backward. It trains the back, arms and legs together.
instructionsEn: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.

entries.descriptionEn: A forward lunge holding a sandbag at your chest or on your shoulders. The awkward load challenges your legs and core.
instructionsEn: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.

entries.descriptionEn: A standing stretch with your legs crossed that lengthens the sides of the trunk. It loosens the obliques and waist.
instructionsEn: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

entries.descriptionEn: A gentle floor move where you slide your heel toward your hips and back. It restores knee and hip bend with low strain.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

entries.descriptionEn: A calm lying breathing drill that focuses on belly breathing. It helps you relax and learn core control.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.

entries.descriptionEn: A shoulder mobility drill where a stick helps one arm lift forward and overhead. The other hand guides the movement.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

entries.descriptionEn: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.
instructionsEn: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.

entries.descriptionEn: A kneeling sissy squat with a resistance band for assistance or load. It places a big stretch on the quads.
instructionsEn: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.

entries.nameEn: stick assisted standing shoulder internal rotation
entries.descriptionEn: A mobility drill where you use a stick behind your back to help rotate the shoulder inward. It improves reach and range.
instructionsEn: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.

entries.nameZh: 站姿靠墙肩内旋等长收缩
entries.nameEn: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
entries.descriptionEn: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.
instructionsEn: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 球辅助仰卧屈膝髋内收等长收缩
entries.nameEn: ball assisted lying bent knee isometric hip adduction
entries.descriptionEn: A lying hip adduction hold squeezing a ball between the knees. It trains the inner thighs.
instructionsEn: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.

entries.descriptionEn: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.
instructionsEn: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.

entries.nameZh: 弹力带拇指伸展等长收缩
entries.descriptionEn: A thumb hold against a band that builds strength in the muscles that extend the thumb. It is small and controlled.
instructionsEn: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.

entries.descriptionEn: A plank with alternating knee taps to the floor. It trains the abs and anti-rotation control.
instructionsEn: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
